Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers

Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career
.Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggys products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking ForExperience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excelyou should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Key Responsibilities
1. Operational & Surgical Management
Schedule & Flow: Coordinate daily surgical lists, elective/emergency cases, and room turnaround times to minimize delays and cancellations. 
Patient Safety: Enforce the WHO/NABH surgical safety checklist (Sign-In, Time-Out, Sign-Out), correct patient identification, consent verifications, and safe handover protocols. 
Emergency Preparedness: Maintain readiness for trauma or clinical emergencies inside and outside the OT. 
2. NABH Compliance & Infection Control
Sterilization & Asepsis: Monitor air-handling units (AHU / laminar flow), positive pressure, temperature/humidity logs, and CSSD (Central Sterile Supply Department) sterilization indicators. 
Biomedical Waste (BMW): Ensure strict compliance with national biomedical waste management rules (segregation, color-coding, and safe disposal).

Stock & Expiry Control: Monitor consumable inventory, emergency drugs, surgical instruments, and implant availability; prevent stock-outs or expired items.
4. Human Resource & Staff Management
Duty Rosters: Prepare shift schedules, leave plans, and on-call rosters for OT nurses, OT technicians, and housekeeping staff.
Training & Competency: Conduct regular drills, biomedical safety trainings, and mandatory continuing education for OT personnel. 
5. Interdepartmental Coordination
Liaise closely with surgeons, anesthesiologists, ICU, Wards, CSSD, Blood Bank, and Pharmacy to ensure seamless patient transit and care.

Education: B.Sc. Nursing / Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing / GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery) or a relevant healthcare administration degree; specialized postgraduate credentials or diplomas in hospital/OT management are an added advantage.

Role & responsibilities
1. Sit at the PMJAY help desk and welcome patients and attendants, explaining the scheme, its benefits, and the cashless treatment process in simple Hindi and the local language.
2. Verify beneficiary eligibility through the Beneficiary Identification System (BIS) using Aadhaar, ration card, PMJAY e-card, or other approved documents.
3. Help eligible patients obtain or generate their Ayushman card through the approved process, or guide them to the nearest enrolment centre.
4. Register patients on the Transaction Management System (TMS) and carry out pre-authorization requests for packages that need it.
5. Coordinate with treating doctors and clinical staff to select the correct package and collect required documents, investigation reports, and clinical notes.
6. Upload treatment records, photographs, and discharge summaries, and follow up on claim submission, queries, and approvals within the stipulated timelines.
7. Make sure eligible patients receive cashless treatment, and report any case of illegal charging or denial of service to the hospital management.
8. Counsel patients and families on treatment coverage, the documents they need, expected stay, and what to do at discharge.
9. Support the hospital's PMJAY nodal officer and billing team in tracking claim status, rejections, and recovery of pending claims.
10. Keep daily records of patients counselled, registered, and discharged under the scheme, and submit MIS reports as required.
11. Take part in health awareness and enrolment drives, and refer patients to other government schemes where relevant.
12. Handle patient grievances politely and escalate them to the hospital management or the State Health Agency (SHA), Bihar helpline when needed.
13. Protect patient confidentiality and follow all National Health Authority (NHA) guidelines, SOPs, and data security rules.

Graduate in any discipline. A degree or diploma in Social Work, Public Health, Hospital Administration, Nursing, or Health Sciences is preferred.
Experience of at least 2-5 years in a hospital help desk, insurance desk, TPA, or health scheme setting (freshers with training may be considered).

Description:
Job Summary
The AVP – Medical Coding Quality will provide strategic and operational leadership to the organization's medical coding Quality function, ensuring consistent delivery of high-quality, compliant, and efficient coding services across multiple specialties and client engagements.
The role will be responsible for establishing robust quality governance frameworks, driving coding accuracy and audit effectiveness, optimizing quality assurance resources, and leading continuous improvement initiatives.
The incumbent will work closely with Operations, Training, Technology, and Client Services leadership to strengthen coding quality, improve operational efficiency, enhance client satisfaction, and support organizational growth.
The role will also drive quality transformation through AI-assisted auditing, automation, and data-driven performance management while developing a strong quality leadership pipeline.
The AVP will have direct accountability for the effectiveness of the Quality Assurance function and joint accountability with Coding Operations for overall coding quality performance and achievement of client quality SLAs.
 Key Goals
       Develop and execute a comprehensive medical coding quality strategy across offshore operations, ensuring consistent achievement of client quality standards and contractual SLAs.
       Establish a robust, scalable, and standardized Quality Assurance Program across multiple specialties, business units, and client engagements.
       Drive continuous improvement in coding accuracy, audit effectiveness, compliance, and operational efficiency through structured quality governance and risk management.
       Partner with Coding Operations leadership to jointly own overall coding quality outcomes, with clearly defined responsibilities for audit effectiveness, coder performance, corrective actions, and SLA achievement.
       Optimize QA capacity, audit coverage, resource utilization, and cost efficiency while maintaining service delivery commitments.
       Strengthen collaboration with Operations and Training teams to identify recurring coding errors, implement corrective and preventive actions, and achieve sustainable quality improvements.
       Lead quality-side adoption, validation, and governance of AI-assisted auditing and automation solutions in collaboration with Technology teams.
       Enhance client satisfaction through proactive quality management, transparent reporting, timely resolution of escalations, and continuous improvement.
       Build a high-performing quality leadership team through talent development, succession planning, and performance management.
       Ensure effective management of the QA operating budget and drive measurable improvements in cost efficiency without compromising quality standards.
 Job Profile
Quality Function
       Provide strategic and operational leadership to a QA organization of 350+ auditors through a structured management hierarchy, ensuring capability, productivity, accountability, and scalable delivery.
       Develop and implement organization-wide quality strategies, governance frameworks, policies, and standardized audit methodologies aligned with business objectives and client requirements.
       Oversee quality management for OP (ED/SDS/ANC/OBV), ProFee Surgery & EM, HCC, Home Health and IP DRG projects.
       Ensure consistent achievement of coding quality standards, client-specific requirements, and contractual SLAs across all assigned engagements.
       Exercise direct ownership of audit quality, audit accuracy, audit coverage, and QA process effectiveness, while sharing accountability for overall coding quality outcomes with Coding Operations.
       Own QA workforce planning, audit coverage strategy, resource utilization, productivity management, and cost optimization aligned with business growth and client requirements.
       Drive effective implementation, monitoring, and adherence to the organization's Quality Management System (QMS).
       Establish enterprise quality dashboards and governance mechanisms to monitor coding accuracy, audit effectiveness, defect trends, rework, and corrective action effectiveness.
       Establish second-level audit, inter-auditor calibration, and audit dispute resolution frameworks to ensure consistency, reliability, and defensibility of audit findings.
       Lead structured Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) programs, with defined accountability, closure timelines, and verification of sustained improvements.
       Identify systemic quality risks, coding error patterns, and process gaps, and implement proactive measures to prevent recurrence.
       Ensure adherence to applicable ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS, official coding guidelines, client-specific coding requirements, and relevant compliance standards.
       Collaborate with Operations and Training leadership to identify competency gaps, develop targeted training interventions, and monitor improvements in coding performance.
       Develop risk-based audit methodologies to prioritize high-risk specialties, complex accounts, new coders, and recurring error categories.
       Lead quality readiness assessments for new client implementations, specialty expansions, process transitions, and operational scale-up.

Purpose of the Role
The role is responsible for driving sales of vehicles through sales volumes and market share and ensuring enhancing customer engagement in the assigned territory. It involves actively managing dealer relationships & driving demand, developing new business and achieving the territory sales targets.

Job Responsibility
1. Sales Planning:
Drives sales in the specified territory for a particular product line ensuring volume sales, market share growth and enhanced customer engagement in assigned territory
Plan and conduct monthly target setting including marketing activations at the dealerships in line with forecast/ estimated TIV and sales volume for the assigned territory
Coordinate with various partners and internal teams to drive customer engagement & sales. Plan and execute monthly activations and provide the necessary support to drive effectiveness while measuring outcomes of activities conducted
Ensure monthly and annual targets to be achieved in terms of retail sales and customer satisfaction levels as per Sales & Marketing plan.
Support state product manager in the conversion of mid-to-big sized deals when needed
Drive the conversion of C4T customers with assigned dealership into Tata Motors fold
Drive sales and share of business with key accounts customers
Drive value added sales in the assigned territory and seek support from sales teams on need basis
2. Review and Execution:
Conduct sales execution meeting on a monthly basis with dealers sales representatives and sales team to monitor performance and to set future action plan
Execute dealer wise and outlet wise performance to monitor sales pipeline and deploy action plan to different territories based on performance and potential
Review and monitor MIS of the following: Volume, Market Share, Activity Report, Retail tracker, C4T list and pipeline DSE
Ensure the execute of distribution of dealership target DSE wise and Micro Market wise
Provide product wise indent to RSMs as per the agreed schedule
Capture and review market intelligence through multiple sources, including voice of customer on product/services and regulatory requirements. Explore potential white spaces due to emerging customer expectations
Review and monitor dealers inventory and ensure that it stays at optimum level through proper forecasting
Provide inputs on existing product improvements/ development of new products and variants to create differentiation in the market
Work closely with state product managers to share market intelligence about the product on regular basis
3. Financial Management:
Monitor liquidation of stock at assigned dealerships to ensure timely payment by financiers and channeling of funds back into the system
4. People Management:
Drive manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships as per TML norms
Execute trainings for dealer sales team on pre-sales & sales processes, new product features / modifications etc.

Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal:
State Product Manager (Product Line), State Head
Update and seek support on sales and market share growth
Provide support, if and when necessary, in conversion of mid-to-big sized deals
Regional Sales Managers
Product, targeting setting for self and dealership, ATL activities
Regional Head SNM/ SNM Manager
Drive Manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships
Regional Head RCFI/ RCFI Manager
Ensure finance availability to dealers and customers

Desired Candidate Profile
Education : B.E/ B.Tech with relevant experience/ MBA in Sales & Marketing preferred.
Relevant Experience : 4 - 7 years.
Experience in Automobile Industry.
Experience in Sales & Marketing

Skills & Competencies
Product Knowledge
Analytical Skills
Interpersonal Skills
Communication Skills

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

The role acts as a bridge between mental and physical healthcare, working within a multidisciplinary medical team to improve patient outcomes while rigorously adhering to NABH Standards regarding patient care, rights, informed consent, and clinical documentation.

Key Responsibilities1. Core Psychological & Therapeutic Duties
Assessments: Conduct systematic psychological, emotional, and behavioral evaluations to identify patient distress patterns related to chronic illnesses, lifestyle diseases, surgeries, trauma, or psychiatric conditions.
Therapy Delivery: Provide evidence-based individual, group, or family counselling to address anxiety, clinical depression, stress, grief, and treatment adherence issues.
Crisis Intervention: Deliver emergency psychological first aid for patients experiencing acute trauma, severe diagnoses, or self-harm ideation within the hospital.
Specialized Care Support: Collaborate with departments like Oncology, Cardiology, Diabetology, Palliative Care, and Bariatrics to help patients cope with chronic medical conditions.
2. NABH Standard Compliance & Quality Control
Standardized Documentation (COP - Care of Patients): Maintain flawless, highly precise electronic and manual case files. Document all psychological evaluations, customized care plans, progress tracking, and discharge notes according to standard templates approved by the hospital's quality desk.
Patient Rights & Education (PRE): Ensure the absolute protection of patient data and medical confidentiality. Formally educate the patient and their family members regarding treatment plans, therapeutic expectations, and available support systems.
Informed Consent: Strictly obtain and document informed consent before executing specialized psychotherapeutic strategies or assessments.
Incidents & Medication Safety: Report any adverse behavioral events or psychological crises immediately via the hospital's standardized incident reporting system. Ensure clear separation between psychological therapies and psychotropic prescription tracking.
Audits & KPIs: Participate in routine internal clinical audits and track psychology department Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure the department remains fully prepared for NABH surveillance audits.
3. Interdisciplinary Collaboration
Participate actively in multidisciplinary case conferences alongside psychiatrists, neurologists, physicians, and medical social workers to enable holistic recovery paths.
Provide consultation, basic counselling skills training, and burnout management workshops for the hospital's nursing and allied health staff.

Qualifications and Skills
Education:
Masters Degree (M.A./M.Sc.) in Counselling Psychology or Clinical Psychology from a UGC-recognized university.
Preferred: M.Phil in Clinical/Counselling Psychology or a relevant doctoral degree (Ph.D./Psy.D.).
Note: Registration with the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP) or Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) is highly valued depending on specific clinical assessment duties.
Experience: Minimum 2–5 years of practice in a multi-specialty or psychiatric hospital setting (prior exposure to NABH or JCI accredited workflows is a significant advantage).
Core Competencies: Active listening, high emotional intelligence, crisis de-escalation, and proficiency in clinical information systems (HIS/EMR tools)

Summary:
The Field Sales Executive plays a vital role in driving business expansion within the paint-chemical industry by cultivating strong, lasting relationships with key trade partners, including painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. This position demands consistent performance, proactive engagement, and a hands-on approach to achieve and exceed sales targets. The ideal candidate will conduct daily site visits, maintain a strong presence at assigned retail outlets, organize shop meetings, and ensure accurate reporting all contributing to enhanced market penetration and brand visibility. With a focus on customer-centric strategies and performance excellence, this role is essential to sustaining growth and strengthening market position across the assigned territories.

Location: Mumbai

Achieve and consistently exceed assigned sales targets.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with painters, contractors, builders, architects, engineers, and other key stakeholders.
Conduct a minimum of two site visits per day to identify new opportunities and support customer needs.
Dedicate at least two hours daily to on-site presence at assigned retail stores to drive sales and customer engagement.
Organize and lead weekly shop meetings with applicators to promote product adoption and team alignment.
Submit accurate and timely daily sales reports through the designated online portal.








Requirements
Valid two-wheeler license is mandatory for field operations.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to build relationships.
Self - motivated, disciplined, and highly driven by performance goals.
Minimum educational qualification: Graduation (preferred).
6 months to 12 months of experience in channel sales (e.g., AP/Akzo, Laminates, Plywood, Electricals, Lubricants, building materials).
Fresh graduates or professionals from insurance or banking sectors with demonstrated sales aptitude are encouraged to apply.




Benefits

MWA: 5,000/ -
Lucrative performance-based incentives
Absorption after 1 year based on performance
Travel allowance: 5,000 per month, depending on profile

Description:
Location: Madhepura
Company: Alstom
Job Summary
Could you be the full-time Material Planner in Madhepura were looking for
Your future role
Take on a new challenge and apply your material planning and supply chain expertise in a cutting-edge field. Youll work alongside collaborative and detail-oriented teammates.
Youll play a critical role in ensuring seamless material planning and supply chain processes, directly impacting production efficiency and supplier delivery performance. Day-to-day, youll work closely with teams across the business, including Manufacturing and Testing, Industrial Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, and Logistics, as well as collaborate with external vendors and business partners. Youll also proactively resolve supply issues, update material planning documents, and drive continuous improvement initiatives in supplier delivery performance.
Youll specifically take care of creating and updating Material Planning documents, such as Call-offs and Schedule Agreements, but also ensure the accuracy of material planning master data and resolve goods receipt issues.
Well look to you for:
Managing purchase requisitions until Material Planning document creation for internal suppliers
Following up with Procurement on purchase requisition maturity for external suppliers
Ensuring and updating the accuracy of material planning master data in compliance with stock and logistic constraints
Communicating delivery plans and purchase orders to suppliers and following up on their confirmations
Analyzing supplier confirmations versus Alstom needs and evaluating risks/impacts on production/projects
Identifying priorities, setting up recovery actions, and organizing regular reviews with suppliers to monitor delivery performance
Resolving supply chain issues, including managing MRP exception messages and goods receipt issues
Driving supplier OTIF (On-Time In-Full) improvement initiatives
All about you
We value passion and attitude over experience. Thats why we dont expect you to have every single skill. Instead, weve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
B. Tech in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering
6+ years of experience in scheduling and inventory management within a manufacturing environment
Proficiency in SAP (PP/MM) modules
Knowledge of industrial planning, logistics, inventory management, material planning, and supplier relationship management
Familiarity with tools such as ASCOT, ARIBA, CELONIS, and QlikSense
Strong data analysis and reporting skills
Cross-functional team management and collaboration skills
Agility and adaptability in a dynamic environment
Entrepreneurial mindset and problem-solving abilities
Proficiency in English and Hindi
You dont need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, youll be proud. If youre up for the challenge, wed love to hear from you!

Job Title: Data Analyst
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Pune
Department: Customer & Retail Analytics
Employment Type: Full-time
About FedEx: FedEx provides customers and businesses worldwide with a broad portfolio of transportation, e-commerce, and business services and also serves our customers through our retail presence. We foster an environment of growth and learning, where innovative ideas are encouraged, and diverse teams are valued for their contributions. As part of our commitment to excellence, were seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join our analytics team.
Job Summary: As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in gathering, processing, and analyzing data to drive informed decision-making and actionable insights for FedEx. Your quantitative expertise and business acumen will help develop analytical solutions to improve operations, customer experience, and business outcomes. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to develop meaningful data analysis, insights summarizations/ visualizations and communicate findings that guide strategy and operational decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets using Python and SQL to support business objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, formulate analytic solutions, and provide actionable insights.
Develop and maintain data models and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics.
Create meaningful data visualizations to communicate findings, trends, and actionable insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Conduct exploratory data analysis and identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for business improvement.
Support data quality initiatives, ensuring accuracy and consistency across data sources.
Utilize statistical and quantitative techniques to support problem-solving and business optimization efforts.
Mandatory Skills:
Python: Proficiency in data manipulation, data analysis libraries (Pandas, NumPy), and data visualization libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
SQL: Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and complex queries.
Business Acumen: Ability to understand business context and objectives, aligning analytics with organizational goals.
Quantitative Aptitude: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
Data Visualization: Basic skills in data visualization to effectively communicate insights.
Statistical Analysis: Foundational understanding of statistical methods (e.g., regression, hypothesis testing).
Communication Skills: Ability to distill complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
Good-to-Have Skills:
Power BI: Experience with Power BI for data visualization and report development.
Machine Learning Fundamentals: Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts for deeper pattern analysis.
Advanced Excel: Skills in advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, and data cleaning for quick analyses.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably within the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and a collaborative mindset.
Join Our Team: If you are passionate about Data analytics to drive business impact and enhance the customer experience, we invite you to join our team at FedEx. Apply now to be part of a dynamic, innovative environment where your skills and expertise will make a difference.
Application Process: To apply for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications. Qualified candidates will be contacted for further evaluation.

Location: Bangalore / Pune / Mumbai / Gandhinagar
Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant to join our growing SAP practice. As an SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant at Capgemini, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting SAP Business Workflow solutions to automate business processes and enhance operational efficiency. You will collaborate closely with functional consultants, business users, and technical teams to deliver innovative workflow-based solutions across SAP landscapes.
As an SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant, you will:
Design, develop, and implement SAP Business Workflow solutions to automate end-to-end business processes.
Configure and develop workflow components including Tasks, Standard Tasks, Workflows, Events, Methods, Rule Resolution, and Agents.
Create and enhance Business Objects (BOR) and ABAP OO-based workflow objects.
Develop custom workflow functionalities using ABAP programming techniques, User Exits, BAdIs, Enhancements, and Function Modules.
Configure event management and workflow triggering mechanisms using change documents, business transactions, and custom events.
Develop and troubleshoot workflow notifications, work items, inbox configurations, and approval processes.
Integrate workflows with SAP modules such as MM, SD, FI, CO, HCM, and SRM based on business requirements.
Perform workflow administration activities including monitoring, debugging, error handling, and performance optimization.
Work with functional consultants and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical workflow solutions.
Ensure adherence to SAP development standards, best practices, and quality processes throughout the project lifecycle.

Required Skills

Strong hands-on experience in SAP ABAP Workflow Development.
Expertise in SAP Business Workflow configuration and development.
Experience with BOR (Business Object Repository) and ABAP OO Workflow.
Good knowledge of Workflow Administration, Event Management, Agent Determination, and Rule Resolution.
Strong ABAP development skills including Reports, Enhancements, BAdIs, User Exits, Function Modules, and Object-Oriented ABAP.
Experience in workflow debugging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA workflow framework will be an added advantage.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.Role & responsibilities

Job Description
Overview
AtkinsRalis is one of the world's leading consultancies operating in the built and natural environment. You might know us for the great work we do across our wide variety of projects. We're proud to say it's thanks to our people's diversity of thought, expertise and knowledge. We offer unparalleled opportunities for talented individuals in search of a rewarding career both in India and around the world. And when you join us, you'll be a part of this genuinely collaborative environment, where everyone's voice is valued and treated equally.
Your role
We are looking for a Principal Transport Planner (Strategic Modelling) to join our team. This role will be based at our AtkinsRalis office in Bangalore/Gurgaon, India.
Appropriate academic and professional qualifications (Bachelor's Degree with Master's degree in transport planning / economics).
Working experience (16+ years) in Transport Planning software like VISUM, SATURN, DIADEM, EMME.
Experience and knowledge of Strategic Modelling techniques and guidance.
Knowledge and experience in delivering transport planning/modelling projects for UK/ME/ USA/ Canada/ Australia regions.
Strong Analytical skills with experience in handling and interpreting complex datasets.
Experience in scripting using like Python, Excel-VBA and R.
Strong understanding of ArcGIS/QGIS, PowerBI and Microsoft Office applications.
Ability to work in a team as part of a wider project with no supervision.
Experience in leading smaller teams as part of a project delivery.
Good written communication skills.
Be able to delegate the tasks.
About you
Be highly self-motivated and ambitious.
Be able to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers.
Be able to build excellent working relationships with colleagues and clients.
Experience in the use of analytical and research tools such as GIS and the use of databases.
Appreciation of the transport industry and related policy context.
Professional membership of a relevant institution.
Reward benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
About AtkinsRalis
We're AtkinsRalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
Find out more.

We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.

Description:
Job Description
Job Title: Product Lifecycle Risk Manager, AVP
Location: Mumbai, India
Alternative Locations: Pune, India / Bangalore, India


Role Description:
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

About DWS Investment Risk:
The Chief Risk Office within DWS is an independent function responsible for protecting the business as well as being a trusted adviser and partner for supporting sustainable business growth.
As part of the Chief Risk Office, Investment Risk provides independent oversight and challenge of risks arising from DWS fiduciary activities, including the governance of investment products throughout their lifecycle.
The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.

What we’ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritization of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.

Your skills and experience
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with at least five years of relevant experience in Asset Management, Product Governance, Product Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, Regulatory Change or a related governance or control function.
Strong understanding of investment products, asset management operating models, product lifecycle management and Product Governance frameworks within a regulated financial services environment.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate their impact into appropriate governance processes, policies and controls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to independently review and challenge complex product initiatives, identify material risks and control gaps, and formulate clear, practical recommendations.
Experience managing or enhancing governance processes, workflows and control frameworks, including translating governance requirements into system enhancements and supporting tool implementation, testing, migration or automation initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organizational skills, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior stakeholders and committees, constructively influence cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality outcomes across competing priorities.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with data analytics, reporting tools or process automation solutions is advantageous.

How we’ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
About us and our teams

Role & responsibilities
We are seeking a Network Implementation Engineer to perform the staging, configuration, migration, and cutover of enterprise and data center network environments. This role is responsible for turning Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and High-Level Designs (HLDs) into production reality across Cisco routing, switching, wireless, and security ecosystems. The ideal candidate has deep Cisco CLI expertise, hands-on experience executing maintenance windows, and familiarity with Cisco's controller-led architectures (Catalyst Center).
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst (9200/9300/9400/9500/9600) and ASR/ISR/Catalyst 8000,4300,1100 series routers.
Provision Cisco Catalyst Wireless infrastructure, including 9800,5520,8500 Series Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points (APs).
Onboard devices into Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Spaces/DNAC) for automated template deployment.
Lead scheduled, off-hours maintenance windows to perform core/distribution cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE / NX-OS).
Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.
The skills Required
Routing- Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge on MPLS will be a advantage.
Switching- Deep understanding on switching concept like STP, HSRP, VRRP, Portchannel, Switch Stacking, VTP.
Wireless- Hands on experience on cisco air OS and catalyst controllers (8500,5520,9800), Access point, RF fundamentals, WLAN fundamentals.
Experience & Certifications
Experience: 6 months of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field experience),CCNP preferred.
Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.
Participation in off-hours change windows (nights and weekends) to minimize operational disruption.

Shift – 24*7
Work Mode – Work from office
Looking for immediate joiners

Role : Counterparty Onboarding Relationship Manager - Supply Chain Finance

Department: Supply Chain Finance Counter-party Team.

Location: Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Chennai, Chandigarh, Lucknow, and Hyderabad.


Role Summary

Own endtoend onboarding of vendors, dealers and other counterparties under anchorled Supply Chain Finance programs. Ensure fast, compliant onboarding, smooth activation and strong earlystage engagement to drive utilization and portfolio hygiene.

Key Responsibilities

Engage with vendors/dealers to explain SCF products, benefits and onboarding process.
Manage complete onboarding workflow: KYC, documentation, risk checks, approvals and limit setup.
Coordinate with Credit, Risk, Ops, Legal and Tech for frictionless onboarding and compliance.
Drive activation: ensure counterparties utilize limits and monitor your portfolio growth and quality.
Monitor counterparty-level ageing/overdue, flag early warning indicators, follow-up for payments, support Collections on early bucket resolution, and ensure anchor alignment on disputes.
Resolve operational issues, documentation gaps and onboarding bottlenecks.
Maintain MIS, funnel trackers and adherence to onboarding TATs.
Support Anchor Relationship Managers with utilization, reactivation and earlycycle portfolio hygiene.

Key KPIs

Counterparties onboarded
Onboarding TAT (Pre-sanction documentation Approval post-sanction documentation Golive)
Documentation quality / monitor deferrals.
Firstdrawdown % and utilization support

Candidate Profile

Experience: 4 to 10 years in SCF, Working Capital, Trade Finance, MSME lending or onboarding roles.
Skills: Strong communication, KYC/AML understanding, documentation accuracy, process discipline, Excel/CRM familiarity.
Traits: High ownership, speed, detailorientation, customer empathy.

Education
Graduate/MBA preferred.
Certifications in KYC/Compliance/SCF are advantageous.

Maintain employee records, personal files, contract staff muster, shift rosters.
Ensure timely confirmation, transfers, promotions, increments, and separations.

Maintain statutory registers and ensure readiness for inspections.
Support external audits: FSSAI etc

Handle shop floor discipline issues, grievances, counselling, and issue of notices/charge sheets where needed.
Support healthy employee relations in close coordination with the Factory Manager and Area HR Head.
Maintain harmonious relations between staff, operators, contract workforce, and contractors.
7. Training & Capability Building
Identify unit-level training needs (food safety, GMP, safety, HR policy awareness).
Conduct daily/weekly briefing talks or coordinate functional training.
Maintain training records and skill-matrix for operators.
8. Employee Engagement & Welfare
Drive engagement calendar: festivals, R&R, skip-levels, suggestion programs.
Ensure availability of welfare facilities: drinking water, rest area, washrooms, PPE, first-aid, canteen.
Monitor hygiene, safety and morale on the shopfloor.
9. HR MIS, Analytics & Reporting
Prepare and maintain monthly HR dashboards:
Attendance, attrition, overtime, contractor compliance score, open positions, training records, statutory status.
Share daily/weekly MIS with Factory Manager & Area HR Head.
10. Support to Business & Operations
Partner with production, quality and shift leads to ensure manpower efficiency.
Support productivity, food safety and operational performance through timely HR interventions.
Drive culture of discipline, safety, responsibility and performance.

10+ years in data engineering with 5+ Experience in AWS data platforms.
Amazon Redshift (deep): data modelling, performance tuning, WLM, RBAC, external schemas/Spectrum.

Advanced SQL, dimensional/canonical data modelling, ETL/ELT frameworks.
Python (primary) PySpark for Glue jobs.
MySQL (operational data store) and CDC/batch extraction patterns.
dbt must be able to read, reverseengineer, and migrate existing dbt models.
Dataquality frameworks, reconciliation, and lineage/metadata practices.
Git,CI/CD pipelines, database schema version control (Liquibase or equivalent), Dev/Test/Prod promotion.
Leadership, mentoring, stakeholder management; ability to work independently in Agile.

Dagster orchestration for ASIS discovery and migration.
Kafka / eventdriven streaming ingestion.
Apache Iceberg on S3, Apache Spark/EMR
Tableau, Metabase servinglayer knowledge.
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation).
Datagovernance tooling (Glue Data Quality, Data Zone, Lake Formation).

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you'd like, where you'll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you'll be able to reimagine what's possible. Join us and help the world's leading organizations


Your Role

Architect, deploy, and maintain on-premise VMware Workspace ONE (AirWatch) environments, ensuring high availability, secure database integrations, and seamless communication between components such as UAG and ACC.
Configure and administer Microsoft Intune environments, designing robust Mobile Device Management (MDM) and Mobile Application Management (MAM) solutions.
Manage the complete lifecycle of Android Enterprise devices (Work Profile, Fully Managed, Dedicated) and iOS/iPadOS devices.
Design and implement compliance policies, configuration profiles, conditional access policies, and certificate-based authentication mechanisms.
Manage integrations with Apple Business Manager (ABM), Apple Push Notification Service (APNs), Managed Google Play, and enterprise identity platforms.
Lead client discovery workshops, gather business and security requirements, and translate them into scalable mobility solutions.

Strong hands-on experience with VMware Workspace ONE (On-Premise), including architecture, deployment, administration, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
Extensive experience managing and configuring Microsoft Intune for device enrollment, application management, compliance, and security.
Expert knowledge of Android Enterprise deployment models, OEM configurations, and iOS/iPadOS management frameworks.
Experience implementing Conditional Access, Zero Trust principles, certificate-based authentication, and mobile security controls.
Strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), identity integration, and enterprise mobility security.
Experience integrating UEM platforms with Apple Business Manager (ABM), APNs, Managed Google Play, Okta, Ping, and other identity providers.
Ability to develop Statements of Work (SoW), High-Level Design (HLD) documents, technical documentation, and user adoption guides.



What will you love working at Capgemini

Work on enterprise-scale digital workplace and mobility transformation programs for global clients across multiple industries.
Gain hands-on exposure to next-generation endpoint management, Zero Trust security architectures, and modern workplace technologies.
Collaborate with global teams and client stakeholders to design and implement cutting-edge UEM solutions using Workspace ONE, Intune, Android Enterprise, and Apple ecosystems.
Build expertise in cloud security, identity management, compliance automation, and endpoint security frameworks.

Job description: SAP BW4/HANA L3 Support and Enhancement.
A BW/4HANA L3 Support Engineer requires advanced technical support for SAP BW/4HANA systems, resolving complex issues escalated from lower support levels. This role requires deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA architecture, data modelling and troubleshooting techniques. Key responsibilities include analysing and resolving critical incidents, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with development teams for long-term solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting and Resolution: Investigate and resolve complex technical issues related to SAP BW/4HANA, often involving performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, or system errors.
Root Cause Analysis: Conduct thorough root cause analysis to identify the underlying causes of issues and implement preventative measures.
Collaboration: Work closely with L1 and L2 support teams, development teams, and other IT teams to resolve issues and improve system stability.
System Monitoring: Monitor the health and performance of SAP BW/4HANA systems, proactively identifying and addressing potential problems.
Knowledge Management: Document solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and best practices to build a knowledge base for future reference.
Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior support engineers.
Incident Management: Manage critical incidents (P1 and P2 tickets) and ensure timely resolution.
System Enhancement: Contribute to the development and implementation of solutions to improve system performance and stability.
Required Skills & Experience:
Deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA: Including data modelling, data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Advanced troubleshooting skills: Ability to analyse complex issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
Strong communication and collaboration skills: Ability to effectively communicate with various stakeholders, including business users and technical teams.
Experience with SAP BW/4HANA administration: Including system configuration, performance tuning, and security.
Experience with ABAP development: For data extraction and transformation.
Knowledge of HANA platforms: (e.g., Native HANA modelling, AMDP) is often preferred.
Experience with incident management and ticketing systems: 3-5 years of experience is required.

Job description: SAP BW4/HANA L3 Support and Enhancement.
A BW/4HANA L3 Support Engineer requires advanced technical support for SAP BW/4HANA systems, resolving complex issues escalated from lower support levels. This role requires deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA architecture, data modelling and troubleshooting techniques. Key responsibilities include analysing and resolving critical incidents, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with development teams for long-term solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting and Resolution: Investigate and resolve complex technical issues related to SAP BW/4HANA, often involving performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, or system errors.
Root Cause Analysis: Conduct thorough root cause analysis to identify the underlying causes of issues and implement preventative measures.
Collaboration: Work closely with L1 and L2 support teams, development teams, and other IT teams to resolve issues and improve system stability.
System Monitoring: Monitor the health and performance of SAP BW/4HANA systems, proactively identifying and addressing potential problems.
Knowledge Management: Document solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and best practices to build a knowledge base for future reference.
Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior support engineers.
Incident Management: Manage critical incidents (P1 and P2 tickets) and ensure timely resolution.
System Enhancement: Contribute to the development and implementation of solutions to improve system performance and stability.
Required Skills & Experience:
Deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA: Including data modelling, data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Advanced troubleshooting skills: Ability to analyse complex issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
Strong communication and collaboration skills: Ability to effectively communicate with various stakeholders, including business users and technical teams.
Experience with SAP BW/4HANA administration: Including system configuration, performance tuning, and security.
Experience with ABAP development: For data extraction and transformation.
Knowledge of HANA platforms: (e.g., Native HANA modelling, AMDP) is often preferred.
Experience with incident management and ticketing systems: 3-5 years of experience is required.

Description:
Job Description Learning Operations Manager

Role Purpose
The Learning Operations Manager is responsible for the efficient operational delivery of the organisation's learning portfolio. The role ensures that learning activities are planned, administered, delivered and reported accurately, providing an exceptional learner experience while producing high-quality management information to support business decision-making and regulatory compliance.
The role combines strong operational management with expertise in HR systems, learning technologies and data analytics to ensure learning is delivered to the right audiences, at the right time, with measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities
Learning Operations
Manage the end-to-end operational delivery of learning programmes across multiple business areas.
Coordinate learning schedules, enrolments, cancellations and communications.
Ensure learning activities are delivered efficiently, consistently and in accordance with agreed service levels.
Identify and implement opportunities to automate and streamline operational processes.
Maintain operational procedures, standards and documentation, as well as manage the learning team inbox.
Audience Management
Define and manage learning audiences using organisational structures, job roles, business rules and regulatory requirements.
Create and maintain learner populations within the Learning Management System (LMS).
Ensure mandatory and role-based learning is assigned accurately.
Manage audience changes resulting from organisational restructures, acquisitions, role changes and employee lifecycle events.
Work closely with HR and business stakeholders to validate audience accuracy.
Learning Invitations & Communications
Manage learner invitations, reminders and completion notifications.
Design and maintain communication schedules to maximise learner engagement and completion rates.
Ensure communications are timely, professional and aligned with organisational branding.
Support stakeholder communications for major learning deployments.
Reporting & Analytics
Produce regular dashboards and management reports covering learning activity, completion rates, overdue training, compliance status and learner engagement.
Analyse trends, identify risks and recommend actions to improve learning performance.
Develop meaningful KPIs and operational metrics.
Support audit requests by providing accurate learning records and evidence.
Present data insights to senior stakeholders in a clear and actionable format.
HR Systems & Learning Technology
Act as a subject matter expert for the Learning Management System and its integration with HR systems.
Manage system configuration relating to learning assignments, organisational hierarchies, user records and reporting.
Work with HRIS teams to ensure accurate employee data feeds.
Support testing and implementation of system enhancements and upgrades.
Troubleshoot operational issues relating to learner records and system functionality.
Stakeholder Management
Build strong relationships with HR, Technology, Compliance, Learning Partners and business stakeholders.
Provide operational advice and guidance on learning processes and system capabilities.
Support business areas in planning learning deployments and reporting outcomes.
Continuous Improvement
Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, technology and process redesign.
Monitor operational performance against service levels.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across Learning Operations.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience
Essential Experience
Significant experience in Learning Operations, Learning Administration or Learning Services.
Experience managing large-scale learning deployments across complex organisations.
Strong experience of audience management within Learning Management Systems.
Experience producing learning compliance reporting and operational dashboards.
Experience managing learner communications and invitations.
Working knowledge of HR systems and employee data structures.
Experience supporting regulatory or mandatory learning programmes.

Technical Skills
Strong knowledge of Learning Management Systems (e.g. Cornerstone, SuccessFactors Learning, Workday Learning, Oracle Learning, Moodle).
Experience using HR systems such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM or equivalent.
Advanced Excel skills.
Experience using reporting and visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau or similar.
Strong understanding of data quality, governance and reporting principles.
Comfortable working with large datasets.

Core Competencies
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail.
Strong customer and service orientation.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Continuous improvement mindset.
High levels of accuracy and accountability.

Desirable
Experience supporting financial services, regulated industries or mandatory compliance learning, in particular Supplier Management /Third Party Risk Management.
Knowledge of xAPI, SCORM and learning technologies.
Understanding of data privacy and GDPR principles.
Experience working within Agile or transformation programmes.

Success Measures
The Learning Operations Manager will be successful when they consistently deliver:
Accurate audience assignments with minimal manual intervention.
High completion rates for mandatory and regulatory learning.
Timely learner communications and invitations.
Reliable, insightful reporting that supports business decision-making.
Excellent learner satisfaction with operational support.
High levels of HR and LMS data integrity.
Continuous improvement through automation and process optimisation.
Strong operational governance and audit readiness.

Position: Business Analyst -Senior Techno-Functional Payment Application Designer with knowledge of domestic (NACHA, FedWire) and cross-border (SWIFT) payment schemes.
Experience: 7-20 years
Location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune/Mumbai

A talented, versatile, and hands-on **Functional Payments Expert** responsible for devising and delivering cutting-edge, innovative payment solutions. The ideal candidate is a **self-motivated individual** with strong awareness of payments industry trends, bank processing models, payment security, and end-to-end transaction lifecycles with understanding of Technology to design a solution.
Strong **business acumen**, positive work ethics, and a **collaborative mindset** are key to success in this role. The candidate will work closely with **cross-functional teams** including business, product, analytics, UX, and engineering, requiring excellent **articulation, negotiation, and influencing skills** due to high stakeholder visibility.
This role acts as a **bridge between business, product, and implementation teams**, translating business needs into scalable, high-performance payment solutions. The individual is expected to be an **effective leader, mentor, and thought leader**, contributing to future-ready payment architectures and strategies.
The role combines **functional design leadership, solution selling, and client-facing engagement**, requiring deep working knowledge of payments and modern distributed system architectures.
Your future duties and responsibilities
ead techno-functional design and solution definition for complex payment systems, translating business requirements into scalable and resilient solutions
Act as a bridge between business, product, and engineering teams, ensuring alignment across requirements, design, and implementation
Drive requirement elicitation, analysis, and documentation, including BRDs, functional specifications, process flows, data/message mappings, and user stories
Own end-to-end functional design for payment flows, including initiation, validation, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, and exception handling
Define and review functional decomposition aligned to microservices and domain-driven design principles
Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to ensure functional designs align with technical architecture (such as microservices, MQ or Kafka-based event flows, database modelling, UI design etc.).
Validate functional designs against non-functional requirements such as performance, scalability, resiliency, security, and regulatory compliance
Support Development, FAT, UAT and implementation phases, including scenario definition, validation support, and issue analysis.
Provide functional guidance during production issue analysis and root cause investigations, especially for payment failures and reconciliation breaks.
Engage directly with clients and senior stakeholders, presenting designs, explaining solution options, and influencing design decisions
Contribute to solution selling and pre-sales activities, including proposal support, solution walkthroughs, and client discussions.
Mentor junior designers and analysts, promoting best practices and thought leadership in payments design.
Contribute to future-state architecture and product roadmap discussions, incorporating industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging technologies.
Ensure all functional artifacts are accurate, complete, and audit-ready, supporting operational and compliance needs.
Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and cross-team design reviews.
Required qualifications to be successful in this role
Must-Have Skills:
General / Functional Skills
* Proven experience in **product development** with strong focus on **techno-functional design, decomposition, and solution definition**
* Strong **UML modeling skills**, preferably using **Sparx Enterprise Architect**
* Ability to understand, analyze, and document **business requirements** from diverse stakeholders
* Expertise in **Business Analysis**, **Requirement Elicitation**, **Gap & Impact Analysis**, **Message/Data Mapping**, and **FAT validation**
* Experience producing **BRDs, Functional Specifications, Process Flow Diagrams, User Stories, Backlogs**, and related artifacts
* Excellent **written and verbal communication skills**
* Strong **client-facing experience**, including interaction with senior executives (internal and external)
* Solid understanding of **technical aspects of software products**, including:
* Interfaces & APIs
* Connectivity & integration patterns
* Databases
* Application servers & middleware
* SOA and distributed systems
* Data warehousing, archival, and purge strategies
* Hands-on experience across the **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)**
* Strong working knowledge of **Agile delivery models**
Payments Domain Expertise
* Extensive experience in **payments-related software development projects or products**
* Strong proficiency in **SWIFT**, **SWIFT GPI**, **NACHA**, **CHAPS**
* Hands-on experience with **Clearing & Settlement Systems** across **Europe, Canada, and the US**
* Experience working with **at least two clearing systems in different countries**
* Proven track record of **product or project implementation** in **medium to large-scale banks**
Architecture & Technology (Key Additions)
* Strong **working knowledge of Microservices Architecture**, including:
* Service decomposition and domain-driven design concepts
* API-driven integration and service orchestration
* Working knowledge of designing interfaces.
* Resilience, scalability, and fault-tolerance considerations in payment systems
* Performance optimization and high availability considerations
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams to ensure **functional designs align with scalable, performant system architectures**
Good-to-Have Skills:
* Experience with **SWIFT Service Bureau** implementations
* Exposure to **product roadmap planning** and **DevOps strategies**
* Site implementation experience with leading payment products such as **Fundtech** or **Clear2Pay**
* Experience representing organizations in **external forums, industry panels, or conferences**
* Strong understanding of **CI/CD pipelines and operational readiness for payment platforms**

Key Responsibilities
1. Databricks Enterprise Strategy
Define and own the enterprise-wide Databricks platform strategy, roadmap, and adoption model in line with business goals.
Set up a Databricks Center of Excellence (CoE), including best practices, reusable frameworks, and engineering standards.
Assess new Databricks capabilities (Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Serverless, Photon, Mosaic AI, Databricks SQL) and lead their adoption.
Drive platform cost optimization (FinOps), workspace strategy, and capacity planning.
Act as the primary technical liaison with Databricks and cloud vendor partners.
2. Advanced DABs (Databricks Asset Bundles) Framework
Design and implement an enterprise-grade CI/CD framework using Databricks Asset Bundles for consistent, repeatable deployments.
Standardize Infrastructure-as-Code and Configuration-as-Code practices across environments (Dev, QA, UAT, Prod).
Integrate DABs with DevOps tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and Terraform.
Build reusable bundle templates, deployment patterns, and automated testing and validation pipelines.
Ensure version control, environment promotion, and release governance across all Databricks workloads.
3. Governance Implementation
Lead the design and rollout of data governance using Unity Catalog, covering access controls, data lineage, auditing, and data discovery.
Implement data security, privacy, and compliance controls (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, CCPA, as applicable).
Define data quality frameworks, metadata management standards, and data ownership and stewardship models.
Work with InfoSec, Risk, and Compliance teams to enforce policies such as row/column-level security, data masking, and fine-grained permissions.
Set up monitoring, observability, and audit mechanisms across the data platform.
4. Data Lakehouse Architecture
Architect and evolve the enterprise Data Lakehouse using Delta Lake and the Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
Design scalable data models that support analytics, BI, ML/AI, and real-time use cases.
Lead migrations from legacy data warehouses, Hadoop, and on-prem platforms to the Databricks Lakehouse.
Ensure performance tuning, storage optimization (Z-Ordering, Liquid Clustering, partitioning), and high availability.
Enable data sharing through Delta Sharing and support data mesh and data product approaches where relevant.
5. Cloud Architecture (AWS / Azure)
Design secure, scalable, and resilient cloud-native data architectures on AWS and/or Azure.
Oversee the integration of Databricks with cloud services, such as:
Azure: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Synapse, Entra ID, Purview
AWS: S3, Glue, Kinesis, Lambda, IAM, Redshift, Lake Formation
Define networking, identity, and security architecture, including VNet/VPC injection, Private Link, and SSO/SCIM.
Drive disaster recovery, business continuity, and multi-region strategies.
6. Enterprise Data Pipeline Design
Lead the design and delivery of robust batch and streaming pipelines using PySpark, Spark SQL, Structured Streaming, Delta Live Tables, and Auto Loader.
Establish reusable ingestion, transformation, and orchestration frameworks (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, ADF).
Ensure pipelines meet SLAs, scalability, reliability, and data quality requirements.
Promote engineering excellence through code reviews, testing standards, modular design, and documentation.
Enable real-time and near-real-time data processing for critical business use cases.
7. Portfolio Management
Manage a portfolio of data engineering programs and projects, ensuring delivery on scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
Prioritize initiatives based on business value, ROI, and strategic alignment.
Own resource planning, budgeting, vendor management, and risk mitigation across the portfolio.
Report progress, KPIs, and outcomes to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
Run delivery governance using Agile, SAFe, or hybrid methodologies.
People Leadership
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers, architects, and tech leads, including onshore and offshore teams.
Build a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
Drive hiring, performance management, and career development for the team.

Ability to solve complex challenges/problems and rapidly deliver innovative solutions

Hunger and passion for learning new skills
