SQL DBA Azure
Pune / Bangalore / Noida:
5 Days – Work from Office
What does a successful SQL DBA – Azure do at Fiserv?
We are looking for a skilled SQL DBA with hands-on Azure experience to join our team and support the administration, performance, availability and security of critical database environments. In this role, you will manage SQL Server databases across on-premises and cloud environments, support production systems and help ensure reliable, scalable, and high-performing database operations.
A successful candidate brings strong SQL Server database administration experience, practical knowledge of Azure services and the ability to work across infrastructure, application, and development teams. This role is important to maintaining database stability, supporting cloud initiatives and driving operational excellence.
What you will do
Administer, monitor and maintain SQL Server database environments across development, test and production systems
Manage databases in Azure environments, including support for cloud-hosted database services and related platform operations
Perform database installation, configuration, upgrades, patching and migration activities across on-premises and Azure platforms
Monitor database health, performance, storage and availability and take proactive action to prevent issues
Perform backup, recovery, restoration and disaster recovery support for business-critical databases
Troubleshoot database issues and optimize performance through tuning, indexing, query analysis and configuration improvements
Support high availability and disaster recovery solutions for SQL Server environments
Ensure database security, user access management and compliance with operational and security standards
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, cloud and application support teams to resolve issues and support new initiatives
Automate routine database administration tasks where appropriate
Support production releases, environment readiness and operational transitions
Maintain technical documentation, standards, support procedures and runbooks
Participate in incident management, root cause analysis and continuous improvement efforts
What you will need to have
4 to 10 years of experience in SQL Server database administration
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server in production environments
Hands-on experience with Azure, including Azure SQL Database, Azure virtual machines or other Azure data services
Experience in database backup and recovery, performance tuning, security and monitoring
Strong knowledge of SQL Server installation, configuration, patching and upgrade processes
Experience supporting high availability and disaster recovery configurations
Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills
Experience working in cross-functional support and delivery environments
Good verbal and written communication skills
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, work and military experience
What would be great to have
Experience with Snowflake
Familiarity with Azure automation, scripting or infrastructure support
Experience with PowerShell or other scripting tools
Knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps or infrastructure-as-code practices
Experience in financial services, payments or other regulated environments
Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and alerting tools

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Mandatory Skills
1. Advanced Prompt Engineering.
Experience with structured outputs (JSON mode, function/tool calling) and system prompt design.
Ability to systematically test, version, and optimize prompts for quality and token efficiency.
Knowledge of prompt injection risks and mitigation techniques.
2. LLM Architecture Design
Strong understanding of transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, tokenization, and context windows.
Ability to design scalable LLM system architectures, including agents, memory, tool use, and orchestration layers.
Experience making trade-off decisions on model selection, latency, cost, and accuracy.
3. RAG System Implementation
Hands-on experience building production RAG systems end-to-end.
Proficiency with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma, Milvus, Qdrant, or pgvector.
Knowledge of embedding models, chunking strategies, hybrid search (semantic + keyword), re-ranking, and query transformation.
Experience evaluating RAG pipelines using tools like RAGAS, TruLens, or custom metrics.
4. Fine-tuning Strategy
Ability to determine when fine-tuning is the right approach compared with prompting or RAG.
Hands-on experience with PEFT techniques (LoRA, QLoRA), instruction tuning, and alignment methods (RLHF, DPO).
Experience with dataset curation, cleaning, and preparation for fine-tuning.
Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, TRL, Axolotl, or Unsloth.
5. LangChain / LlamaIndex (Advanced)
Deep, hands-on experience building complex chains, agents, and multi-step workflows.
Proficiency with LangGraph, LCEL, custom tools, retrievers, memory modules, and callbacks.
Experience with LlamaIndex indexing strategies, query engines, and data connectors.
Ability to extend frameworks with custom components when needed.
6. Multi-model Integration
Experience integrating and orchestrating multiple LLM providers and open-source models.
Ability to implement model routing, fallback mechanisms, load balancing, and cost optimization.
Exposure to multimodal models (text, image, audio, vision-language).
Familiarity with gateways and abstraction tools such as LiteLLM, OpenRouter, or similar.
7. Production Deployment
Proven experience deploying LLM applications to production at scale.
Proficiency with model serving frameworks such as vLLM, TGI, Ollama, Triton, or TensorRT-LLM.
Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including services like Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
Experience with LLMOps and observability tools such as LangSmith, MLflow, Weights & Biases, Langfuse, or Arize.
Understanding of caching, batching, quantization, rate limiting, and latency optimization.

Description:
Salesforce Omnistudio Technical Lead/Architect (FSC) Manager
Key Responsibilities
Technical Design & Solutioning
Own the creation of Technical Design Documents (TDDs) covering data models, OmniStudio components, Apex architecture, integrations, security and deployment approach.
Translate functional requirements and user stories into scalable technical solutions aligned with Salesforce and FSC best practices.
Design the Salesforce data model, including FSC standard objects such as Person Accounts, Business Accounts, Account-Account and Account-Contact Relationships, plus custom extensions.
Make "Configuration vs. Customization" decisions. Favor declarative and OmniStudio capabilities where appropriate.
Take part in solution reviews and Design Authority forums, and contribute to architecture decisions.
Development Leadership
Lead, guide and mentor a team of Salesforce developers.
Allocate work, estimate effort, and track development progress across sprints.
Conduct code reviews and enforce coding standards, design patterns, governor-limit awareness and security best practices.
Do hands-on development on complex components and act as the escalation point for technical blockers.
Define and enforce development standards, naming conventions, and reusable frameworks such as a trigger framework, error-logging framework and Integration Procedure patterns.
Delivery Ownership
Take end-to-end ownership of technical delivery: quality, timelines and scope.
Work with Project Managers on sprint planning, estimation, risk identification and mitigation.
Support SIT, UAT, performance testing, deployment and hypercare phases.
Act as the technical point of contact for client stakeholders and present designs and progress clearly.
Practice & People Development
Contribute to PwC's Salesforce practice through accelerators, reusable assets, knowledge sessions and pre-sales support such as solution estimates and RFP responses.
Coach and develop team members. Contribute to performance feedback and capability building.

Must-Have Skills
1. Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC)
Strong hands-on implementation experience with FSC (Banking, Wealth Management and/or Insurance).
Good understanding of the FSC data model, Household and Relationship management, Action Plans, Rollup-by-Lookup (RBL), Interaction Summaries and Compliant Data Sharing.
2. OmniStudio Implementation
OmniScripts: guided, multi-step user journeys with conditional logic, reusable components and custom LWC overrides.
Integration Procedures: server-side orchestration, caching, chaining, error handling and performance optimization.
Data Mappers (formerly DataRaptors): Extract, Turbo Extract, Transform and Load.
FlexCards: contextual data display and actions (highly preferred).
3. Lightning Web Components (LWC)
Build custom, reusable and performant LWCs.
Embed LWCs within OmniScripts and FlexCards.
Handle component communication, Lightning Data Service and wire adapters.
4. Business Rules Engine (BRE)
Hands-on with Decision Matrices / Lookup Tables and Expression Sets.
Implement eligibility and decisioning logic.
5. Document Generation
Experience with OmniStudio Document Generation (client-side and server-side), including template design, Data Mapper/Integration Procedure data sources, and generating PDF/DOCX outputs.
6. Salesforce Data Modelling
Design scalable data models, including object relationships, record types, and the trade-offs of master-detail vs. lookup.
7. Salesforce Design & Configuration
Strong command of declarative configuration: Flows, Validation Rules, Page Layouts, Lightning App Builder, Dynamic Forms, Approval Processes, Custom Metadata and Custom Settings.
Configure the security model: Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, Roles, Sharing Rules and Field-Level Security.
Declarative Rollup summaries (DLRS)
8. Apex Development
Expert-level Apex: Triggers (framework-based), Classes, Test Classes with strong coverage and meaningful assertions, and Exception Handling.
Real-time processing: synchronous transactions and REST/SOAP callouts.
Asynchronous and batch processing: Batch Apex, Queueable Apex (including chaining), Schedulable Apex, Future Methods and Platform Events.
Strong understanding of governor limits, bulkification and performance tuning.
9. Code Quality & Reviews
Run structured code reviews.
Use static code analysis tools such as PMD, Salesforce Code Analyzer, SonarQube or Clayton.
Enforce secure coding practices: CRUD/FLS enforcement, SOQL injection prevention and with sharing usage.
10. Team Leadership & Technical Design Ownership
Proven experience leading development teams of 515 developers.
Strong track record of authoring Technical Design Documents and owning delivery outcomes.

Description:
Job Summary
Infrastructure Engineer
Job Location: India (Bangalore)
Maersk is achieving an unprecedented transformation in the growth of our business, rethinking the way we engage with customers and partners, and how the world's trade flows across our global network. From the farm to your refrigerator, or the factory to your wardrobe, we are developing solutions in-house that meet customer needs across the whole Supply Chain E2E. Joining Maersk you will join a global leader in Container Logistics as we embark on an industry-defining digital transformation that will revolutionize trade.
You'll play a vital part in our success, helping us re-think what technology can do by using the latest technologies, and building the experience to advance your career. If you are passionate about working in an entrepreneurial environment supporting an ambitious, culturally diverse team of 3000 People within Maersk Technology - on a great transformation journey - then apply today!
The role of the Infrastructure Engineer
As an Infrastructure Engineer within our Technology Services Engineering Team, you will be a key driver and doer in a fundamental shift in how we architect and host our application estate to ensure that we can take our platform operating model to the next level. You will be an advocate to enable a composable technology foundation which will enable our Product development teams in building our digital foundation of the future to help delivering for our global customer base.
Your focus will be on both assisting in the ideation and realisation of what our next generation platform will encompass, as well as then helping our Product teams in implementing products that are aligned to this long-term Platform vision.
To realise Maersk's "One Customer Journey", a consistent and resilient platform is essential. You will be key in helping promote 'the right way' in how we utilise technology in delivering on this promise.
To help to make our next generation platform successful, we are looking for key individuals to join our Technology Services Engineering team to help shape this vision and be pivotal in transforming how we do business with customers and vendors.
As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will demonstrate the following characteristics:
You have proven background in delivering complex, high performance, highly available solutions
You are creative and come up with innovative approaches to projects and any issues that arise.
You are a "do'er". You get things done.
Sharing expertise and insight with other engineers
Currently the tech stack is not 100% fixed but we have a strong preference for commercial experience of opensource plus cloud technologies. The ideal candidate will have a background that spans development, architecture, and operations. We are looking for full stack engineers with preference for staff that can provide expert coverage over three primary areas, plus some ability across all areas.
DevOps - Github, Terraform, Ansible
Cloud - AWS, Azure, GCP
Operational System - RHEL, Windows
Hypervisor - KVM, AHV, VMWare
Database - Oracle, Microsoft SQL, PostgreSQL
Patch management - Redhat Satellite WSUS
Config management - AWX
Domain driven design experience and understand how to create composable microservices and API's
Opensource - Track record of community activity and contribution
Key Responsibilities
Execute technical, engineering practices, and engineering methodologies.
Work on our problems, building high quality, architecturally sound systems that are aligned with our business needs and help drive our platform vision forward
Execute technology roadmap with the associated release goals. Participate in POCs for new and upcoming strategic technology solutions.
Handling and automating day to day administration tasks including systems reporting and system tuning
Good understanding of programming and scripting, with the ability to create targeted, ad-hoc custom solutions to specific problems the ability to design and write larger-scale applications able to function on a large server estate
Contribute to documentation and team routines
Works in collaboration with other engineers
Representation of Maersk in external technology events and conferences.
Key Skills
Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering
5+ years of experience of engineering experience at scale
Experience with diverse operational systems both on prem (virtual and physical) and in Cloud (Azure and Google)
Develop and implement solutions using Python (or other programming language), CLI, PowerShell, GPOs
Experience in system performance analysis, tuning, and troubleshooting experience including network, system, and hardware optimization for low latency.
Experience with High Availability, clustering, failover, and load balancing
Red Hat and/or Microsoft Windows Server certification is a plus
Knowledge of programming languages, operating system principles, networking, and software development best practices.
Experience of working with offshore teams
Experience of Test-Driven Development approaches

Job Summary
Senior Engineering Manager - Technology Operational Excellence
Location: Pune/Bangalore
We are seeking an experienced Senior Engineering Manager to lead a critical portfolio within Technology Operational Excellence. This role is accountable for driving the strategy, roadmap, governance and execution across Recovery Assurance, Technology Risk Audit, Standards Assurance, Operational Excellence, and the application of automation and AI to strengthen assurance and operational outcomes.
This is not a traditional governance or reporting role. The successful candidate will operate as a strategic leader with end-to-end ownership, defining direction, building high-performing teams and influencing senior stakeholders and platform teams to deliver measurable improvements in resilience, reliability, availability, operational maturity and risk reduction. Success will be measured by the ability to drive accountability, use data to identify improvement opportunities and translate strategy into sustainable outcomes across the technology landscape.
Reporting to the Director, Technology Operational Excellence, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, setting the direction and leading delivery across your area. The Director will provide strategic alignment, guidance and challenge, while you will be accountable for developing the strategy, roadmap and operating model required to deliver the agreed outcomes.
Responsibilities Strategy Portfolio Leadership
Define and execute the strategy, roadmap, and operating model for Technology Operational Excellence capabilities.
Translate organizational objectives into measurable outcomes and improvement initiatives.
Drive prioritization across resilience, technology risk, audit, standards assurance and Operational Excellence, while working across adjacent capabilities such as Change Management to improve end-to-end operational outcomes.
Identify emerging operational risks and capability gaps and develop scalable solutions.
Provide strategic guidance and recommendations to senior technology leadership.
Recovery Assurance Resilience
Lead enterprise recovery assurance and resilience programs.
Improve recoverability of critical business and technology services by influencing platform teams to do the right testing, validation, and continuous improvement.
Drive failover, restore, and recovery exercises across cloud, SaaS, on-premise, and vendor-managed environments.
Ensure recovery risks are identified, tracked, and remediated effectively.
Technology Risk, Audit Assurance
Lead technology operational risk management, audit readiness and the sustainable remediation of audit findings.
Improve assurance through automated controls, evidence-based monitoring and policy enforcement.
Connect risks, incidents, recovery gaps, standards and control weaknesses to identify systemic issues.
Partner with the Change Management team to strengthen risk-based controls, use incident and performance insights, and support continual improvement in Change outcomes.
Contribute to the future evolution of Change Management strategy, governance and control effectiveness as the Technology Operational Excellence operating model develops.
Operational Excellence, Automation AI
Drive Operational Excellence initiatives across Technology portfolios.
Improve operational maturity, engineering standards adoption, and service reliability working with platform teams across tech.
Leverage Automation, AI, and data-driven insights to reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and enhance operational effectiveness.
Support the transition from governance through reporting to governance through automated controls and intelligence-driven decision making.
People Leadership
Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team spanning resilience, risk, audit and operational excellence.
Build leadership capability, foster accountability, and create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
Partner closely with Engineering, Platform, Cyber Security, Internal Audit, and Business stakeholders.
What We're Looking For Essential Experience
Significant leadership experience in one or more of the following areas: Technology Operations, Operational Excellence, Resilience, Technology Risk, Audit or Assurance.
Proven track record of owning complex portfolios and driving strategy through execution.
Experience defining operating models, roadmaps, and transformation initiatives.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills at senior leadership levels.
Deep understanding of operational resilience, risk management, technology controls, and modern engineering practices.
Demonstrated ability to lead teams, develop talent, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
Preferred Experience
Disaster Recovery, Recovery Assurance, or Enterprise Resilience leadership.
Technology Risk, Audit, and Control Frameworks.
SRE, Reliability Engineering, Observability, and Operational Readiness practices.
Automated controls, policy-as-code, and evidence-based assurance.
AI and Automation-led operational transformation.
Experience across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, and hybrid technology environments.
What Success Looks Like
Clear strategies and executable roadmaps across Technology Operational Excellence capabilities.
Improved resilience, recovery assurance, change success rates, and operational risk reduction.
Increased adoption of engineering and operational standards.
Greater use of automation, AI, and intelligent controls to simplify operations and strengthen assurance.
Sustainable closure of risks, control gaps, and audit findings.
A highly capable and empowered team with strong ownership and accountability.

About the Role: 
We are looking for an Associate level legal professional who can act as a trusted business advisor who works collaboratively across business, sales, and other functions and has the knowledge and experience required to take on a variety of legal assignments, such as  employment law advisory, intellectual property advisory and portfolio management, transactional support and assistance, SaaS Agreements with potential customers of Zeta, and agreements with SaaS Vendors who provide SaaS to Zeta for internal consumption or integration within Zetas SaaS Offerings. 

Responsibilities
Drafting, negotiating, managing internal and external stakeholders, as well as managing external legal advisors assisting the company on such assignments.
Provide legal advice and opinions on all legal matters that impact the business and provide innovative solutions to minimize/manage the legal risks involved with the companys business operations in various jurisdictions around the world
To communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (such as management, leadership teams, Finance, HR, Information Security etc) and external stakeholders (customers/clients, vendors, investor representatives, industry association representatives).
To constantly improve and evolve the drafts and templates created by the legal team, from learnings from each customer. Strive to simplify drafting in order to achieve quicker turn-around-times and to make legal agreements easier for non-legal stakeholders to understand.

Skills
The candidate must have an excellent grasp of laws and market practices pertaining to a variety of technology agreements such as SaaS Master Service Agreements, Professional Services Agreements, Software Development Agreements; data protection laws and issues under a contract, intellectual property and other affiliated areas. 
The candidate should have the ability to work independently and within a team as and when required and must have unimpeachable integrity, honesty and the ability to maintain strict confidentiality.
The candidate should have excellent verbal and written communication skills in order to communicate with persons across different walks of life and cultures and in order to understand business requirements and communicate the required solutions. 
Ability to explain contract risks and obligations to non-lawyers.
Attention to detail, speed, and efficiency in reviewing and drafting documents.

Experience and Qualifications
5 year BA.LLB (Hons) degree from a reputed national law university/college. (Mandatory Requirement) LLM or postgraduate degree in law from a reputed international law university specifically in the field of technology law. (Optional Requirement). 
 Post Qualification Experience: 4 years In a top tier law firm, preferably within the technology law practice of the firm or at the least some level of experience in technology contracts; and/or As an in-house counsel in a Technology Company (preferably, SaaS however Non-SaaS technology company experience will also be accepted) People with prior experience in law firms, but currently working as in-house counsel will be preferred over people with no prior law firm experience.

Description:
Senior Network Test Engineer
Experience: 5 to 10 Years
Work location: Bangalore/ Pune/ Noida

Feature & Protocol Testing: Test network routing features to ensure they work exactly as designed.
Regression Testing: Re test existing features across different software versions to find new bugs or performance drops.
L2 & L3 VPN Testing: Set up and test virtual private networks, ensuring traffic flows correctly and safely between virtual routers.
Lab Setup: Recreate real world customer networks in a lab environment using traffic generators.
Troubleshooting: Find network bugs, analyze packet captures (Wireshark), and work with developers to fix them.
Network automation: Python, Ansible, REST APIs
Technologies:
MPLS Basics: Good understanding of how MPLS works, including LDP and RSVP TE.
VPN Services: Hands on experience testing L3VPNs and L2VPNs (VPLS, VPWS, EVPN).
Routing Protocols: Strong knowledge of how BGP / MP BGP, OSPF, and IS IS build paths and neighbors.
Network Convergence: Experience testing fast failover mechanisms like BFD and FRR (Fast Reroute).
Testing Tools: Experience using hardware traffic tools like Ixia (IxNetwork) or Spirent, along with Wireshark.

Ensure adherence to agreed turnaround times to meet productivity and quality benchmarks.

Demonstrate flexibility to work in rotational shifts.
Exhibit innovation and clarity in both written and verbal communication.

Role MDM Architect
Locations – Pune | Bangalore | NCR | Hyderabad
Your Responsibilities includes, but not limited to:
Understand the technical landscape current as well as desired future state Assess the current state architecture & understand current business processes for managing Master Data Management solutions.
Assess the functional and non-functional requirements of desired future state MDM solution Prepare the to-be architecture including data ingestion, data quality rules, data model, match/merge, workflows, UI, batch integration and real-time services.
Extensive hands-on experience in installation and configuration of core Informatica MDM Hub components such as Hub console, Hub Store, Hub Server, Cleanse/Match Server and Cleanse Adaptor.
Ability to deliver full lifecycle MDM projects for clients including Data modeling, Metadata management, design and configuration of matching and merging rules, design and configuration of standardizing, cleansing and deduplication rules.
Create Design Document and data models addressing business needs for the client MDM environment - Contribute to creating reusable assets and accelerators for MDM platforms.
Will also be involved in integration/transfer of data across multiple systems, streamlining data processes and providing access to MDM data across the enterprise.
Make technology decisions related to the Client MDM environment & Interpret requirements and architect MDM solutions.
Provide subject matter expertise on data architecture and data integration implementations across various downstream system.
Coordinate with Project Managers and participate in project planning and recurring meetings.
Collaborate with other team members to review prototypes and develop iterative revisions.

Experience: 4-9 Years

Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Embedded UI Software Engineer to design and develop graphical user interfaces for embedded products. The candidate should have strong expertise in Embedded C/C++, LVGL, TouchGFX, or similar embedded GUI frameworks, along with hands-on experience in ARM-based embedded systems.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop embedded graphical user interfaces using LVGL, TouchGFX, Embedded Wizard, Qt for MCU, or similar frameworks.

Integrate UI software with embedded platform services and device drivers.
Work on ARM Cortex-M based microcontrollers (STM32, NXP, ESP32, etc.).

Support display, touch, communication, and peripheral interfaces.
Collaborate with hardware, firmware, validation, and product teams.
Participate in software testing, debugging, and product releases.

4-6 years of Embedded Software Development experience.
Strong programming skills in Embedded C/C++.
Experience with LVGL (mandatory preferred).
Hands-on experience with TouchGFX, GUIX, emWin, Embedded Wizard, Qt/QML, or similar Embedded GUI frameworks.
Experience with ARM Cortex-M platforms (STM32/NXP).
Experience in RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, QNX, VxWorks, or Embedded Linux).
Knowledge of Display Technologies, LCD/TFT Touchscreens, HMI Development.
Experience with UART, SPI, I2C, CAN communication protocols.
Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.

Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytms B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytms PA PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.

Job Summary
The OCM (Organizational Change Management) Lead Consultant is responsible for leading change management, training, and communication activities associated with enterprise-wide transformation programs, including ERP/HRIS implementations and organizational transitions.

Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement

Conduct change impact assessments and identify stakeholder groups affected by change.
Develop stakeholder maps and engagement plans to effectively manage client audiences.
Identify potential sources of resistance and implement mitigation strategies to encourage positive acceptance of change.
Build, mobilize, and manage change champion/change agent networks to accelerate adoption.
Training & Adoption

Create employee orientation and onboarding plans related to new business processes and technologies.
Collaborate with client teams and Learning & Development stakeholders to create detailed training schedules and participant plans.

Program Execution & Leadership

Adapt change strategies as organizational needs evolve.
Lead and manage large-scale OCM teams consisting of junior, mid-level, and senior consultants.
Ensure alignment of change, communication, and training activities for a seamless end-user experience.
Best Practices & Methodology

Integrate communication, training, and change interventions into a unified adoption strategy.
Recommend and implement best practices to improve transformation outcomes.

Experience
5-10 years of experience in Organizational Change Management (OCM).
Experience supporting large-scale organizational transformation programs.
Digital Transformation implementation experience is highly desirable.
Experience working with global teams, offshore (India) teams, and international client stakeholders.
Change Management Expertise
Strong understanding of organizational change principles and change adoption processes.
Experience with ADKAR methodology.
PROSCI Certification preferred.
CCMP (Certified Change Management Professional) certification is a plus.
Project & Delivery Knowledge
Understanding of software implementation lifecycles and project management methodologies, including:
SDLC
Waterfall
Agile
Core Competencies
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong decision-making skills.
Ability to work effectively with employees and leaders at all organizational levels.
Ability to drive alignment toward a common vision and business goal.
Preferred Candidate Profile
OCM Lead / Change Management Consultant with experience in ERP, HRIS, or Digital Transformation programs.
Experience leading large change initiatives in global organizations.
Skilled in stakeholder engagement, change impact assessments, communications, training strategy, and adoption management.
Comfortable managing geographically distributed teams and client-facing engagements.

Job Description

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Greenfield Site Launch & Industrialization
Lead the end-to-end Supply Chain workstream for the new plant start-up and industrialization.
Build Supply Chain processes, systems, governance and organization from a greenfield environment.
Develop the Supply Chain launch roadmap aligned with plant commissioning and production ramp-up milestones.
Define and implement planning policies, inventory strategies, warehouse processes and logistics flows.
Support New Product Introduction (NPI), industrial transfers and production readiness reviews.
Recruit, train and develop the Supply Chain team required for production launch and growth.
Establish operational KPIs, reporting cadence and governance mechanisms prior to SOP (Start of Production).
Drive launch readiness reviews and manage supply chain-related risks during ramp-up.

1. Demand Planning & S&OP
Translate customer demand, sales forecasts and program requirements into an integrated Supply Chain and Production Plan.
Lead the monthly S&OP process in coordination with Sales, Program Management, Operations, Finance and Engineering.
Identify demand-supply gaps, capacity constraints, material risks and recovery actions.
Maintain a rolling 12-18 month supply and capacity outlook.
Establish clear priorities based on customer requirements, program milestones and business objectives
Design and implement the sites S&OP / IBP process, governance and decision-making framework.
Establish demand, supply, inventory and capacity review cycles and escalation processes.
Lead executive S&OP reviews during plant launch and production ramp-up phases.

2. Production Planning & Control
Own the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and ensure alignment with available capacity, manpower, materials and customer demand.
Optimize production loading across manufacturing lines and work centers.
Ensure timely release and closure of Manufacturing Orders / Work Orders.
Monitor plan adherence and drive corrective actions for deviations.
Establish appropriate production lead times, safety stocks and planning parameters.
Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve bottlenecks and improve throughput.
Manage demand, capacity and inventory trade-off decisions during ramp-up phases.

3. Material Planning & MRP
Existing responsibilities plus:
Own the MRP process and ensure availability of materials in line with the production plan.
Monitor material shortages, long-lead items, critical components and supplier constraints.
Establish and maintain accurate ERP planning parameters including:
Lead times
Lot sizes
Safety stocks
Reorder levels
MOQ
Supplier lead times
Planning horizons
Develop material risk dashboards and provide early-warning alerts.
Drive shortage recovery plans with Procurement, Suppliers and Operations Define and deploy MRP planning policies, parameters and system governance from plant start-up through serial production.
Validate material planning assumptions, safety stock strategies and inventory buffers required for launch readiness.

4. Procurement & Supplier Management
Lead procurement planning in alignment with production and material requirements.
Ensure timely release and follow-up of Purchase Orders / Purchase Requisitions.
Monitor supplier OTD, quality, lead time and responsiveness.
Establish supplier recovery plans for critical shortages and delayed deliveries.
Identify and mitigate single-source and long-lead supplier risks.
Work with Strategic Sourcing and Quality to develop alternate sources wherever required.
Support supplier capacity assessments and supplier development initiatives.
Validate supplier capacity against projected production growth requirements.
Develop business continuity strategies for critical commodities and components.
Support supplier localization and supply base development initiatives where appropriate.

5. Inventory Management
Own factory inventory performance covering raw material, WIP and finished goods.
Establish inventory targets based on demand, lead time, criticality and customer requirements.
Drive reduction of:
Excess inventory
Obsolete inventory
Slow-moving inventory
Uncontrolled WIP

Job Description
Cloud Automation Engineer
Location: Mumbai / Noida / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai
Experience: 6+ Years
About the Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Cloud Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Azure Cloud, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automation engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, automating, and managing scalable Azure-based virtual lab environments while driving operational efficiency, reliability, and cost optimization.
Your Role
As a Cloud Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining automated Azure infrastructure solutions, reusable deployment frameworks, and environment lifecycle management capabilities. You will work closely with cloud architects, DevOps teams, and engineering stakeholders to deliver highly automated and repeatable cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Automate the creation, configuration, operation, and teardown of Azure-based virtual lab environments.
Develop reusable Terraform and/or Bicep modules for Azure infrastructure provisioning.
Automate deployment of Azure services including Virtual Networks, Subnets, NSGs, Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Private Connectivity, and Monitoring solutions.
Create and maintain reusable VM images, deployment artifacts, and infrastructure configurations.
Develop automation for building, versioning, packaging, validating, publishing, and deploying environment bundles.
Automate deployment and movement of build, topology, emulator, configuration, and test bundles across virtual machines.
Implement configuration-driven provisioning based on predefined recipes and topology definitions.
Develop scripts for environment startup, shutdown, hibernation, health checks, reset, cleanup, and teardown activities.
Build automation for resource tagging, expiration policies, orphan-resource detection, and cloud cost management.
Troubleshoot infrastructure provisioning and configuration issues to improve reliability and repeatability.
Maintain Infrastructure-as-Code repositories, deployment documentation, runbooks, and operational guides.
Required Skills Experience
7+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure Automation, DevOps, or Cloud Engineering.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud infrastructure design.
Expertise in Terraform and/or Azure Bicep for Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Experience automating Azure networking, compute, storage, security, and monitoring services.
Strong scripting experience using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
Knowledge of Azure Virtual Machine image management and environment provisioning.
Mandatory Skills
Microsoft Azure
Terraform
Azure Bicep
Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Azure Networking (VNet, Subnet, NSG)
Azure Virtual Machines
Automation Scripting (PowerShell/Python/Bash)
CI/CD Deployment Automation
Cloud Cost Optimization
Monitoring Operations

Description:
ROLE - Manager, Brand Partnerships & Alliances ( Regional)
About NoBroker Technologies Private Limited
NoBrokerHood, a part of NoBroker Technologies Pvt.Ltd. Our founders understood the need to have a tech-enabled
visitor and community management system, that aims to make life convenient, hassle-free, and secure for the
residents of a gated community. Thus, NoBrokerHood was launched. NoBrokerHood is a smart visitor, society and
accounting management system. From our start in late 2018, NoBrokerHood is currently securing 20,000+ societies
under its hood. From catering to all the society needs like complaint management, gate entry, maintenance bill
payments, digital notice board, it also has features like Marketplace, home services and more. NoBrokerHood goes
beyond visitor and gate management delivering an end-to-end community experience that empowers residents
and management committees with digital convenience, revenue growth, and future-ready innovation.
To know more about NoBrokerHood, visit our website - https://www.nobrokerhood.com/
About the role:
As a Brand Manager, your role is about generating sales and solving customers' problems with regard to
marketing/advertising. You will work as an extended marketing arm of the brands and all the actions strongly exhibit
a Customer-First approach. The primary role is to identify potential brands/companies, onboard new clients, and
ensure the retention of existing ones. In the process of onboarding and retention, you are also exposed to campaign
planning and execution based on the client's brief.
What makes this Job profile interesting?
1. Complete understanding of Sales funnel and acquisition of brands onboard.
2. Exposure to a variety of clients from different industries & categories to know their marketing spend trends
& AOP cycle.
3. Get to work with the marketing team of various companies (small, mid, and large)
Job Description:-
The role has 2 distinct areas of responsibility:


Day-to-day research of relevant brands and their marketing spending trends and marketing approach.
Relationship Management with clients or agencies regularly to know their upcoming campaigns.
You Are Expected To


Identify new brand/company basis trends, market knowledge, current advertisers
Reach out and make connections with identified brands /companies /Agencies







Understanding client's businesses, identifying their marketing problems, and collecting the marketing
campaign brief
Plan the advertising campaign basis the brief and get a go-ahead from clients to execute the advertising
campaign
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure that the campaigns are performing/executed as per the
commitment.




Coordinate with clients for smooth flow of work and reporting of ongoing advertising campaigns
Ensuring that the monthly/yearly revenue targets are being achieved with input and output criteria
Preparing Daily Task Reports
The work hours are equally split between - answering emails/calls and campaign execution & campaign
planning

Forge strong business relationships with the clients to ensure its a long-run business avenue year on year
basis.


Build a culture of high performance & innovation in the team with a paced approach
Experience and skills required
Desired Candidate Profile






Excellent communication skills in English.
Ability to change according to business requirements.
work experience of minimum 1-2 years preferred
Demonstrate a positive, can-do attitude. Willing to roll up your sleeves and get things done.
Keen interest in analysing performance data and transforming it into actionable strategies.
Keen to grow as an individual.
What we have to offer!



Working directly with the leadership team; having a high level of work independence, autonomy, and
empowerment to lead company-wide changes
Being part of a start-up from an early stage, lead your area of expertise and be a part of this exciting growth
journey of changing the real estate world
Excellent platform for learning how to build teams, achieve goals and handle high-growth situations. Ideal
for people with entrepreneurial ambitions.
Benefits




Performance Bonus
Corporate Health Insurance
Rewards & Recognition
Travel Allowance

Description:
About the Opportunity

Ericsson is looking for a Telecom Billing L2 Production Support Specialist to support billing and invoicing operations. The role involves 24x7 production support, billing-cycle monitoring, incident resolution, application troubleshooting, and coordination with technical and business stakeholders.

What You Will Do

Provide L2 production and operational support for telecom billing and invoicing systems.
Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly billing cycles, including bill generation, final billing, invoice generation, validation, archival, and downstream processing.

Troubleshoot job failures, processing delays, invoice issues, data discrepancies, and integration failures.

Analyze application logs, database records, input/output files, and job execution status to identify root cause and recovery actions.

Perform approved job restarts, reprocessing, reconciliation, recovery, and data-validation activities.

Monitor batch jobs, schedulers, FTP/SFTP transfers, and upstream/downstream interfaces.

Use SQL, application logs, files, and operational tools for issue analysis and billing-data validation.

Handle incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs and participate in critical incident support.

Coordinate with L3/L4 application, database, infrastructure, vendor, business, and other stakeholder teams.

Support approved changes, releases, and post-deployment validation.

Prepare RCA documents, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.

Identify opportunities for automation and operational improvement.

Network Implementation Engineer
Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Pune, Noida
Immediate joiners preferred

Experience: 3+ Years

Skills:
Experience: 3+ years of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically
within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or
equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field
experience),CCNP preferred.
Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.
Participation in off-hours change windows (nights and weekends) to minimize
operational disruption.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst
(9200/9300/9400/9500/9600) and ASR/ISR/Catalyst 8000,4300,1100 series
routers.
Provision Cisco Catalyst Wireless infrastructure, including 9800,5520,8500
Series Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points (APs).
Onboard devices into Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Spaces/DNAC) for
automated template deployment.
Lead scheduled, off-hours maintenance windows to perform core/distribution
cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE /
NX-OS).
Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP
neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error
monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming
parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.

Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Location- Bangalore/Noida
Role type- IC

Marketing & Pipeline Performance Intelligence
Analyze performance across campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, and ROI.
Identify trends, performance gaps, risks, and opportunities across campaigns, channels, audiences, segments, and pipeline.
Diagnose what is driving performance and where intervention is needed.
Translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
Data Science & Proactive Monitoring
Lead the design and deployment of predictive, forecasting, pacing, and anomaly-detection models to proactively monitor marketing and pipeline performance.
Build scalable early-warning capabilities that detect meaningful changes and emerging performance risks and opportunities.
Use advanced analytics to understand what changed, why it changed, and what is likely to happen next.

Measure the impact of optimization actions and incorporate learnings into future analyses and models.
AI & Analytics Automation
Apply AI and automation to accelerate monitoring, forecasting, diagnostics, and insight generation.
Automate recurring analytical processes and build scalable performance intelligence solutions.
Partner with Marketing Operations and technology teams to operationalize models and analytics.
Executive Insights
Translate complex analytics into clear, decision-ready business insights and recommendations.
Communicate what is happening, why it matters, and what action should be taken.
Provide leadership with a proactive view of the marketing and pipeline risks and opportunities that require attention.
Qualifications
8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data science, performance intelligence, or advanced analytics.
Hands-on data science experience designing, building, validating, and deploying predictive and proactive monitoring models, including forecasting and anomaly detection.
Deep understanding of B2B marketing and pipeline performance, including campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, attribution, and ROI.
Proven ability to diagnose performance drivers and translate model outputs and analytical insights into actionable marketing recommendations.
Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using AI, automation, and modern analytics platforms.
Strong business acumen, problem-solving, executive communication, and cross-functional partnership skills.
Success in This Role
Marketing identifies performance risks and opportunities earlier.
Teams understand where performance is changing, why, and what action to take.
Predictive monitoring reduces reliance on retrospective reporting.
Marketing gains greater visibility into campaign effectiveness and pipeline creation, progression, and conversion.
AI and automation enable faster, more scalable performance intelligence.
Leadership receives clear recommendations connecting marketing activity to pipeline and business outcomes.

About this opportunity
We are looking for a Storage and Backup Engineer to design, implement, and support enterprise storage and data protection solutions across on-premises and cloud environments. You will play a key role in ensuring data availability, integrity, backup reliability, and disaster recovery readiness, with a strong focus on Rubrik Backup Administration and Management.
What you will do

Administer, configure, upgrade, and maintain Rubrik CDM clusters, including networking, security, replication, archival, and cloud integrations.
Manage backup and recovery operations, monitor backup jobs, and ensure successful data protection and restoration.
Implement and test disaster recovery strategies, conduct DR drills, and support data retention and compliance requirements.
Perform storage provisioning, capacity planning, performance optimization, and system health monitoring.
Troubleshoot storage, backup, and recovery issues in critical production environments.
Collaborate with virtualization, cloud, and infrastructure teams to deliver integrated backup solutions.
Automate operational tasks using scripting tools and maintain accurate technical documentation.

You will bring

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field, with 5-7 years of experience in storage and backup administration.
Strong expertise in Rubrik Backup Administration and Management (mandatory), including Rubrik CDM architecture, cluster operations, distributed filesystem, metadata management, snapshots, and scale-out architectures .
Experience with enterprise backup technologies such as Veeam, Veritas NetBackup, or Commvault.
Good understanding of backup methodologies, disaster recovery concepts (RPO/RTO), storage management, and data protection best practices.
Familiarity with VMware, Hyper-V, Windows, Linux, networking fundamentals, and cloud backup solutions (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
Knowledge of automation and scripting tools such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and teamwork skills, with the ability to support mission-critical environments.
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification".

Experience: 2-3 Years
Location: PAN India

Job Summary
We are looking for a motivated Databricks Developer with 23 years of experience in data engineering and big data technologies. The role involves building scalable data pipelines, optimizing data workflows, and supporting analytics and business intelligence initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines using Azure Databricks/AWS Databricks.
Develop ETL/ELT processes using PySpark and Spark SQL.
Ingest, transform, and process large-scale structured and unstructured datasets.

Implement and manage Delta Lake architecture for reliable data processing.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, data analysts, and engineering teams to understand data requirements.

Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions.
Participate in code reviews and adhere to development standards.

Required Skills
2–3 years of experience in Databricks development.
Strong proficiency in PySpark and Python.
Hands-on experience with Databricks Workspace, Jobs, Notebooks, and Workflows.
Strong knowledge of Spark SQL, DataFrames, and distributed computing concepts.
Experience with Delta Lake and data lake architectures.
Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases.
Understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks and data warehousing concepts.
Experience with version control tools such as Git.
Knowledge of Linux/Unix environments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Job Description: Salesforce Application Architect Provider Network Management (PNM / Vlocity)

Role Summary
We are seeking a Salesforce Application Architect with deep expertise in Provider Network Management (PNM) within Salesforce Health Cloud, including hands on experience with Vlocity/OmniStudio. The architect will design and implement provider enrollment, credentialing, network management, and contract automation solutions using Salesforce’s PNM capabilities, which streamline provider onboarding, automate guided workflows, and leverage specialized Health Cloud PNM objects and data models.
Responsibilities
Architect end to end PNM solutions (provider enrollment, credentialing, contracts, network setup) aligned with Health Cloud PNM capabilities.
Design and extend the PNM data model using custom objects
Lead solutioning using Vlocity/OmniStudio (OmniScripts, Integration Procedures, DataRaptors).
Provide architectural guidance, ensure scalability, and adhere to Salesforce platform best practices.
Collaborate with business, provider operations, and engineering teams to deliver compliant, industry grade solutions.
Required Skills
Strong hands on experience with Salesforce Health Cloud PNM and healthcare provider lifecycle processes.
Advanced Vlocity/OmniStudio expertise.
Strong Salesforce platform architecture, data modeling, and integration skills.
Preferred certifications: Application Architect, OmniStudio, Health Cloud.
Solid understanding of healthcare payer/provider operational models.
Deep understanding of Salesforce recommended architectural practices, scalability considerations, and cross-cloud solutioning
Proficiency in API design, security, data modeling, system integrations, and event-driven architectures.
General Requirements
8-15 years IT experience with 5+ years in Salesforce.
Salesforce certifications preferred (Application Architect, OmniStudio Consultant/Developer, Health Cloud).
Strong communication skills for stakeholder management, discovery workshops, and solution presentation.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with payer systems, provider credentialing systems, or healthcare interoperability (HL7/FHIR) is a plus.
Experience implementing Provider Search, Network Adequacy, or Provider Directory solutions within Health Cloud ecosystems.
Prior work in regulated healthcare environments with compliance requirements.

About This Opportunity
Ericsson is looking for a skilled Engineer with hands-on expertise in Ericsson IN Charging Systems to support telecom operations, system integration, ICP upgrades, audits, and implementation of customer/network changes across critical IN and charging nodes.
What You Will Do
Perform integration, configuration, commissioning, and O&M activities on Ericsson Charging System nodes.
Execute ICP upgrades and CR-based configuration changes across CS nodes such as SDP, CCN, OCC, AIR, NELS, ADPLMN, and NGCRS.

Coordinate with customers, project teams, technical teams, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth implementation and delivery.

Identify opportunities for automation, operational improvement, and knowledge sharing.

Description:
Job Summary:
Coordinates documents and gathers and inputs data related to assigned administrative support duties for a team, department, function or other organizational leader/group. Performs activities under a moderate degree of supervision.
Key Responsibilities:
Provides administrative support by conducting research, preparing statistical reports and addressing routine information requests. Gathers, compiles and verifies information and enters it accurately into documents such as reports, presentations or forms; and office systems such as databases or spreadsheets. Assists with data collection, data entry and report generation on various departmental related activities. Assists with associate functions such as preparing correspondence, receiving visitors, arranging conference calls and scheduling meetings. Responds to, or redirects, routine inquiries from external or internal sources about the organization/department, its activities, or processes so callers/visitors are answered promptly and accurately. Prepares documentation for payment of vendors, suppliers and other third parties as applicable; submits documentation and enters request for payments into accounting system; responds to inquiries from accounts payable and payees. Documents and maintains departmental policies and procedures. Participates as a team member on departmental related business improvement assignments and projects as needed. Performs other routine administrative activities as needed per the established procedures of the organization and/or department.
To drive secondary sales through distributors and DSRs and engage directly with retailers, rebuilders, OEM dealers, independent workshops, institutional customers, and fleet customers. The resource will also focus on educating customers about company policies, schemes, and product benefits, maintaining accurate sales data, and ensuring timely communication of all required information to channel partners.
Competencies:
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Plans and aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Data Communication and Visualization - Constructs a tale of the business problem, root cause, solution options, and opportunities through illustrating data visually, including reports and dashboards.

Project Schedule Management - Manages the planned schedule using the recommended schedule management tools and processes to drive completion within the agreed timeline.

Adapts to target audience - Explains complex topics (significant technical data, subject matter expertise, etc. ) in such a way that the target audience (e. g. sales professionals, customers, training vendors, etc. ) can understand, retain, and use the information

Integrates Customer Perspective - Incorporates an understanding of the customers perspective on our products and sales efforts to develop sales content that improves our ability to meet their needs and increase revenue.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Requires some work experience or intermediate level knowledge obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis. Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk. Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process. Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
- Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
- Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
- Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

Monitor team performance metrics (coverage, productivity, conversion rates).
Ensure proper usage and adoption of the Superstore app among retailers.
Drive promotional campaigns and new product launches in the territory.

Provide regular sales performance reports to senior management.
Share customer feedback, demand trends, and improvement suggestions.
Maintain accurate sales data and territory records.

Description:
Essential Services : Role & Location Fungibility
At ICICI Bank, we believe in serving our customers beyond our role definition, product boundaries, and domain limitations through our philosophy of customer 360-degree. In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as One Bank, One Team. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be role and location-fungible with the understanding that Banking is an essential service. The role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

About the program
The ICICI Bank Probationary Officer Program nurtures young professionals with "Seva Bhav" - values of humility, adaptability, and a zeal to learn. Focused on relationship management, it emphasizes empathy, professionalism, and providing banking solutions to customers. The program includes extensive residential training, followed by nationwide placements in relationship management (sales) roles.
The Probationary Officer Program will prepare selected applicants for Relationship Manager (RM) job, which is a sales role. This role will involve client interactions and will require travel within and around the assigned location/city.
Selected applicants shall be placed in any location based on the requirements of the Bank and will undergo a rigorous training by ICICI Bank.

Eligibility
Education: Graduates, Engineers, Post-Graduate
Qualification: 60% and above in 10th and Graduation
Role and Location Fungibility: Applicant should be locationally mobile and willing to do sales

Program Structure
Program Duration: 2 Months Classroom Training


Selection Process
Online Aptitude Test: Once the applicants are shortlisted, the first step is to undergo an online aptitude test. It comprises of four sections (Verbal, Quantitative, Logical ability, General Awareness).
Interview (Face-to-Face): Applicants who have successfully completed the aptitude test shall be invited for the in-person interview. Interview details will be shared on your registered email ID.

Job Brief: JSW Steel Limited is seeking a highly skilled and experienced professional to lead the mechanical operations within the Pellet Plant department. This role demands a strategic and hands-on leader responsible for overseeing the maintenance, reliability, and performance of all mechanical equipment and systems in the pellet plant. The ideal candidate will drive operational excellence, ensure compliance with safety and quality standards, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to optimize plant productivity.
