Develop and implement preventive and predictive maintenance strategies to minimize downtime and extend equipment life.
Coordinate with production and quality teams to align mechanical operations with plant production goals and quality standards.
Monitor and analyze mechanical equipment performance data to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions.
Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols and regulatory compliance within the mechanical department.
Manage budgeting, procurement, and inventory control for mechanical spare parts and tools.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on mechanical efficiency, cost reduction, and process optimization.
Oversee root cause analysis of mechanical failures and lead troubleshooting efforts to prevent recurrence.
Mentor and develop mechanical engineering staff, fostering a culture of technical excellence and teamwork.
Collaborate with engineering and project teams on equipment upgrades, installations, and modifications.

Root Cause Analysis
Team Leadership and Development
Budgeting and Cost Control
Safety and Regulatory Compliance
Performance Monitoring and Data Analysis
Project Management
Process Optimization
Inventory and Spare Parts Management
Preferred Qualifications:
Bachelors degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field; a Masters degree is preferred.
Minimum of 8-10 years of progressive experience in mechanical maintenance and operations within the steel manufacturing or heavy industrial sector.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. CNC Machine Operation
Operate CNC roll-turning and machining equipment safely and efficiently as per approved operating procedures.
Carry out roll turning, dressing, grooving, machining and finishing operations as per approved roll pass drawings and machining instructions.
Select appropriate CNC programs, tools, inserts and machining parameters according to roll material and profile requirements.

2. Roll Pass Machining
Perform accurate machining of roll passes, grooves, collars, radii and other required profiles.
Ensure correct pass dimensions, groove depth, roll diameter and profile geometry as per drawing/pass schedule.
Maintain required surface finish and dimensional accuracy.

3. Roll Inspection
Inspect rolls before and after CNC machining for:
Roll diameter
Groove dimensions
Pass profile
Collar dimensions
Radius
Surface condition
Cracks/chipping and other abnormalities
Use vernier caliper, micrometer, profile gauges and other measuring instruments correctly.

4. Roll Dressing & Reconditioning
Carry out scheduled roll dressing/reconditioning to restore required pass geometry.
Ensure proper removal of worn, damaged or cracked portions before machining.
Follow defined roll-dressing frequency and tonnage-based maintenance requirements.

5. CNC Program & Parameter Control
Use approved CNC programs and ensure correct program selection for each roll/pass.
Verify tool offsets, work offsets, zero setting and machine parameters before starting machining.
Report any abnormality in CNC program, machine movement or machining parameters to the supervisor.

6. Dimensional Accuracy & Quality
Ensure machining is carried out within specified dimensional tolerances.
Verify critical pass dimensions at appropriate stages of machining.
Prevent over-machining and maintain maximum possible roll/pass life.
Ensure proper identification and traceability of each roll after machining.

7. Machine Maintenance
Carry out routine inspection of CNC machine, lubrication system, hydraulic system, coolant system, chuck/fixtures and other accessories.
Check machine condition before starting the shift.
Immediately report abnormal vibration, noise, temperature, leakage, spindle/tool issues or CNC alarms.
Maintain basic operator-level preventive maintenance activities.

8. Tool & Consumable Management
Ensure proper selection and handling of cutting tools, inserts, holders and measuring instruments.
Monitor tool wear and replace tools at appropriate intervals.
Maintain minimum required stock of critical CNC tools and consumables.

9. Safety
Follow all SPM safety procedures, PPE, LOTO and machine guarding requirements.
Ensure proper clamping and securing of rolls before machining.
Never enter the machining zone while the machine is running.
Maintain safe handling practices for heavy rolls using EOT crane/Hydra/Farana as applicable.
Report unsafe conditions, near misses and equipment abnormalities immediately.

10. Roll Identification & Traceability
Verify roll identification, grade, serial number and machining requirement before starting work.
Maintain proper records of roll diameter before/after machining.
Record machining details, pass number, tonnage, dressing quantity and final dimensions.
Ensure proper marking and storage of completed rolls.

11. Coordination with Roll Shop & Mill
Coordinate with Roll Shop, Guide Shop and SPM Operations for timely availability of rolls.
Prioritize roll machining according to the rolling schedule and upcoming section changes.
Ensure emergency roll dressing/machining requirements are attended promptly to minimize mill downtime.

12. Troubleshooting
Identify machining abnormalities such as chatter, vibration, poor surface finish, dimensional deviation, tool breakage and incorrect profile.
Take immediate corrective action within the defined operating procedure.
Escalate major machine or quality issues to the CNC Supervisor/Shift In-Charge.

13. 5S & Housekeeping
Maintain excellent housekeeping around the CNC machine and work area.
Ensure proper collection and disposal of chips, coolant and machining waste.
Keep tools, gauges and fixtures properly identified and stored.
Follow 5S standards and workplace organization practices.

14. Continuous Improvement
Participate in TPM, 5S, Kaizen and productivity-improvement initiatives.
Suggest improvements in machining cycle time, tool life, roll utilization and pass life.
Support reduction of CNC machining time and improvement of roll-shop productivity.

Required Competencies
1. Temp. above 30C .
2. Proximity to Heat, Noise & Temperature.

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, or assisting guests with loading/unloading vehicles and transporting luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated bell area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and 100 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Design, build, deploy, and support secure cloud-based applications and services that meet business and customer requirements
Develop and maintain both front-end and back-end components of modern web applications using React, TypeScript, Python, SQL, and related technologies
Build scalable APIs, integrations, and data-driven applications using modern engineering practices
Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and delivery velocity
Support the integration of AI capabilities, including LLMs, Generative AI services, AI agents, and intelligent automation features, into existing and new business applications
Contribute to the development, integration, testing, deployment, and support of AI-enabled solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent search, conversational experiences, and workflow automation capabilities
Assist with the implementation and operationalization of agentic AI solutions, including prompt engineering, tool integration, vector search, and orchestration frameworks under the guidance of senior technical leaders
Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to deliver scalable end-to-end solutions supporting reporting, analytics, dashboarding, and business process automation initiatives
Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support
Apply Agile and Lean development practices to deliver features and enhancements within established timelines and quality standards
Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and continuous improvement activities to promote engineering excellence and software quality
Build and support cloud-native solutions utilizing Azure services, including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Functions, Service Bus, and related platform capabilities
Support CI/CD automation, Infrastructure as Code initiatives, containerized deployments, and DevOps practices utilizing GitHub, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform
Troubleshoot application, integration, and performance issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions
Monitor and support production applications while meeting operational, reliability, and service-level objectives
Collaborate effectively with cross-functional and global teams to deliver business value and technical solutions
Continuously learn and apply emerging AI, cloud, and software engineering technologies to improve team effectiveness and accelerate solution delivery
Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

Graduate degree or equivalent experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field
7+ years of experience with Agile/Lean software development practices
4+ years of experience with cloud environments and architecture, preferably Azure
Experience automating CI/CD pipelines and working with source control systems such as Git and GitHub
Hands-on experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, SQL databases, and modern web application development
Hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying applications that integrate Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI services, AI agents, or intelligent automation capabilities
Solid experience developing applications and services using Python and modern API development practices
Experience building and supporting scalable, secure enterprise-grade applications using modern architecture patterns, microservices, and service-oriented architectures
Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native application deployment practices
Experience building infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform
Experience consuming and integrating AI platform capabilities such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Functions, and related Azure services
Experience participating in code reviews, technical design discussions, and engineering best practices
Familiarity with AI application patterns such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, vector databases, semantic search, conversational AI, or knowledge-grounded AI solutions
Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, AutoGen, or similar technologies

Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.

Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supervises and manages employees.

Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.

- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies

- Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.

- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.

- Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
- Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Job Title-Area Sales Head
Level-Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager
Location-Jammu SHQ
Reporting To-Product head
Supervising-Individual Contributor
Job responsibilities

1. Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve company targets.
2. Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, distributors, and their teams.
3. Identify new business opportunities and market trends to expand the company's market share.
4. Lead and motivate distributors and their teams to drive performance and meet sales objectives.
5. Analyze sales data and market insights to formulate effective sales strategies.
6. Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as marketing, product development, and customer service to ensure alignment and customer satisfaction.
7. Monitor and report on sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to senior management.
8. Provide regular training and coaching to distributor teams to enhance their skills and performance.
9. Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and conferences to promote brand awareness and generate leads.
10. Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and ethical standards in all sales activities.
Candidates profile -
Education-Preferred MBA B.tech /B.E or any Regular Graduate with 60 %
Experience-5-8 Years
Salary -Best in Industry
Personal Attributes

Excellent communication and people skills
Learning agility
Customer centricity
Strong influencing and stake holder management skills
Aptitude in problem-solving
Desire to work as a team with a result driven approach
Age-Maximum 32 Years
AboutCompany:
Havells India Limited (Havells), one of Indias largest FMEG (Fast-Moving Electrical Goods) Company & power distribution equipment manufacturer.
Havells is among the few organizations being recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified TM Organization for the fourth consecutive year. We have also been recognized among Indias Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All Top 50.
Havells owns some of the most prestigious brands like Havells, Crabtree, Lloyd, Standard, & Reo offering a wide spectrum of products, including Industrial & Domestic Circuit Protection Devices, Cables & Wires, Motors, Fans, Modular Switches, Home Appliances, Water Heaters & Air Cooler, Grooming Products, Luminaires for Domestic, Commercial and Industrial Applications. With the acquisition of Lloyd in 2017, Havells has made a foray into high-potential consumer durables segments with offerings of Air-conditioners, Televisions, Refrigerators and Washing Machines.
Our global network consists of 7000+ professionals across 35 branches and 15 plants. The company boasts of a strong manufacturing prowess with 15 state-of-the-art manufacturing plants in India located in Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana, Ghiloth, Tumkur, and Sricity. Currently over 95% of the product offering is energy efficient and manufactured in-house which makes Havells a name synonymous with excellence and expertise in the electrical industry.
Havells, over the years, has embarked on the journey of social change through inclusive growth. Serving Mid-Day Meal to over 70,000 students across 700 schools daily in the Alwar district, building over 4000 eco-friendly bio-toilets in 400 government schools, distributing over 1,90,000 reusable sanitary napkins to girls, and planting over 17 Lakh tree saplings so far, are among few of our CSR initiatives.

Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.

Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job Description:- General Trade.
1. Sales Target Achievement: Daily market visit and cover 20-25 retailers daily basis as per monthly travel plan. Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets in General Trade by expanding the distributor and retailer base.

Relationship Building: Build and maintain strong relationships with store managers, buyers, and category managers to ensure smooth operations.
Promotions & Activations: Implement promotional campaigns, in-store activations, and other initiatives to boost sales and brand awareness.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
Growth in the number of active retailers and stores.
Improvement in product visibility and brand presence in both GT and MT.
Effective distributor and store relationship management.
Read in out-of-stock issues and improvement in stock rotation.

Description:
The Team Leader - ESSCO will spearhead the sales team s efforts to position Essco as a leading brand in the value market segment. This role requires strategic oversight and hands-on management to drive revenue growth across Essco s product lines, including faucets, sanitaryware, cisterns, and H.W.S. The Team Leader will take personal ownership of key Regional Distributors (RDs), ensure effective training of the sales team, and achieve substantial dealer growth. This role is pivotal in executing market strategies, enhancing dealer performance, and leading a high-performing team to meet and exceed targets.
Key Responsibilities
Sales Team Performance: Oversee and drive the performance of the Essco sales team to meet or exceed revenue targets across all product lines: ESSCO Faucets, ESSCO Sanitaryware, ESSCO Cisterns, and ESSCO H.W.S.
Key Account Management: Take personal ownership of select top RDs, ensuring they meet their sales targets and contribute to overall revenue performance
RSD Management: Manage and coordinate with Regional Sub-Distributors (RSDs) to ensure alignment with sales strategies and optimal performance
RD Recruitment & Selection: Identify and recruit suitable Regional Distributors (RDs) in consultation with the HOD/ZH
Dealer Growth: Drive dealer growth, ensuring a minimum of 85% of the dealer universe shows measurable expansion and increased productivity
Sales Team Training: Conduct and oversee targeted training sessions for the RD/RDS sales team to enhance their skills and performance, ensuring all training goals are met
Market Development: Develop and implement strategies to expand Essco s market presence, including penetrating new markets and increasing the brand s footprint in existing areas
Performance Monitoring: Monitor and analyze sales performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions as needed
Dealer Relations: Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers to foster growth, resolve issues, and enhance dealer satisfaction
Reporting: Provide regular reports to senior management on sales performance, market trends, and team progress, including insights and recommendations for strategic adjustments
Operational Efficiency: Ensure efficient and effective execution of sales operations, including compliance with company policies, pricing strategies, and promotional activities
Brand Visibility and Hygiene: Maintain high standards of brand visibility and hygiene across all dealer showrooms and points of sale
Issue Resolution and Coordination: Address and resolve any issues related to supplies, sales policies, and customer care in coordination with the relevant departments
Market Analysis: Conduct market surveys and analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement
Inventory Management: Ensure effective inventory management and supply chain operations to meet market demands
Promotional Activities: Lead the implementation of promotional activities and marketing campaigns to boost brand visibility and sales
Dealer and Customer Pipeline: Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of potential new dealers and customers
Compliance and Ethics: Ensure compliance with company policies and ethical standards in all business operations
OC & Factory Visits: Plan and facilitate visits to Orientation Centers (OCs) and the factory for potential external customers
Supply & Sales Issue Resolution: Address and resolve issues related to supplies, sales, and customer care for dealers and specifiers
Key Attributes
Proven ability to lead and motivate a sales team to achieve and exceed targets
Strong understanding of the building materials industry
Demonstrated success in managing key accounts and driving dealer growth
Effective training and development skills with a focus on enhancing team performance
Strategic thinking with the ability to implement tactical plans for market expansion and revenue growth
Strong analytical skills for monitoring performance and identifying improvement opportunities
Competencies
Customer Focus
Negotiation Skills
Presentation Skills
Competitor Analysis and Market Development
Qualifications and Experience
Education:
Bachelor s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field
An MBA or equivalent is preferred
Experience:
10-12 years of experience in sales within the building materials industry or a related sector
3-4 years of experience in a team leadership or managerial role, with a proven track record of achieving sales targets and driving team performance
Skills:
Excellent leadership and team management skills
Strong communication and interpersonal abilities
Proficiency in strategic planning and execution
Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to drive decision-making
Effective training and mentoring skills
Proactive problem-solving attitude and adaptability
Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills

Role & responsibilities

We are hiring enthusiastic, career-oriented Freshers. This opportunity is ideal for graduates who possess excellent communication skills in English, are passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences, and are eager to build a successful career in the customer service industry.
The ideal candidate should be confident in interacting with customers over phone calls, demonstrate strong listening and problem-solving skills, and maintain a customer-first approach while always upholding professionalism. Since the role involves supporting customers from diverse regions, the ability to communicate effectively in whenever required is mandatory.
'
General Guidelines :
Registrations will be processed on a first-come, first-served basis.
Participation is limited to the first 350 eligible candidates reporting between 09:00 AM and 11:00 AM.
Personal laptops, tablets, or other electronic devices are not permitted during the interview process.
Candidates are advised to carry a mobile charger, as the assessment and interview process may continue throughout the day.
We are specifically looking for fresh graduates with outstanding communication skills and a customer-centric mindset.
Applicants must have completed their Graduation or Postgraduation. Candidates currently pursuing any degree, certification, or educational program are not eligible.
The role operates in a 24x7 work environment, primarily supporting customers across different geographies, including US customers. Candidates must be willing to work in rotational shifts and rotational week-offs.
Candidates who can join immediately are highly encouraged to apply, as immediate availability will be considered an advantage.
Candidates must bring required documents:
Two copies of their updated resume.
A valid Government-issued photo ID proof.
Original and photocopies of educational certificates and marksheets.
Eligibility Criteria:
Freshers are welcome to apply
Any Graduation except BE & BTech
0 -11 Month of experience considered only, more than 11 not suitable.
Any internship experience, customer service exposure, or BPO experience will be an added advantage.
Experience in Content Moderation will be considered a plus.
Excellent spoken English is mandatory.
Strong communication skills in English are mandatory.
Ability to read, write, understand, and communicate fluently in both English is a key requirement for this role.
Strong listening, interpersonal, and communication skills.
Ability to engage in professional and fluent customer conversations.
Customer-focused mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities.
Basic computer knowledge and a willingness to learn new processes and technologies.
Key Responsibilities:
Handle inbound and/or outbound customer calls professionally.
Communicate clearly, confidently, and effectively with customers in English, as required.
Read, comprehend, and respond accurately to customer queries, process documents, emails, and system updates in both languages.
Understand customer concerns, analyze issues, and provide timely resolutions.
Deliver high-quality customer service while ensuring customer satisfaction.
Accurately document customer interactions and update records in the system.
Candidates must possess:
Excellent verbal communication skills in English.
Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English fluently.
Strong listening and comprehension skills to effectively understand customer concerns and provide appropriate resolutions.
Ability to communicate professionally with customers across different regions and backgrounds.
Confidence in handling customer conversations, documenting interactions, and interpreting information in both languages.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
Strong command of grammar, comprehension, and professional communication in both languages.
Strong customer service orientation and customer-handling skills.
Professional attitude, positive work ethic, and customer-first mindset.
Why Join Us?
Excellent opportunity to kick-start your career in the Customer Support industry.
Comprehensive training and professional development programs.
Attractive career growth and advancement opportunities.
Dynamic, inclusive, and collaborative work environment.
Exposure to global customer interactions and industry best practices.
Opportunity to enhance communication, customer service, and problem-solving skills while working with a leading organization.

Job Responsibilities

T Support & Troubleshooting
Provide technical support for desktops, laptops, printers, and other IT devices.

Manage Microsoft 365, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, Linux, and shared drives.

IT Service Management & Administration
Handle daily ITSM activities, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management.
Manage and resolve end-user support tickets using Service Now or other ticketing tools.
Maintain IT asset inventory, software licenses, and hardware records.
Perform daily backups, data restoration, and disaster recovery support.
Coordinate with vendors for IT repairs, AMC, and technical support.
Maintain technical documentation and knowledge base records.

Backup & Disaster Recovery

Description:
Ways of Working -

Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.

About the Team -

Swiggy Dineout is building Indias largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its partner restaurants across its network for 21000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!

Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.

Role Summary -

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month.

The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities -

Account & Partner Relationship Management

Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently. Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned. Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:

Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business. Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc. Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner. Interaction with

Stakeholders:

Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies

Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV) Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate

Understanding of Conversion Funnel -

Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills -

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English

Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality

Effective communication skills

Attitude & Aptitude for Sales

Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life. Analytical, good Excel skills.

The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules

Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.

Initiative & Flexibility:

Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions. Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.

Creativity & Initiative:

Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Job Summary
We are looking for energetic and detail-oriented Operations Executives to join our team across Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Karnataka. The role involves supporting day-to-day operational activities, maintaining accurate records, handling data entry and ensuring timely completion of assigned tasks.
Key Responsibilities
Handle day-to-day operational and administrative activities.
Perform data entry and maintain accurate records and documentation.
Review and update information in internal systems.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth execution of operational activities.
Follow defined processes, guidelines and timelines.
Ensure accuracy and completeness of data and documentation.
Support the team in other operational activities as required.
Eligibility Criteria
Education: Any Graduate
Experience: Freshers are welcome; candidates with prior data entry / operations experience will be preferred.
Age: 20–34 years
Gender: Male / Female
Location: Candidates currently residing in Andhra Pradesh, Telangana or Karnataka
Good communication and basic computer skills.
Comfortable working with MS Excel and other basic office applications.
Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn.
Preferred Skills
Data Entry
MS Excel
Documentation & Record Management
Basic Computer Skills
Attention to Detail
Coordination & Follow-up
Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume.

As a professionally trained Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Description:
Purpose of the Role

The role is responsible for driving sales of vehicles through sales volumes and market share and ensuring enhancing customer engagement in the assigned territory. It involves actively managing dealer relationships & driving demand, developing new business and achieving the territory sales targets.

Job Responsibility

1. Sales Planning:
Drives sales in the specified territory for a particular product line ensuring volume sales, market share growth and enhanced customer engagement in assigned territory
Plan and conduct monthly target setting including marketing activations at the dealerships in line with forecast/ estimated TIV and sales volume for the assigned territory
Coordinate with various partners and internal teams to drive customer engagement & sales. Plan and execute monthly activations and provide the necessary support to drive effectiveness while measuring outcomes of activities conducted
Ensure monthly and annual targets to be achieved in terms of retail sales and customer satisfaction levels as per Sales & Marketing plan.
Support state product manager in the conversion of mid-to-big sized deals when needed
Drive the conversion of C4T customers with assigned dealership into Tata Motors fold
Drive sales and share of business with key accounts customers
Drive value added sales in the assigned territory and seek support from sales teams on need basis

2. Review and Execution:
Conduct sales execution meeting on a monthly basis with dealers sales representatives and sales team to monitor performance and to set future action plan
Execute dealer wise and outlet wise performance to monitor sales pipeline and deploy action plan to different territories based on performance and potential
Review and monitor MIS of the following: Volume, Market Share, Activity Report, Retail tracker, C4T list and pipeline DSE
Ensure the execute of distribution of dealership target DSE wise and Micro Market wise
Provide product wise indent to RSMs as per the agreed schedule
Capture and review market intelligence through multiple sources, including voice of customer on product/services and regulatory requirements. Explore potential white spaces due to emerging customer expectations
Review and monitor dealers inventory and ensure that it stays at optimum level through proper forecasting
Provide inputs on existing product improvements/ development of new products and variants to create differentiation in the market
Work closely with state product managers to share market intelligence about the product on regular basis

3. Financial Management:
Monitor liquidation of stock at assigned dealerships to ensure timely payment by financiers and channelling of funds back into the system
4. People Management:
Drive manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships as per TML norms
Execute trainings for dealer sales team on pre-sales & sales processes, new product features / modifications etc.
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal:
State Product Manager (Product Line), State Head
Update and seek support on sales and market share growth
Provide support, if and when necessary, in conversion of mid-to-big sized deals
Regional Sales Managers
Product, targeting setting for self and dealership, ATL activities
Regional Head SNM/ SNM Manager
Drive Manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships
Regional Head RCFI/ RCFI Manager
Ensure finance availability to dealers and customers

Desired Candidate Profile
Education : B.E/ B.Tech with relevant experience/ MBA in Sales & Marketing preferred.
Relevant Experience : 4 - 7 years.
Experience in Automobile Industry. (Commercial Vehicles)
Experience in Sales

Description:
Job Summary
The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities

Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.


Data Interpretation / Business Performance Management
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.


Interaction with Stakeholders
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.)


Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Qualifications
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

About the role

You are the first CARS24 voice a buyer hears in your city. People who find us on Google Maps, through a creator's video, or on social and listing platforms call or message in. Your job is to understand what they need, help them pick the right car, build trust in the CARS24 brand, and get them to the hub for a test drive.
Inbound lead sources:
Google Business Profile (GMB) calls and messages for the city hub
Influencer and creator campaigns (calls, WhatsApp, link and form leads)
Other platforms: website and app enquiries, social media DMs, listing and classifieds platforms, walk-in follow-ups

Key responsibilities

-Handle inbound enquiries
Answer calls, WhatsApp messages and callback requests from all lead sources quickly, ideally within 5 minutes of a lead arriving.
Call back missed calls and unattended leads the same day.
-Car discovery
Understand the customer's budget, preferred body type, fuel type, brand, model year and usage.
Recommend suitable cars from current hub and city inventory and share links, photos and prices.
Explain financing (loan) options, exchange of an old car, and the test-drive process at a high level.
-Brand discovery
Explain the CARS24 promise clearly: inspection report, fixed pricing, warranty, return policy, paperwork and RC transfer support.
Handle common objections and trust questions from first-time online car buyers.
-Visit scheduling and coordination
Book hub visits and test drives with a confirmed date and time slot.
Share hub location, timings and what documents to bring.
Send reminders before the visit and confirm on the day.
Hand over context to the hub sales team so the customer does not repeat themselves.
-Follow-up and conversion
Follow up with customers who did not show up or are undecided, and reschedule visits.
Re-engage older leads when new matching inventory arrives.
-Reporting and feedback
Log every interaction, outcome and next step in the CRM / lead sheet accurately.
Tag the lead source correctly so marketing can measure GMB and influencer performance.
Share recurring customer questions, complaints and inventory gaps with the hub and marketing teams weekly.

Description:
DBS Bank India Limited
DBS Bank has been present in India for 30 years, opening its first office in Mumbai in 1994. DBS Bank India Limited is the first among the large foreign banks in India to start operating as a wholly owned, locally incorporated subsidiary of a leading global bank. As a trusted partner, DBS provides a range of banking services for large, medium, and small enterprises and individual consumers in India, focusing on a seamless customer experience that helps them Live more, Bank less. In November 2020, Lakshmi Vilas Bank was merged with DBS Bank India Limited. DBS Bank India is now present in ~350 locations in 19 Indian states.
Position Title

Branch Relationship Manager - Growth

Job Purpose

To deliver exceptional volume and revenue performance with a primary focus on acquiring new-to-bank (NTB) DBS clients having an AUM INR 1 million through a need-based approach,” while also engaging and growing existing clients.
To drive sustained acquisition momentum through active sourcing, local market penetration, and network building, and ensure client coverage and product penetration via cross-sell and up-sell of DBS products and services.
To manage & maintain the highest customer satisfaction and service levels through proactive client engagement & relationship management, coordinating internally with DBS Service, Distribution, and Product teams.
Key Accountabilities

Primary ownership of NTB acquisition: Consistently acquire and upgrade quality clients in the branch catchment with a strong focus on sourcing new affluent clients into the Treasures segment.
Build and execute a robust acquisition pipeline through self-sourcing, referrals, branch walk-ins, local area prospecting, corporate and community engagement.
Engage with existing customers to deepen the wallet share through retention and growth of AUM.
Accountable for achieving monthly & annual volume and revenue objective, as agreed.
Ensure activation of e-Channels (I-Banking / M-Banking/ Online MF/Debit Card) and Savings Book growth for both newly acquired and existing clients.
Ensure proper implementation & execution of product strategies through effective relationship management.
Develop the client trust and loyalty for entrenched relationship with DBS through lifestyle and beyond banking propositions
Ensure optimum product mix and new- to- product clients aimed at customer level profitability and enhancing client coverage.
Drive and deliver exemplary customer service in the local market and uphold DBS service standards.
Ensure internal and regulatory compliance through strict adherence to DBS sales process, timely risk reviews and exercising due diligence while on-boarding.
Ensure exemplary service delivery of these clients by building appropriate workflows and processes incl. doorstep banking etc.
Establish DBS as the primary banker for newly acquired clients and strengthen its position as a prominent banking provider through consistent acquisition and superior service delivery.
Job Duties & responsibilities

Establish, manage and grow the AUM of mapped Client segment by acquiring and nurturing the client having AUM => INR 1 M
Ensure complete knowledge of all products & services through continuous skill and knowledge improvement.
Resolve customer queries and complaints within the agreed TAT as per the DBS customer service policy.
Coordinate and work closely with CBG colleagues, Service teams, Product specialist to ensure that team objectives are met through an environment that nurtures harmony and collaboration through teamwork
Work closely with the Line Manager and City / Cluster Head to ensure achievement of common team and Branch objectives.
Ensure internal and regulatory compliance and address operational risks if any, e.g. Health & Safety standards, security of premises, AML / KYC and ongoing risk reviews.
To exercise appropriate due diligence while on-boarding and engaging with clients.
Establish DBS as a primary banker for clients and as a prominent banking provider in India.
Required Experience

Minimum 2 years of experience in a reputed bank and proficient in banking products.
Education / Preferred Qualifications

Preferably MBA (not mandatory)
Mandatory - Graduate (10+2+3 years of education)
AMFI / IRDAI / FEDAI certified candidates with BCSBI certification would be an added advantage
Core Competencies

Strong Relationship Management and influencing skills
Strong service orientation, customer-centric behavior
Effective probing and listening skills.
Self-driven and ambitious.
Good written and verbal communication skills
Results-orientated & the ability to deliver results under pressure
In-depth knowledge of local market and competition.
Understanding of competitive positioning
Focused on developing image and goodwill of the brand
Creative, inquisitive mind with problem solving abilities
Ability to deliver results within tight timelines
Attention to details, analyzing abilities
Technical Competencies

Understanding of HNI Sales/ wealth management product suite, platforms and operational procedures
Understanding of banking and para-banking guidelines issued by RBI (local regulations in India) and local laws and regulations that impact businesses in general.
Understanding of KYC requirements & Anti-money Laundering Policies.
Knowledge of financial markets and products to assist in meaningful engagement with client
Work Relationship

Management of clients and prospects for acquisition and deepening of wallet share
Close interaction with Branch Manager, BOSH, CSO, CH, RH, Treasures RM’s and Treasures Elite Team Leader
Operations team to ensure consistent delivery of volume and revenue targets.
Close and regular interaction with Branch Product specialists for effective skill / knowledge
Development of self and explore potential in existing books through joint engagement with clients
DBS India - Culture & Behaviors

Performance through Value Based Propositions
Ensure customer focus by delighting customers & reducing complaints
Build pride and passion to protect, maintain and enhance DBS’ image and reputation
Enhance knowledge base, build skill sets & develop competencies
Execute at speed while maintaining error free operations
Maintain the highest standards of honesty and integrity
