Granulation Operator
We are seeking a skilled Granulation Operator to join our dynamic team in the operation of Fluid Bed Dryers (FBD) and Fluid Bed Processors (FBP) for pharmaceutical and related manufacturing. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and efficiency of our granulation processes, contributing to the production of high-quality pharmaceutical products. Description:
Accountable for overall success of the daily kitchen operations.
Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while leading the staff and managing all food related functions.
Works to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget.
Supervises all kitchen areas to ensure a consistent, high quality product is produced.
Responsible for guiding and developing staff including direct reports.
Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Manages kitchen shift operations and ensures compliance with all Food & Beverage policies, standards and procedures.
- Estimates daily production needs on a weekly basis and communicates production needs to kitchen personnel daily.
- Assists Executive Chef with all kitchen operations and preparation.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
- Develops, designs, or creates new applications, ideas, relationships, systems, or products, including artistic contributions.
- Assists in determining how food should be presented and creates decorative food displays.
- Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Performs all duties of kitchen managers and employees as necessary.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Operates and maintains all department equipment and reports malfunctions.
- Checks the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
Leading Kitchen Operations
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Leads shifts while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Ensures employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Recognizes success performance and produces desired results.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
Maintaining Culinary Goals
- Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Utilizes the Labor Management System to effectively schedule to business demands and for tracking of employee time and attendance.
- Trains employees in safety procedures.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, providing feedback as needed.
- Brings issues to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources as necessary.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Role: Business Development / Expansion Role OYO (Field Profile)

What is this role about?
This role is about *expanding OYOs hotel network in new and upcoming markets

You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.

This is a field-based role and requires regular travel.

What will you do in this role?

* Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
* Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
* Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
* Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
* Negotiate commercials and close property signings
* Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
* Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
* Review agreements and service levels with property owners
* Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams

How is your performance measured?

* Number of sellable rooms signed every month
* Number of rooms made live and available for booking
* Gross margin generated from signed properties

Education:
* Graduation mandatory
* MBA preferred

*Experience & Skills:*
* 1–5 years of relevant experience
* Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
* Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
* Analytical and data-driven mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
* Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
* Good Excel skills and professional email writing

Stakeholders you will work with:

Internal:
* Business Development Head
* Hub Head
* Central Team
* Operations Team
* Transformation Team
* Legal Team

External:
* Property Owners
* Real Estate Brokers

In simple words:

Your role is to find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable.

Job Summary
As a Customer Service Associate at Marks and Spencer, your main role is to assist customers, maintain store standards, and learn the basics of store operations.

Customer Service : Greet Assist Customers: Welcome customers with a friendly attitude and help them find what they need.
Understand Customer Needs : Listen to customers, understand their preferences, and recommend suitable products.
Store Standards : Visual Merchandising: Help maintain the store's appearance by following guidelines for product displays.
Proper Product Handling : Ensure products are handled carefully and organized correctly on the shelves.
Basic Operations : Learn Store Procedures: Follow company guidelines for tasks like stocking, housekeeping, and cashiering.
Assist with Cashiering : When needed, help with basic cashier duties to provide smooth service.
Growth Learning : On-the-Job Training: Take part in training sessions to improve your skills and grow within the role.

Description:
Essential Services : Role & Location Fungibility
At ICICI Bank, we believe in serving our customers beyond our role definition, product boundaries, and domain limitations through our philosophy of customer 360-degree. In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as One Bank, One Team. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be role and location-fungible with the understanding that Banking is an essential service. The role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

About the program
The ICICI Bank Probationary Officer Program nurtures young professionals with "Seva Bhav" - values of humility, adaptability, and a zeal to learn. Focused on relationship management, it emphasizes empathy, professionalism, and providing banking solutions to customers. The program includes extensive residential training, followed by nationwide placements in relationship management (sales) roles.
The Probationary Officer Program will prepare selected applicants for Relationship Manager (RM) job, which is a sales role. This role will involve client interactions and will require travel within and around the assigned location/city.
Selected applicants shall be placed in any location based on the requirements of the Bank and will undergo a rigorous training by ICICI Bank.

Eligibility
Education: Graduates, Engineers, Post-Graduate
Qualification: 60% and above in 10th and Graduation
Role and Location Fungibility: Applicant should be locationally mobile and willing to do sales

Program Structure
Program Duration: 2 Months Classroom Training


Selection Process
Online Aptitude Test: Once the applicants are shortlisted, the first step is to undergo an online aptitude test. It comprises of four sections (Verbal, Quantitative, Logical ability, General Awareness).
Interview (Face-to-Face): Applicants who have successfully completed the aptitude test shall be invited for the in-person interview. Interview details will be shared on your registered email ID.

Plan Center Meetings of customers and notify customers in advance of the schedule, ensure 100% participation of borrowers in the center meetings.

Carry out end use monitoring of loans as per the process.
Maintain healthy and cordial relationship with all potential and existing borrowers, ensure 100% compliance and good conduct on all SOPs and practices as defined in the branch operating model.
Create a daily report of tasks planned and executed and submit to Branch Manager.
Ensure recovery disposition reconciliation is done with Credit and Ops Officer as per schedule.
Ensuring critical parameters like lead to login are executed as per matrix.
Maintain centre meeting discipline, follow SOPs and code of conduct.

Quality sourcing and achieving targets as defined.
Regular collections and maintaining customers in current bucket, regularizing and normalizing delinquent customers.
Compliance on all business parameters, zero audit findings on his / her sourced customer segment / portfolio.

Description:
APM Terminals
The Warehouse Manager is responsible for overseeing daily operations of a warehouse handling direct-to-consumer distribution. This role ensures seamless order fulfillment, inventory accuracy, and efficient warehouse operations while meeting customer satisfaction goals and adhering to safety and compliance standards. The role also ensures timely sorting, grading, transformation, and distribution of products to dark stores while maintaining quality, cold chain integrity, and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities Operations Management
Oversee all warehouse operations, including receiving, storage, order picking, packing, and shipping.
Implement and optimize processes to meet daily order fulfillment goals.
Ensure timely sorting, grading, transformation, and delivery while maintaining stock availability for all dark stores.
Handle complete day-to-day warehouse operations, including cold chain management, within defined cut-off timelines while ensuring quality and SOP adherence.
Inventory Control
Maintain accurate inventory records through regular cycle counts and audits.
Manage inventory accuracy and share daily stock audit reports.
Collaborate with procurement and sales teams to forecast and manage stock levels.
Ensure timely inventory liquidation (damaged and expired) as per SOP and customer SLA.
Team Leadership
Supervise, train, and motivate warehouse staff, including pickers, packers, and inventory personnel.
Manage shift schedules to ensure adequate staffing during peak periods.
Coordinate with vendors to ensure timely availability of resources such as contract associates, security staff, and transportation.
Technology Utilization
Leverage warehouse management systems (WMS) to track inventory and orders efficiently.
Ensure staff are properly trained on WMS and other operational technology tools.
Ensure timely processing of vendor bills as per PR/PO process in SAP.
Customer Experience Vendor Management
Ensure all orders are fulfilled accurately and delivered on time to maintain high customer satisfaction.
Address and resolve any order discrepancies or operational issues promptly.
Manage relationships with third-party vendors and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are consistently met.
Review vendor invoices thoroughly to ensure accuracy in calculations, rates, and supporting documentation, verifying alignment with contracts, SLAs, or purchase orders.
Safety Compliance
Enforce adherence to safety standards and operational regulations within the warehouse.
Ensure compliance with labor laws, health standards, and cold chain handling requirements.
Reporting KPIs
Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) such as order accuracy, delivery timelines, inventory turnover, and productivity.
Ensure daily KPIs agreed with the customer are achieved and presented during daily operational reviews.
Track productivity across warehouse processes and minimize process waste to control variable costs.
Use operational data and insights to identify improvement opportunities.
Required Experience Skills
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).
Proven experience of 10+ years managing grocery or FMCG warehouse operations, preferably involving fresh produce or cold chain logistics.
Strong experience in warehouse management systems (WMS), SAP, and inventory control processes.
Demonstrated ability to manage vendor relationships and SLA-driven operations.
Strong leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication, coordination, and organizational abilities.

Office Location:

Position description: As a Commercial Manager, your main goal is to lead your team, drive sales, and manage the store's overall performance. Your key responsibilities include:

Primary Responsibilities:
1. Team Leadership:

? Build a Strong Team: Develop a motivated and high-performing team that is committed to achieving goals.

? Lead by Example: Encourage your team and create opportunities to boost sales through positive leadership.

? Manage Performance: Oversee Section Managers and store staff, offering guidance and coaching to improve performance.

2. Sales Store Operations:

? Drive Sales: Promote sales growth by analyzing trends like footfall, customer conversion rates, and average purchase value (UPT).

? Achieve Sales Targets: Ensure the store meets its sales targets and adjust strategies when needed to stay on track.

? Seasonal Planning: Make sure the store is prepared for seasonal events and has the right staffing levels in place.

3. Store Presentation Competition:

? Implement Brand Guidelines: Follow and enforce guidelines for visual merchandising (VM) and marketing to maintain the brand image.

? Stay Competitive: Keep an eye on local competitors and take steps to gain an advantage in your market.

4. Customer Experience:

? Connect with Customers: Build strong relationships with customers by understanding their needs and preferences.

? Respond to Feedback: Listen to feedback from both customers and staff, and share valuable insights with relevant departments for improvement.



5. Stock Management Operations:

? Efficient Stock Management: Ensure smooth and accurate stock processes to keep the store well-organized and prepared.

6. Staff Engagement Communication:

? Regular Briefings: Keep your team updated with regular meetings, sharing important information and recognizing their achievements.

? Employee Development: Provide timely feedback to help your team improve and conduct performance appraisals to track growth.

Description:
Job Description
Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500 cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation.
Built on the back of robust ML technology and fueled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India.
From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming a logistics hub of excellence today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
With Swiggys New Supply and the recent launches of Swiggy Instamart, Swiggy Genie, and Guiltfree, we are consistently making waves in the market, while continually growing the opportunities we offer our people.
Job Responsibilities:
Initiate partnerships with new accounts and actively manage existing relationships, being their P.O.C. for Swiggy Sustaining and growing the relationships which translates to a growth in revenue for the city
Maintaining a strong relationship with restaurant owners (Specifically Key Accounts of the City Country) and advising them on issues related to the market and offering solutions on the same
Conduct promotional events marketing activation, primarily BTL, in conjunction with the internal teams Manage the sales administration function, and operational performance reporting, streamlining processes and systems wherever possible and advising senior management on maximizing business relationships and creating an environment where customer service can flourish, also managing a huge team
Responsible for training new recruits, especially Sales Managers, and mentoring them
Desired Skill Set:
Graduate with 5-6 years of experience in Business Development, Sales or Account Management
A competent decision-maker with the ability to develop, own and build a strategic plan for ensuring the best restaurants partner with us
Effective communication skills with Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life Should be able to lead and mentor the team
Identifies builds and uses a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach
Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions. Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence for change to increase the effectiveness and success on campaigns
Creativity Initiative - demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward Qualifications
Graduate with 4-6 years of experience in Business Development, Sales or Account Management

.Role & responsibilities:
Inpatient and Outpatient Care: Conduct daily hospital rounds in general wards and Intensive Care Units (ICUs) to manage acutely or chronically ill patients.
Diagnosis and Evaluation: Diagnose conditions such as Acute Kidney Injury (AKI), Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD), Glomerulonephritis, Nephrotic Syndrome, and diabetic/hypertensive nephropathy.
Renal Procedures: Perform and supervise procedures including diagnostic kidney biopsies, temporary/permanent dialysis catheter placements, and AV fistula evaluations.
Dialysis Management: Oversee and prescribe Hemodialysis, Peritoneal Dialysis, and Continuous Renal Replacement Therapy (CRRT) for critical care patients.
Kidney Transplantation: Evaluate donors and recipients, manage pre-transplant workups, and provide long-term post-transplant immunosuppressive and medical care.

Consultations: Provide expert renal consultations to emergency, cardiology, and other hospital departments

Education: MBBS followed by an MD/DNB in General Medicine, culminating in a super-specialty DM (Nephrology) degree (or equivalent Fellowship/DNB Nephrology).
Licensure: Valid state medical council registration and active board certification/specialty recognition.
Skills: High-level clinical decision-making, procedural competency (biopsies, dialysis access), emergency resuscitation skills for severe electrolyte/acid-base crises, and patient/family communication.

Job Title: Project Manager - Civil Engineering


Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of high-rise and commercial building projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in civil engineering, excellent leadership skills, and a proven track record of managing complex construction projects from inception to completion.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Planning: Develop detailed project plans, including scope, timelines, budgets, and resource allocation.
Execution: Lead the execution of construction activities, ensuring adherence to project specifications, safety standards, and quality control.
Team Management: Supervise and coordinate the activities of project teams, including engineers, architects, and subcontractors.
Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, stakeholders, and regulatory bodies, providing regular updates on project status.
Risk Management: Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize project delays and cost overruns.
Budget Management: Monitor project budgets, ensuring financial accountability and adherence to cost estimates.
Quality Assurance: Ensure that all work meets industry standards and complies with local regulations and building codes.
Documentation: Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including contracts, change orders, and progress reports.

Qualifications:

Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering or a related field.
years of experience in project management within the construction industry, specifically with high-rise and commercial buildings.
Proven experience with project management software and tools.
Strong understanding of construction methods, materials, and legal regulations.
Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Professional certification (e.g., PMP, LEED) is a plus.

Benefits:

Competitive salary and performance bonuses.
Health, dental, and retirement benefits.
Opportunities for professional development and training.

The SFC Hub Manager is accountable for end-to-end operational performance of an individual Surface Hub, ensuring timely, accurate and cost-efficient movement of shipments across inbound, processing, sorting, staging and outbound linehaul operations. Description:
About us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the team:
QR & Soundbox is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.

Expectations/ Requirements:
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role:
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Description:
About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent -> Reduce attrition

Organisational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
Job Description
A Sales Advisor is responsible for delivering the best customer experience that contributes to the store s sales and profit. As a Sales Advisor, you ll always put customers first, offer assistance, and share your product and fashion knowledge. You ll create an environment that is easy for customers to shop through store operations and great garment care. You will also share your knowledge and skills with your colleagues, offering help where needed to build positive working environment.
Key Responsibilities
Provide great customer experience.
Fold, hang, display and merchandise garments to maximise selling opportunities.
Actively process, stock and replenish garments on the sales floor and in the stock room.
Open, unpack and label merchandise with security tags.
Support customer purchases and returns in the register. Qualifications
To be successful in the role as Sales Advisor, we believe you are a team player with a proactive and helpful approach, fostering collaboration and collective success. You have a positive mindset, where you are eager, optimistic and motivated when interacting with colleagues and customers. We also believe you are flexible and able to adjust to changing circumstances and customer needs, and that you can take initiatives and independently in a quick and effective way address customers needs. In addition, you are communicative and socially confident, fostering a positive interaction with colleagues and customers.
What you need to succeed:
Previous experience within retail, merchandising and/or customer service.
Effective time management - being stress-resistant and good at prioritisation.
Have a customer service mindset where you always prioritise the customers needs while serving as a brand ambassador.
Being fashion knowledgeable and have a genuine interest in fashion trends.
Have a selling mindset with the ability to approach and fulfil customer needs.

Working at the heart of a fast-paced fashion business, a Visual Merchandiser will create an environment that inspires customers to explore their personal style. A multi-tasker who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment with an eye for detail, who puts creativity inclusivity together.
1-2+ years of transferrable experience welcome
Ability to stand for long periods of time, bend, stretch, engage in repetitive motions, push, pull and carry items (mannequins, clothing, totes, torsos, etc.) for a short distance
Must be able to work with hand and power operated tools (Iron, Steamer, etc) and lift in order to execute display setups
Must be able to work a flexible work schedule, including nights, weekends and support other stores

Description:
Senior Resident Paediatrics

Role Overview
The Senior Resident Paediatrics is a full-time, post-MD/DNB clinical and academic tenure position at a leading university-run super speciality teaching hospital and medical college integrating compassionate care, advanced medicine, teaching and research. The role delivers round-the-clock paediatric and neonatal care across the wards, emergency, NICU, PICU and outpatient services, while supporting the training of undergraduate and postgraduate medical students. The Senior Resident reports to the Head of the Department of Paediatrics through the assigned unit faculty and supervises Junior Residents, interns and nursing teams on duty. It is a tenure position of up to 3 years under National Medical Commission (NMC) norms, suited to a qualified paediatrician seeking clinical depth alongside teaching and research exposure.

Work Mode
Work mode: work from hospital (fully on-site), with working days per hospital/NMC norms, including duty, on-call and emergency rosters as assigned by the department. No travel requirement has been specified for this role.

Key Responsibilities
Provide first-line senior clinical care to neonates, infants, children and adolescents admitted to paediatric wards, NICU and PICU, including daily rounds and clinical decision-making.
Assess, stabilise and manage paediatric and neonatal emergencies, including resuscitation, shock, respiratory distress, seizures, sepsis and poisoning.
Lead neonatal resuscitation at high-risk deliveries and caesarean sections in coordination with the obstetrics team.
Perform and supervise essential procedures such as endotracheal intubation, umbilical and peripheral vascular access, lumbar puncture, intraosseous access and surfactant administration, as clinically indicated.
Initiate and monitor respiratory support, including oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation, under faculty guidance.
Conduct paediatric outpatient and specialty clinics, including growth and development assessment, nutrition counselling, well-baby care and follow-up of high-risk newborns.
Implement immunisation services in line with the national immunisation schedule and Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) recommendations, including counselling of parents.
Take on-call and emergency duties as per the departmental roster, ensuring timely handover and continuity of care across shifts.
Teach and mentor MBBS students, interns and Junior Residents through bedside teaching, case presentations, skills sessions and assessments under competency-based medical education.
Maintain accurate, timely and legally sound medical records, including admission notes, progress notes, consent, discharge summaries and death certification.
Communicate clearly and compassionately with parents and families on diagnosis, prognosis and treatment plans, including breaking difficult news and obtaining informed consent.
Adhere to infection control, antimicrobial stewardship, patient safety and quality protocols, and participate in clinical audits and mortality and morbidity reviews.
Participate in departmental academic activities and clinical research, including journal clubs, seminars, case reports and approved research projects.
Coordinate with paediatric surgery, obstetrics, radiology, laboratory and other super speciality teams for multidisciplinary care and timely referrals.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a medical college recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
MD (Paediatrics) or DNB (Paediatrics) from an NMC-recognised medical college or an NBEMS-accredited institution, completed with results declared by the date of joining.
Valid registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, with the postgraduate qualification registered or eligible for registration.
Age below 45 years at initial appointment, as per prevailing NMC norms for Senior Residents in broad specialties.

Required Experience
Experience range: 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB paediatric clinical experience. Freshly qualified MD/DNB Paediatrics doctors are eligible to apply.
Relevant experience: postgraduate residency in Paediatrics with substantial rotations in NICU, PICU, paediatric emergency and general paediatric wards in a tertiary care or teaching hospital.
Preferred experience: prior work as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in Paediatrics in a medical college, teaching hospital or multi-specialty tertiary care hospital.
Industry preference: medical colleges, university teaching hospitals, super speciality hospitals and high-volume tertiary paediatric or neonatal care centres.

Technical and Functional Skills
Neonatal resuscitation and stabilisation in line with Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) and National Neonatology Forum (NNF) guidelines.
Paediatric emergency and critical care management in line with Paediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) principles, including airway, breathing and circulation support.
Working knowledge of respiratory support: oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation.
Procedural competence: intubation, umbilical venous and arterial catheterisation, intraosseous access, lumbar puncture, surfactant administration and exchange transfusion.
Fluid, electrolyte and nutritional management, including parenteral nutrition in neonates and critically ill children.
Management of neonatal jaundice, prematurity, sepsis, respiratory distress, malnutrition, diarrhoeal disease and common infectious diseases of childhood.
Interpretation of blood gases, laboratory results and paediatric and neonatal imaging.
Growth monitoring, developmental assessment, immunisation practice and preventive paediatrics.
Clinical documentation on hospital information systems or electronic medical records, and adherence to evidence-based IAP and NNF protocols.
Bedside teaching and assessment methods under competency-based medical education.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Compassionate, family-centred communication with children and parents, including counselling under stress and breaking difficult news.
Composure, sound judgement and rapid decision-making during emergencies and night duties.
Team leadership on duty, guiding Junior Residents, interns and nursing staff with clarity and respect.
Collaboration with faculty, nursing, allied health and other clinical departments.
Strong professional ethics, integrity, patient confidentiality and respect for child rights and safeguarding.
Teaching aptitude, patience and a willingness to mentor learners.
Time management, reliability on rosters and accountability for patient outcomes.
Cultural sensitivity and the ability to communicate with patients from diverse linguistic and social backgrounds.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Valid NRP, PALS and Basic Life Support (BLS) certifications.
Fellowship or certificate training in Neonatology, Paediatric Critical Care or a related paediatric subspecialty.
Publications, case reports or conference presentations in Paediatrics or Neonatology.
Completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research and exposure to medical education workshops.
Membership of the Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) or National Neonatology Forum (NNF).
Exposure to hospital quality, accreditation and patient safety programmes.

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate has completed MD or DNB Paediatrics at a reputed NMC-recognised medical college or NBEMS-accredited hospital with a high patient load, and has trained across neonatal, paediatric intensive care, emergency and general paediatric services. Candidates with 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB experience as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in recognised teaching hospitals or reputed tertiary care centres are preferred, as are those with a stable, verifiable work record. The role suits doctors building a career in academic paediatrics or preparing for super-speciality training, as Senior Resident experience in a recognised teaching institution is relevant to NMC eligibility norms for teaching faculty positions.

Compensation and Benefits
Compensation is offered as a competitive annual CTC (Total Cost to Company) in Indian Rupees (), commensurate with qualification, experience and institutional norms. Benefits follow institutional policy and are shared with shortlisted candidates at the offer stage. The role offers structured clinical exposure across neonatal and paediatric critical care, protected involvement in teaching and research, and the experience of working in a super speciality academic environment.

Application Instructions
Send your resume, mentioning the role "Senior Resident – Paediatrics", via email to careers@execvera.com, or by LinkedIn message, or by WhatsApp message to 9071197415. Include copies of your MBBS and MD/DNB certificates, your medical registration, a summary of NICU and PICU exposure, and your current notice period. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete the screening questionnaire and appear for an interview.

Role Overview
The Senior Resident General Surgery is a full-time, post-MS/DNB clinical and academic position in the Department of General Surgery of a leading super speciality teaching hospital and medical college run by a renowned university. The role combines hands-on operative surgery, round-the-clock emergency and trauma care, ward and outpatient management, and structured teaching of undergraduate and postgraduate students. The Senior Resident reports to the Head of Department and works under the supervision of Professors, Associate Professors and Assistant Professors, while supervising Junior Residents, interns and the unit's clinical team. The position bridges postgraduate training and an independent teaching-faculty career, building the Senior Residency experience recognised under National Medical Commission (NMC) regulations.

Work Mode
Work from hospital (on-site at the teaching hospital), duty days per NMC norms, including rostered on-call, night and emergency duties; no regular travel is expected.

Key Responsibilities
Perform elective general surgical procedures as primary surgeon or first assistant, including hernia repair, appendicectomy, cholecystectomy, and breast, thyroid and soft-tissue surgery, with consultant supervision as appropriate.
Manage acute surgical emergencies and polytrauma, including resuscitation, primary and secondary survey, emergency laparotomy and timely escalation to consultants.
Conduct surgical outpatient clinics, evaluating new and follow-up patients and planning investigations, conservative treatment or surgery.
Lead daily ward rounds, preoperative assessment and optimisation, and postoperative care, with early recognition and management of complications.
Obtain valid, documented informed consent and counsel patients and families on diagnosis, procedure, risks and expected outcomes.
Perform and assist in laparoscopic procedures, such as diagnostic laparoscopy, laparoscopic appendicectomy and laparoscopic cholecystectomy, progressively building minimal access skills.
Carry out bedside and minor procedures, including incision and drainage, biopsies, chest tube insertion, central venous access and suprapubic catheterisation.
Teach and assess MBBS students and postgraduate residents through bedside clinics, lectures, case presentations, skills-lab sessions and competency-based medical education (CBME) activities.
Supervise and mentor Junior Residents and interns, overseeing clinical decisions, handovers, duty rosters and logbook entries.
Maintain accurate and timely case records, operative notes, discharge summaries and medico-legal documentation in the hospital information system.
Apply and promote patient safety, infection prevention and control, the WHO Surgical Safety Checklist, antimicrobial stewardship and accreditation standards.
Coordinate with anaesthesia, critical care, radiology, pathology and other specialities for multidisciplinary care of complex surgical patients.
Contribute to clinical audits, morbidity and mortality meetings, journal clubs, research projects and publications of the department.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from an institution recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
MS (General Surgery) from an NMC-recognised institution, or DNB (General Surgery) awarded by the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS), recognised as per prevailing NMC regulations.
Permanent registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, and eligibility to register with the Sikkim Medical Council.
Age within the NMC upper limit for Senior Residents in broad specialities, currently 45 years.

Required Experience
Experience range: 03 years of post-MS/DNB experience in General Surgery; freshly qualified MS/DNB General Surgery graduates are eligible. Preferred: 1–3 years as Senior Resident, Registrar or Specialist in General Surgery at an NMC-recognised medical college or a tertiary-care multispeciality hospital. Relevant experience includes a documented operative logbook with procedures performed as primary surgeon, independent first-line management of surgical emergencies and trauma, and exposure to undergraduate teaching. Experience in high-volume emergency surgical services is valued.

Technical and Functional Skills
Open general surgery: inguinal and ventral hernia repair, appendicectomy, breast and thyroid surgery, excision of soft-tissue swellings and wound management.
Emergency surgery: laparotomy for perforation, obstruction and abdominal trauma, bowel resection and anastomosis, and stoma creation.
Minimal access surgery at basic to intermediate level: safe port placement, diagnostic laparoscopy, and laparoscopic appendicectomy and cholecystectomy.
Trauma care aligned with ATLS principles, including primary and secondary survey and bedside FAST interpretation.
Perioperative care: fluid and electrolyte balance, surgical nutrition, sepsis management, thromboprophylaxis and pain control.
Interpretation of ultrasound, CT, MRI and laboratory investigations for surgical decision-making.
Working knowledge of infection prevention and control, biomedical waste management, medico-legal procedures and hospital information systems.
CBME-based teaching, logbook supervision and formative assessment of students and residents.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Sound clinical judgement and composure under pressure; clear, empathetic communication with patients and families, including breaking difficult news; teamwork and leadership within the surgical unit; commitment to teaching and mentoring; ethical, professional conduct with medico-legal awareness; disciplined time management across clinical, academic and on-call duties; resilience during demanding rosters; and respect for a culturally diverse patient population.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
ATLS or an equivalent trauma course, and current BLS/ACLS certification; FMAS, FIAGES or other structured laparoscopic training; completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (BCBR) and Basic Course in Medical Education (BCME); MRCS or FRCS examination progress; membership of the Association of Surgeons of India (ASI); thesis-based or indexed-journal publications and conference presentations; prior teaching experience in a medical college; and the ability to communicate in Hindi, with working knowledge of Nepali an advantage.

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate trained at an NMC-recognised medical college or an NBEMS-accredited teaching hospital with substantial elective and emergency surgical volumes, and shows a consistent academic record through MBBS and MS/DNB. Prior Senior Resident, Registrar or Specialist tenure at a reputed government or private medical college or a tertiary-care hospital strengthens the application. The career trajectory should point towards academic surgery or a teaching-faculty role, with stable tenures and verifiable references.

Compensation and Benefits
Compensation is competitive and aligned with the candidate's qualifications, experience and institutional norms for Senior Residents. The role offers broad elective, emergency and teaching exposure in an academic setting. Leave, academic support and any other benefits follow institutional policy and NMC norms, and will be detailed at the offer stage.

Application Instructions
Send your updated resume, mentioning the role "Senior Resident – General Surgery", by email to careers@execvera.com, LinkedIn message, or WhatsApp message to 9071197415. Include your MBBS and MS/DNB details, medical council registration number, a summary of your operative logbook, current employer and notice period in days, current and expected annual CTC in , and any certifications or publications. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview and document verification.

POSITION SUMMARY
The Senior Resident in the Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT) at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim, is a pivotal training and operational role for postgraduate-qualified doctors seeking structured hands-on experience in forensic medical practice within a university teaching hospital. The incumbent will contribute to undergraduate MBBS teaching, forensic laboratory operations, mortuary supervision, and medico-legal documentation under the guidance of senior faculty. This role serves as a critical stepping stone toward an academic career as Assistant Professor, fulfilling the NMC-mandated Senior Resident experience requirement in a recognized medical institution.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures and tutorial classes in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology as assigned by the Head of Department.
Conduct undergraduate clinical classes, practical demonstrations, and case-based learning sessions for MBBS students and interns.
Assist senior faculty in postgraduate teaching activities including seminars, journal clubs, and case presentations.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required to ensure uninterrupted academic programme delivery.

B. Clinical & Forensic Responsibilities
Collect, record, and maintain accurate patient and case information in accordance with institutional and medico-legal documentation standards.
Assist in forensic laboratory activities including collection of forensic samples such as viscera, blood, and tissues for toxicological analysis.
Ensure proper preservation and timely dispatch of forensic samples for toxicology analysis, adhering to institutional and legal protocols.
Maintain strict chain of custody for all forensic evidence ensuring proper labelling, packaging, documentation, and secure transfer at every stage.
Supervise mortuary operations and enforce safety protocols including infection control, documentation standards, and dignified handling procedures.
Assist in medico-legal autopsy procedures under the supervision of faculty, including documentation of findings.
Support preparation of medico-legal certificates, injury reports, and other forensic documentation as required.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required, ensuring continuity of clinical and forensic operations.

C. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Maintain meticulous records of all forensic cases, samples, and medico-legal proceedings handled by the department.
Participate in departmental quality improvement initiatives and NABH compliance activities.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME) programmes, workshops, and departmental academic activities.
Complete the NMC-mandated Basic Course in Biomedical Research within the stipulated timeframe.
Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the Head of Department or senior faculty.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MD / MS / DNB in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (or equivalent recognized qualification) from a permitted/recognized medical college or institution, as per NMC guidelines.
Regulatory & Compliance Requirements
Valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission is mandatory.
Appointment must comply with current NMC guidelines for Senior Resident positions in recognized medical institutions.
Must complete or be willing to complete the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (NMC-mandated) during the tenure.
Preference for candidates seeking to fulfill NMC-recognized SR experience for future Assistant Professor eligibility.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES

Chain of custody maintenance
Mortuary supervision & safety
Post-mortem assistance & documentation
Medico-legal record keeping

NMC regulatory awareness
Medical documentation & reporting

Biomedical research basics

Interpersonal & Soft Skills

Strong verbal & written communication
Detail-oriented & organized
Ethical & professional conduct
Team collaboration skills
Composure in forensic environments

Role: Consultant Nephrologist

Organization Overview
This position is with a nationally accredited, 500-bed, multi-super speciality teaching hospital located in a major regional capital city. Established decades ago, the facility stands as the primary healthcare landmark for the Northeast region, housed in a nine-storied structure with over 300,000 square feet of floor space. The institution is academically affiliated with a prominent, decades-old University renowned for excellence in medical education and healthcare.

The hospital is equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure, including 13 general specialities, multiple super-speciality departments, and 12 dedicated operation theatres. It provides comprehensive 24x7 services, including a fully equipped trauma care unit and advanced diagnostic imaging featuring 1.5 Tesla MRI, 64-slice CT scan, and digital X-ray facilities. Critical care capabilities are extensive, supported by 46 well-equipped ICU beds (covering ICU, SICU, NICU, PICU, CCU, and ITU) and round-the-clock emergency services.

Role Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Nephrologist to join our team as a Clinical Practitioner. The successful candidate will manage the diagnosis and treatment of kidney-related diseases, providing expert care to inpatients and outpatients. While the role is primarily clinical and does not require an extensive academic portfolio, the institution places a high priority on candidates who possess relevant work experience within recognized university or medical college hospital settings.

Key Responsibilities
Clinical Management: Provide comprehensive clinical care for patients with acute and chronic kidney diseases, electrolyte imbalances, hypertension, and other renal disorders.

Experience: 1 to 4 years of experience post-completion of the super specialization (D.M.) / M.Ch Nephrology.

Compensation

Description:
Role Overview
The Assistant Professor - General Surgery is an early-career faculty and clinical role combining undergraduate teaching, supervised postgraduate training, patient care, operative practice, academic contribution, and departmental service. The position reports to the Head of the Department of Surgery and supports safe, evidence-informed surgical care across outpatient, inpatient, emergency, and operation-theatre settings. A NABH-accredited tertiary teaching hospital integrating patient care, undergraduate education, postgraduate training, research, and multidisciplinary surgical services. The appointee is expected to model professional conduct, strengthen learner competence, contribute to service continuity, and accept responsibilities assigned within the scope of General Surgery.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver structured undergraduate lectures, tutorials, demonstrations, and case-based sessions aligned with the approved curriculum and departmental teaching plan.
Conduct undergraduate clinical classes using bedside, outpatient, ward, skills-laboratory, and discussion-based methods while protecting patient dignity and consent.
Assess learner progress through appropriate formative and summative activities, provide actionable feedback, and maintain accurate academic records as assigned.
Manage scheduled outpatient consultations by obtaining focused histories, examining patients, planning investigations, documenting decisions, and arranging follow-up or admission when indicated.
Evaluate inpatients admitted under the assigned unit, review clinical progress, coordinate treatment plans, and respond promptly to referrals from other departments.
Attend emergency surgical patients during rostered on-call periods, support timely stabilization and escalation, and document assessment, consent, treatment, and handover decisions.
Perform and assist surgical procedures within demonstrated competence, granted privileges, institutional protocols, and the supervision arrangements applicable to the case.
Attend assigned operation-theatre schedules, complete preoperative preparation, participate in operative decision-making, and ensure appropriate postoperative review and continuity of care.
Supervise postgraduate trainees in theatre and clinical areas, matching responsibility to competence while maintaining patient safety and accountable faculty oversight.
Coordinate multidisciplinary care with anaesthesia, critical care, radiology, pathology, nursing, rehabilitation, and other specialties when patient needs require collaborative management.
Maintain complete, timely, and confidential clinical documentation and follow applicable requirements for infection prevention, surgical safety, quality assurance, ethics, and incident reporting.
Cover the defined duties of other Assistant Professors during approved leave, subject to departmental rosters, clinical competence, workload, and safe service arrangements.
Develop accurate public-education articles on surgical health topics for approved media channels, using evidence-based language and appropriate institutional review processes.
Undertake other academic, clinical, administrative, research, quality-improvement, and departmental responsibilities assigned by the Head of Surgery within the role's lawful scope.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a medical institution recognised for registration and practice in India.
MS in General Surgery or DNB in General Surgery from a recognised awarding body, with equivalence documentation where applicable.
Eligibility for appointment as Assistant Professor under the Medical Institutions (Qualifications of Faculty) Regulations, 2025 and subsequent applicable NMC directions.
Current, valid registration with the National Medical Commission or the relevant State Medical Council, with no unresolved restriction affecting the proposed duties.
Documentary evidence supporting qualifications, registration, experience, appointments, relieving dates, and the specific NMC eligibility pathway claimed.

Required Experience
Minimum experience: The candidate must meet an applicable NMC Assistant Professor pathway. Under the standard pathway, this includes 1 year as Senior Resident in General Surgery in a recognised medical institution after the relevant postgraduate qualification. Candidates relying on another permitted pathway must provide complete evidence satisfying the conditions attached to that pathway; institutional verification remains mandatory.
Relevant experience must demonstrate active General Surgery work across outpatient assessment, inpatient management, interdepartmental referrals, emergency or on-call coverage, operative participation, postoperative care, clinical documentation, and undergraduate teaching. Experience should be supported by verifiable appointment, tenure, duty, and experience records rather than self-description alone.
Preferred experience: Documented clinical teaching, resident supervision, research, audit, patient-safety work, or quality improvement beyond the regulatory minimum will strengthen suitability but does not replace mandatory NMC eligibility.

Technical and Functional Skills
General surgical assessment, differential diagnosis, risk stratification, investigation planning, perioperative decision-making, and evidence-informed patient management.
Outpatient, inpatient, referral, emergency, on-call, preoperative, intraoperative, postoperative, and discharge-care workflows relevant to General Surgery.
Operative assisting and operating capability appropriate to training, recent experience, documented competence, supervision level, and institutional clinical privileges.
Safe surgery practices covering consent, identification, checklist compliance, antibiotic stewardship, blood-product awareness, infection prevention, and structured handover.
Undergraduate curriculum delivery, clinical demonstration, bedside teaching, case discussion, learner assessment, feedback, and maintenance of academic documentation.
Postgraduate supervision that calibrates delegation to trainee competence and preserves direct faculty accountability for patient care and escalation.
Interpretation and application of relevant clinical records, laboratory results, imaging reports, pathology findings, and multidisciplinary recommendations.
Use of electronic or computerised medical records, presentation software, online academic resources, and routine departmental communication systems.
Clinical audit, research ethics, literature appraisal, scientific writing, public health communication, and preparation of accurate surgical education material.
Working knowledge of NMC faculty eligibility, medical education expectations, institutional policies, ethical practice, confidentiality, and professional documentation.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Clear, respectful communication with patients, families, learners, colleagues, and multidisciplinary teams, including difficult conversations and safe handovers.
Professional judgement, integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and willingness to disclose uncertainty or seek senior support when required.
Calm prioritisation during emergencies, changing theatre demands, competing clinical responsibilities, and on-call escalation.
Patient-centred empathy and culturally respectful behaviour without compromising clinical standards, consent, safety, or documentation.
Teaching presence that encourages questions, corrects errors constructively, and differentiates supervision according to learner competence.
Reliability, punctuality, collegiality, adaptability, and readiness to provide approved cross-coverage within safe workload limits.
Commitment to continuous learning, reflective practice, audit, research, quality improvement, and feedback-driven professional development.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Completed recognised training in medical education, biomedical research, research methodology, clinical audit, or evidence-based medicine.
Peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, surgical audits, teaching innovations, or verified contributions to public surgical education.
Experience in a tertiary-care teaching environment managing diverse elective and emergency General Surgery presentations.
Demonstrated participation in surgical safety, morbidity and mortality review, infection prevention, antimicrobial stewardship, or accreditation activities.
Readiness to complete faculty-development or research courses within the timelines required by the applicable NMC pathway or institutional policy.

Professional Tenure and Background
An appropriate background includes a documented progression from MBBS and recognised postgraduate General Surgery training into Senior Residency or another valid NMC pathway, followed by increasingly accountable clinical, teaching, and operative duties. Appointment and experience records should clearly identify institution, department, designation, dates, employment status, bed-strength or recognition evidence when relevant, and responsibilities supporting eligibility.
Experience in recognised medical institutions, teaching hospitals, or appropriately documented government-hospital pathways is valued because it supports verifiable exposure to structured education, governance, multidisciplinary care, and clinical accountability. Selection will be based on regulatory eligibility, evidence of competence, role relevance, and verified accomplishments rather than employer prestige alone.

Compensation and Benefits
The selected candidate will receive competitive, role-aligned remuneration and benefits in accordance with institutional policy, verified credentials, experience, responsibilities, and the final terms of appointment. Exact financial terms will be communicated through the formal selection process.

Application Instructions
Submit an updated resume with the role title, MBBS and postgraduate qualification details, registration status, complete employment chronology, Senior Residency or alternate-pathway evidence, teaching and operative experience, publications or audits, and current contact details. Candidates may apply through email, LinkedIn message, or WhatsApp using the contact information stated in the LinkedIn outreach post. Shortlisting and appointment remain subject to document verification, NMC eligibility review, reference checks, and institutional selection requirements.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title Assistant Professor

Department Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy

Reporting To Professor / Head of the Department

Location Northeast India

Institution Type Premier 500-bed NABH-Accredited Multi-Super

Speciality Teaching Hospital,

Employment Type Full-Time | Teaching Faculty

Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant

POSITION SUMMARY
The Assistant Professor in the Department of Dermatology, Venereology, and Leprosy will serve as a key teaching and clinical faculty member at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim. The role requires a committed medical professional capable of delivering quality undergraduate medical education while managing a robust clinical workload across OPD, IPD, emergency, and Operation Theatre settings. The incumbent will also contribute to research and publication activities as mandated by the National Medical Commission (NMC). This is an entry-level faculty appointment with strong scope for academic growth within the institution.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures and clinical classes in Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy as per university curriculum.
Conduct bedside clinical demonstrations, practical sessions, and case-based discussions for MBBS students and interns.
Participate in departmental seminars, journal clubs, and academic activities to foster a learning environment.
Assist in evaluation and assessment of undergraduate students including internal and university examinations.
Cover duties of other Assistant Professors when required to ensure continuity of academic programmes.

B. Clinical Responsibilities
Attend and manage Outpatient Department (OPD) patients during assigned slots, ensuring evidence-based clinical care.
Provide comprehensive inpatient (IPD) dermatology care manage cases admitted under the unit and attend to inpatient referrals from other departments.
Diagnose and manage common skin diseases, sexually transmitted infections, and leprosy cases.
Attend to emergency dermatology patients during assigned on-call duties.
Participate in scheduled Operation Theatre duties perform and oversee procedures and assist postgraduate trainees.
Maintain accurate clinical documentation and comply with hospital protocols, NABH standards, and patient safety requirements.

C. Research & Publications
Publish research articles in indexed journals as per current NMC requirements.
Submit articles and medical commentary to professional media on a regular basis.
Assist senior faculty and postgraduate students in ongoing research projects, data collection, and analysis.
Complete the NMC-mandated Basic Course in Biomedical Research within the stipulated timeframe if not already completed.

D. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Assist the Head of Department in routine departmental administrative tasks and planning.
Participate in hospital quality improvement initiatives and NABH accreditation activities.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME) programmes and professional development activities.
Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the HOD or institutional authorities.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MD / MS / DNB in Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy from a recognized institution.

Teaching / Clinical Experience (as per NMC Regulations)

Candidates must meet one of the following experience criteria:
(a) One year as Senior Resident in Dermatology at a recognized medical institution; OR
Note: Tutor experience in a medical institution (with PG degree) is considered equivalent to Senior Resident experience; OR
(b) Armed Forces Specialist Medical Officer with at least 1 year teaching experience OR 2 years clinical experience post-PG qualification in the relevant specialty; OR
(c) Non-teaching Consultant / Specialist / Medical Officer with a PG medical degree and at least 2 years of experience in a Government hospital of at least 220 beds (Basic Course in Biomedical Research must be completed within 2 years of appointment); OR
(d) Diploma holders appointed as Senior Residents in a recognized medical institution before 08.06.2017, with total 4 years of SR experience; OR
(e) Diploma holders working as Specialist / Medical Officer in a government medical institution (NMC-recognised teaching programme) with cumulative 6 years of experience.

Regulatory Compliance
Valid registration with State Medical Council or National Medical Commission is mandatory.
Must complete the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (NMC-mandated) if not already completed.
Preference will be given to candidates with prior teaching hospital experience in a recognized university-affiliated institution.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES

Clinical Expertise
Skin disease OPD & IPD management
STI & Venereology clinical care
Leprosy diagnosis & MDT management
Dermatosurgical procedures
Emergency dermatology on-call
Inpatient referral consultation
Academic & Research
• UG MBBS lecture & clinical teaching
Bedside teaching & case discussion
NMC compliance & regulation
Research publication in indexed journals
Biomedical research basics
Academic examination participation
Interpersonal & Soft Skills
• Excellent interpersonal skills
Strong verbal & written communication
Team collaboration & coordination
Responsible & organized approach
Patient-centric care mindset
Adaptability in teaching hospital
