Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.

Must have skills :Microsoft Power Business Intelligence (PBI)

Good to have skills:NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification:15 years full time education

Senior Smartsheet & Power BI Developer
The Senior Smartsheet & Power BI Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing enterprise-wide Smartsheet solutions and Power BI analytics platforms to automate workflows, improve collaboration, enhance project/program management, and deliver actionable business insights. This role focuses on building executive-grade dashboards and reports, integrating Smartsheet with Power BI, and enabling data-driven decision-making through advanced reporting, automation, and system integrations.
Key

Roles & Responsibilities
Smartsheet Solution Development & Automation
Design, develop, and maintain scalable Smartsheet solutions utilizing Sheets, Workspaces, Reports, Forms, Dashboards, Dynamic Views, WorkApps, Pivot App, Functions, and Advanced Formulas.
Create automated workflows for approvals, notifications, reminders, status updates, and data validations using Smartsheet Automation.
Develop cross-sheet references and rollup solutions to consolidate project, program, and portfolio data into centralized views.
Build and optimize enterprise-wide project tracking, resource management, governance, and operational reporting solutions.
Configure Dynamic Views and WorkApps to deliver role-based access and personalized user experiences.
Design and implement governance standards, templates, and best practices for Smartsheet adoption.
Power BI Development & Analytics
Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and reports for executive leadership and business stakeholders.
Develop complex data models, DAX measures, KPIs, scorecards, and drill-through analytics using Power BI.
Create executive-level visualizations for project health, resource utilization, financial metrics, operational performance, and program governance.
Develop and optimize Power BI datasets, semantic models, and reporting frameworks for enterprise-scale analytics.
Implement Row-Level Security (RLS), workspace governance, and data refresh strategies.
Smartsheet - Power BI Integration
Integrate Smartsheet data with Power BI using native connectors, APIs, dataflows, and ETL pipelines.
Design automated data ingestion processes to combine Smartsheet data with enterprise systems such as SharePoint, SQL Server, Azure, Salesforce, and other business applications.
Build consolidated reporting solutions that provide a single source of truth across multiple business functions.
Develop data transformation and cleansing processes using Power Query, Power BI Dataflows, and ETL tools.
Integrations & Technical Enablement
Develop integrations using Smartsheet REST APIs, webhooks, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, and middleware platforms.
Connect Smartsheet with Microsoft ecosystem tools including SharePoint, Teams, Power Platform, Outlook, and Excel.
Support implementation of third-party connectors and integrations with enterprise applications such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Jira, and other operational systems.
Troubleshoot and optimize dashboard performance, data refreshes, data models, and workflow automations.
Required Skills
Smartsheet:
Sheets, Workspaces, Reports, Dashboards
Forms and Data Collection
Workflows and Automation
Dynamic View
Pivot App
WorkApps
Resource & Project Tracking Solutions
Smartsheet Control Center (Preferred)
VLOOKUP
INDEX/MATCH
COUNTIF / COUNTIFS
SUMIFS
Cross-Sheet References
Nested IF Statements
Date Functions
Lookup and Rollup Logic
Power BI:
Dashboard & Report Development
Data Modeling
DAX Measures and Calculations
Power Query (M Language)
Dataflows
Row-Level Security (RLS)
Performance Optimization
Workspace Administration
Semantic Models and KPI Reporting
Stakeholder Engagement & Governance
Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable reporting and automation solutions.
Provide technical guidance and best practices for Smartsheet and Power BI adoption.
Conduct solution reviews, user training, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Maintain technical documentation, governance standards, and solution architecture artifacts
Shift B Support: Availability to provide support until 11 AM PST.
Return to Office: Mandatory 5-day RTO from 4 strategic office locations. (Chennai, Coimbatore, Hyderabad and Bangalore).

15 years full time education

Role: Sr. Gen AI / Agentic AI Architect
Location: Chennai, Hyderabad, Indore

We are seeking a highly experienced GenAI & Agentic AI Architect with strong hands-on expertise to lead the design, development, and implementation of advanced AI solutions for our clients. This role requires a seasoned technical leader with over 8 years of architecture experience and deep knowledge of Azure and/or AWS cloud ecosystems, combined with strong capabilities in containerization, orchestration, observability, and modern AI frameworks.
You will play a critical role in shaping next-generation AI systems, leveraging Generative AI and Agentic AI paradigms to build scalable, intelligent, and action-oriented solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Architect and develop scalable, high-performance Generative AI solutions on Azure/AWS/ GCP platforms
Design, build, and manage containerized AI applications using Docker and orchestrate deployments via Kubernetes
Establish and maintain observability frameworks for LLMs, including performance monitoring, system health, and usage analytics
Develop and implement machine learning models using Python or R, leveraging frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn
Build and deploy AI/ML solutions using cloud-native services such as AWS SageMaker, Azure AI, or Google Vertex AI
Design and implement multi-agent systems and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures
Define and enforce standards for prompt engineering, vector search, and model orchestration
Build and manage enterprise-grade MLOps pipelines covering model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise products and platforms
Lead system optimization, performance tuning, and troubleshooting of AI-driven applications
Establish best practices for secure, scalable, and maintainable AI architectures
Mentor and guide AI engineering teams on emerging technologies and implementation best practices
Stay current with advancements in Generative AI, Agentic AI, and cloud technologies
Required Skills & Qualifications
Minimum 8+ years of experience in a technical architecture role
Proven expertise in Azure and/or AWS cloud architectures
Strong hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes
Proficiency in Python or R with experience in TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn
Deep knowledge of MLOps practices and model deployment on AWS SageMaker, Azure AI, or Google Vertex AI
Experience with multi-agent orchestration and RAG architectures
Solid understanding of prompt engineering, vector search, and LLM observability frameworks
Experience with Spring Boot and microservices architecture
Strong understanding of enterprise AI security, scalability, and governance principles

Job Title:
Trainer Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AI/ML)
Dr. Reddy's Foundation Centre for Future Ready Skilling and Innovation

Department
Future Ready Skilling and Innovation Program Duration
90 Days (Residential / Centre-Based) Employment Type
Full-Time / Contract Target Participants
Unemployed Graduates (Entry-Level Skilling)
Reports To Centre Manager
Location Indore
About Dr. Reddys Foundation

Dr. Reddys Foundation (DRF) is a not-for-profit organisation with over 30 years of experience in the skill development sector across India. Our flagship initiatives equip unemployed youth with job-ready competencies and connect them to meaningful entry-level employment across industries. As the skilling landscape rapidly evolves, DRF is expanding its portfolio to include future-ready Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning programs helping young Indians thrive in a technology-driven economy.
Role Purpose

The Trainer will anchor and deliver the 90-day Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AI/ML) program designed for unemployed graduates. The role combines sound technical knowledge of AI/ML concepts, data handling, model development, and practical AI applications with the ability to make complex concepts accessible to first-time learners. The Trainer will be responsible for end-to-end curriculum delivery, hands-on lab and project facilitation, learner progress assessment, and ensuring that every participant exits the program with practical, employment-ready skills.
Key Responsibilities

Training Delivery
Deliver the full 90-day AI/ML curriculum across modules with clarity, energy, and learner-centred pedagogy
Facilitate hands-on practice sessions using Python, Jupyter Notebook/Google Colab, Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch, and relevant AI/ML tools
Adapt instructional approaches to the varying technical backgrounds of graduate-level participants with little or no prior AI exposure
Conduct live demonstrations, coding walkthroughs, model-building exercises, and real-world AI/ML use-case simulations during sessions
Maintain a structured daily session plan aligned to the program timeline and learning outcomes


Learner Engagement & AssessmentMonitor individual and cohort-level progress through formative checks, quizzes, and project reviews
Provide timely, actionable feedback on assignments, datasets, Python code, ML models, and project outputs built by participants
¢ Identify at-risk learners early and deploy remedial support or differentiated instruction as needed
¢ Foster a psychologically safe and inclusive classroom environment, especially for first-generation tech learners
¢ Guide participants through end-to-end AI/ML capstone projects: problem identification, data collection/cleaning, exploratory analysis, model selection, evaluation, deployment/demo, and documentation
Curriculum & Content
¢ Review and refine module content, exercises, and assessments prior to each cohort rollout
¢ Develop supplementary learning resources (cheat sheets, coding notebooks, video guides, datasets, and practice exercises) to support self-paced revision
¢ Keep content current by integrating the latest developments in AI/ML techniques, frameworks, tools, and platforms
¢ Collaborate with the curriculum team and Program Manager to incorporate participant feedback and improve future batches
Industry Alignment & Placement Support
¢ Contextualize learning through real-world AI/ML use cases relevant to entry-level roles in IT, analytics, business operations, healthcare, retail, and other sectors
¢ Support the placement team by preparing participants with relevant AI/ML portfolio projects, GitHub repositories, model demonstrations, and project documentation
¢ Participate in employer engagement sessions and demo days to showcase cohort outcomes
Reporting & Coordination
¢ Maintain accurate attendance, assessment, and progress records for every participant
¢ Submit weekly session reports and flag concerns to the Program Manager
¢ Coordinate with the operations and logistics team to ensure equipment, internet access, and software licences are ready for each session
Qualifications & Experience

Minimum Qualifications
¢ Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
¢ 24 years of hands-on experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, data analytics, or software development
¢ Prior experience in training, teaching, or facilitation of technical content (even informally or voluntarily)
¢ Demonstrable ability to build, train, evaluate, and demonstrate machine learning models using Python and relevant ML libraries
¢ Proficiency in Python programming, data manipulation, and AI/ML model development
Preferred Qualifications
¢ Prior experience training learners from non-technical or first-generation graduate backgrounds
¢ Certification in relevant areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Python, or cloud AI platforms
¢ Exposure to Development Sector / NGO / social enterprise environments
¢ Experience facilitating project-based learning and guiding capstone or portfolio projects
¢ Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and digital assessment tools


Technical Skills Required

Candidates must be able to teach and demonstrate practical usage of the following tools and concepts:

CategoryTools / AreasProficiency LevelAI & ML FundamentalsAI concepts, supervised/unsupervised learning, model lifecycle, responsible AIWorking proficiencyProgrammingPython, functions, data structures, libraries, debuggingIntermediate to AdvancedData AnalysisNumPy, Pandas, data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, visualization (Matplotlib/Seaborn)Intermediate to AdvancedMachine Learningscikit-learn, regression, classification, clustering, feature engineering, model evaluationIntermediate to AdvancedDeep LearningNeural networks, TensorFlow or PyTorch, basic NLP and computer vision conceptsWorking proficiencyGenerative AILLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG basics, AI application developmentWorking proficiencyTools & PlatformsJupyter Notebook, Google Colab, GitHub, VS Code, basic command lineIntermediate
Competencies & Personal Attributes

¢ Exceptional ability to simplify complex AI/ML and technical concepts for non-technical learners
¢ High learner empathy patient, encouraging, and sensitive to the socio-economic backgrounds of participants
¢ Strong spoken and written communication in English; proficiency in Hindi or a regional language is an advantage
¢ Proactive curiosity to stay current in the fast-moving AI/ML landscape
¢ Structured, self-driven work style with ability to manage a full training day independently
¢ Collaborative mindset for working within a mission-driven, cross-functional team
¢ Commitment to DRFs mission of equitable access to quality skilling for underserved youth
What We Offer

¢ An opportunity to directly impact the employability of hundreds of young graduates across India
¢ Competitive compensation commensurate with experience and sector norms
¢ Access to relevant AI/ML tools, learning subscriptions, and continuous professional development support
¢ A collaborative, mission-driven environment with a 30-year legacy in skill development
¢ Opportunity to contribute to curriculum design and shape the future of DRFs AI/ML skilling portfolio.

Experience in maintaining and supporting enterprise-level software environments.
The candidate should have minimum 2 years of experience in Microsoft 365.
This position is based at our Indore office.

Description:
Entry level management position that is responsible for leading and assisting with the successful completion of daily shift requirements.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Strives to ensure guest and employee satisfaction and achieve the operating budget.
Assists in completing ficial and administrative responsibilities.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supports all day-to-day operations.
- Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Coaches, counsels and encourages employees.
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Supports all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Front Desk Manager.
- Guides daily Front Desk shift operations.
- Communicates performance expectations to employees in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
Monitoring and Supporting Progress Toward Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Participates in department meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Trains staff on adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and property occupancy.
- Understands the impact of Front Desk operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
- Handles guest problems and complaints seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implementing the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Ensures employees have the proper supplies and uniforms.
- Assists in the use of a guest information tracking system to ensure that a successful repeat guest recognition program is in use to recognize guest preferences and aid in problem resolution.
Supporting Handling of Human Resource Activities
- Identifying the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Providing guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Provides feedback to individuals based on observation of service behaviors.
- Participates in an ongoing employee recognition program.
- Conducts training when appropriate.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updating the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Understands the functions of the Bell Staff, Switchboard and Concierge/Guest Services operations.
- Complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Function - Sales - General Trade

About the role
As the custodian of Nestl business in the assigned territory, you will own sales delivery end-to-end - ensuring product availability across relevant channels, planning and achieving monthly/annual targets, building distribution capability, strengthening trade relationships, executing activations/visibility programs, and coordinating cross-functionally to meet overall sales objectives. You will report to the Area Sales Manager and be accountable for timely feedback and the execution of all operational programs in your area.

Job Description (Key Responsibilities)
Plan and achieve monthly and yearly sales targets; set monthly/quarterly/yearly targets for each distributor in the region.
Ensure product availability at all relevant channels through the distributor sales force per company guidelines, drive redistribution value and volume targets.
Build and enhance trade relations; drive continuous market development and addition of new outlets for wider coverage.
Own distribution setup and secondary sales force deployment; extend support for implementation of all activities through the secondary sales network.
Implement all trade/consumer activations and merchandising (visibility) programs with timely, quality feedback as per guidelines.
Ensure distributors compliance with roles and responsibilities; develop each distributor profitably and execute sales/discount/trading terms as determined by the company.
Monitor and minimize bad-goods returns; track deliveries from distributors to customers and ensure effective market coverage.
Monitor distributor overheads and profitability (ROI); build strong business relationships with distributors, trade, and key accounts in assigned territories.
Produce accurate and timely market intelligence reports (competitor activity, price changes, promotional support) and coordinate communication between the team and distributor management.
Lead people process for the secondary sales force - performance evaluations, training, and cost optimization - while complying with all company policies, instructions, and directives.

Qualifications
Strong communication skills with poise and confidence.
Analytical approach; flexible, resourceful, and innovative mindset to solve on-ground challenges.
Proven experience in FMCG/channel sales covering distributor handling, market coverage expansion, and trade relationship management.

Description:
Picture yourself brightening someones day. When you join our Hotels team, thats exactly what youll do every time you come to work. As a Food & Beverage Attendant, youll play an essential role in delivering friendly, attentive, and efficient service across our dining outlets.
Whether welcoming guests, taking orders, serving food and beverages, or ensuring the outlet is ready for service, youll help create experiences that make every stay special.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Previous experience in food and beverage, hospitality, or customer service is preferred.
A passion for delivering friendly and attentive guest service.
Basic knowledge of food and beverage service procedures.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.
Positive, team-oriented, and adaptable approach.
Well-presented, reliable, and committed to maintaining high service standards.
Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays when required.
Ability to stand for extended periods and perform the physical requirements of the role.
Heres what youll do during a typical day:
Deliver warm and attentive service: Welcome guests, take orders accurately, serve food and beverages, and respond promptly to guest requests.
Create memorable guest experiences: Build positive relationships with guests, anticipate their needs, and handle feedback professionally.
Maintain service excellence: Follow Hiltons service standards and ensure food and beverages are presented and delivered to the highest quality.
Support smooth outlet operations: Assist with table setup, clearing, resetting, cleaning, and preparing the outlet before, during, and after service.
Work effectively as a team: Coordinate closely with colleagues, supervisors, kitchen teams, and other departments to ensure seamless service.
Support revenue and efficiency: Promote menu items and special offers where appropriate, process orders accurately, and minimize wastage.
Uphold health and safety standards: Follow food safety, hygiene, sanitation, alcohol awareness, and workplace safety procedures at all times.
Develop your skills: Participate in training and continuously build your knowledge of menus, service techniques, and hospitality standards.

Description:
Role: Business Development / Expansion Role OYO (Field Profile)

What is this role about?
This role is about *expanding OYO’s hotel network in new and upcoming markets

You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.

This is a field-based role and requires regular travel.

What will you do in this role?

* Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
* Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
* Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
* Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
* Negotiate commercials and close property signings
* Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
* Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
* Review agreements and service levels with property owners
* Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams

How is your performance measured?

* Number of sellable rooms signed every month
* Number of rooms made live and available for booking
* Gross margin generated from signed properties

Education:
* Graduation mandatory
* MBA preferred

*Experience & Skills:*
* 1–5 years of relevant experience
* Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
* Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
* Analytical and data-driven mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
* Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
* Good Excel skills and professional email writing

Stakeholders you will work with:

Internal:
* Business Development Head
* Hub Head
* Central Team
* Operations Team
* Transformation Team
* Legal Team

External:
* Property Owners
* Real Estate Brokers

In simple words:
Your role is to find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable.

About us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team:
QR & Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements:
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role:
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us:
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our peoples collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification:
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive

Position Overview
The/Nudge Institute is partnering with the Tripura Rural Livelihood Mission (TRLM), Rural Development Department, Government of Tripura, to promote the adoption of the Graduation Approach (Economic Inclusion Program) for supporting extremely vulnerable households in achieving sustainable and dignified livelihoods. As part of this partnership, a State Project Management Unit (SPMU) has been established at TRLM to support the Government of Tripura in designing and implementing the Tripura - Samaveshi Aajeevika Yojana (TR-SAY) Chief Ministers Nabadisha Abhijan (CM-NDA). This position will be based in Tripura and will report to the Program Lead.


Responsibilities
Own the implementation and outcomes of the program
Provide leadership and managerial support to the field team, mainly to the Block professionals.
Manage Block professionals to ensure quality implementation on the ground through regular meetings and field visits
Develop process and system for onboarding and capacity building of Block professionals
Develop process and system for regular monitoring and cont. feedback
Work closely with The/Nudge's financial unit to develop budgets and ensure timely and effective of such budget
Work closely with the SRLM in developing the annual budget and preparing financial plans
Support TRLM in the research and development of a strategy and program design to target the extremely vulnerable families through the graduation approach built on top of community institutions enabled by the DAY-NRLM
Support TRLM in the implementation of action research of the graduation approach through a special project based on the strategy and design developed in consultation with key stakeholders
Enable convergence of various state initiatives (social security, livelihood promotion, financial inclusion, social empowerment) and programs towards the end goal of graduating women and their households living in extreme poverty.
Support TRLM to review the progress of the program periodically in order to iterate and scale
Support the mission on the use of data and technology to ensure continuous flow of data from the field
Build relationships with key government stakeholders in Tripura such that the special project is successful
Build relationships with key government departments and support the successful adoption of strategies targeting the extremely vulnerable


What's in it for you
Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including LD wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

Description:
About the role
We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead strategic engagements with government and ecosystem stakeholders across education, skilling, vocational education and others. The role will involve working closely with senior government officials to understand priorities, identify system-level opportunities, design and drive high-impact interventions, and translate evidence into actionable policy and program decisions.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of government systems, excellent stakeholder management skills, strategic problem-solving capabilities, and a strong bias for execution. They should be comfortable operating at the intersection of government, technology, data and social impact, and be able to move seamlessly between strategic discussions with senior bureaucrats and ground-level implementation.

Key Responsibilities
1. Government engagement & strategic partnerships
Build and manage trusted relationships with senior government officials across education, skilling, and other adjacent domains.
Engage with senior bureaucrats and department leadership to understand priorities, decision cycles, institutional constraints and emerging opportunities.
Represent the organisation in strategic discussions with state and central government departments, Sector Skill Councils, industry bodies, employers and other ecosystem stakeholders.
Act as a strategic thought partner to government stakeholders, bringing evidence, insights and practical recommendations to support policy and program decisions.
Identify opportunities to align organisational interventions with government priorities, schemes, budgets and existing institutional structures.
2. Strategy, policy & program design
Lead the design and execution of large-scale education and skilling programs in partnership with government, private sector and philanthropy.
Analyse government policies, schemes, budgets and implementation frameworks to identify opportunities for convergence, optimisation and system-level innovation.
Develop strategies and program models that address challenges across education, skilling, employability, placement and workforce outcomes.
Drive evidence-backed policy advocacy and support government stakeholders in translating insights into actionable reforms.
Work with leadership to develop proposals, partnership models and new program opportunities across states, central government and thematic areas.
3. Data, research & evidence
Translate large and complex datasets into actionable insights for government decision-makers and organisational leadership.
Develop analytical frameworks, policy briefs, dashboards, visual reports and presentations that enable real-time decision-making.
Lead research and ecosystem assessments to understand implementation bottlenecks, user needs and opportunities for reform.
Build evidence bases around outcomes such as learning, skilling, employability, placement, wages and workforce participation.
Use data and field evidence to identify course corrections and strengthen program design and implementation.
4. Program execution & impact
Own delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programs from strategy and design through implementation and scale-up.
Work closely with internal teams across product, technology, analytics, training and program delivery to ensure timely and integrated execution.
Monitor program milestones, risks, dependencies and impact indicators, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks.
Lead impact articulation through clear measurement, reporting and documentation frameworks.
Ensure that learnings from implementation are systematically captured and translated into improvements in program strategy and delivery.
5. Field engagement & implementation intelligence
Conduct regular field visits to understand implementation realities, frontline needs and stakeholder experiences.
Engage with teachers, trainers, students, administrators, employers and other actors to gather ground-level intelligence.
Bring field insights into policy discussions, program design and strategic decision-making.
Identify gaps between policy intent and implementation and develop practical recommendations to address them.
6. Communication & thought leadership
Develop compelling narratives, presentations and communication materials that connect field evidence, policy priorities and program outcomes.
Communicate complex insights clearly to senior government and internal leadership.
Publish articles, reports and thought pieces that showcase organisational learning and insights from the education and skilling ecosystem.
Represent the organisation in relevant forums, conferences and ecosystem discussions.
7. Growth & ecosystem development
Identify and shape new opportunities across state government departments and relevant thematic areas.

1. Position Details
Designation: Sales Officer
Location: South Tripura
Department: Trade Sales
Reporting To: ASM/TSM
Salary Range: As per market standards
Experience: 23 years in Sales / Channel Management
Qualification: Graduation (MBA / Marketing preferred)
2. Role Purpose
The Executive – Sales is responsible for driving business growth in the territory by managing dealer and sub-dealer networks, achieving sales and collection targets, strengthening market presence, and ensuring effective execution of company strategies.
3. Key Deliverables / Responsibilities
Manage and expand channel distribution
Appoint, develop, and monitor dealers and authorized sub-dealers
Achieve assigned primary and secondary sales targets
Ensure availability of products and correct market pricing
Execute brand-building and promotional activities at local level
Conduct mason/contractor meets and provide technical support
Ensure timely collection and healthy fund flow from dealers
Track competitor activity and provide market intelligence
Maintain accurate sales reports, MIS, and forecasts
4. Key Result Areas (KRA) & Key Performance Indicators (KPI)
KRA 1: Sales Target Achievement
Monthly, quarterly, and annual volume & value target achievement
Growth in secondary sales and repeat business
KRA 2: Channel Development
Appointment of new dealers and sub-dealers
Improvement in dealer productivity and coverage
KRA 3: Market Development & Visibility
Increased market share in Sivasagar region
Execution of branding, visibility, and promotional activities
KRA 4: Collection & Credit Control
Timely collection as per credit norms
Reduction of overdue and outstanding balances
KRA 5: Compliance & Reporting
Adherence to company pricing, schemes, and SOPs
Timely reporting of sales, collections, and market feedback
5. Roadmap of Success
0–3 Months
Understand company products, pricing, and sales processes
Map Sivasagar market, dealer base, and competitor landscape
Build strong relationships with dealers and influencers
3–6 Months
Achieve minimum 85–90% of assigned sales targets
Expand sub-dealer network in uncovered areas
Improve product visibility and secondary sales
6–12 Months
Consistently achieve or exceed targets
Strengthen dealer loyalty and market share
Become a key contributor to regional business growth
AboutCompany: We are driven by not just our core business of producing superior quality cement, but also the desire to create a positive impact in peoples lives, as well as the environment. Hence, along with world-class labs for quality control, we have a built-in, self-regulating mechanism to encourage a positive impact on the environment, employees, local communities and stakeholders. Sustainability initiatives form a major part of our corporate social responsibility policy and strive to improve living conditions in surrounding areas.

Key Responsibilities

Plan, execute, and monitor solar EPC projects, including rooftop and ground-mounted solar installations, from project initiation to commissioning and handover.

Strong leadership, client coordination, problem-solving, and team management skills.

Key Responsibilities
Counsel students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education and admission opportunities.
Understand each student s academic background, qualifications, interests, preferences, and educational objectives.
Provide information about suitable courses, programmes, colleges, universities, and other educational institutions based on the student s stated requirements.
Explain course eligibility criteria, admission requirements, application procedures, required documents, fees, important dates, and other relevant information.
Guide students regarding educational opportunities after Class 10, Class 12, graduation, post-graduation, and other relevant stages of education .
Assist students in identifying appropriate undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, certificate, professional, and other academic programmes.

Respond professionally to admission-related enquiries received through the company s website, telephone, email, social media, and walk-in visits.
Explain the company s admission guidance and consultancy services clearly to prospective students and parents.
Follow up with prospective applicants regarding counselling sessions, applications, documentation, and other pending requirements.
Maintain accurate records of enquiries, counselling sessions, prospective applicants, applications, admissions, and follow-ups.
Update CRM systems, spreadsheets, online forms, and other internal record-management systems.
Communicate with colleges, universities, and other educational institutions when required and appropriately authorized.
Verify important admission information through official or reliable sources before communicating it to applicants.
Maintain current knowledge of courses, admission procedures, eligibility requirements, entrance examinations, and developments in higher education.
Participate in admission campaigns, educational events, student counselling programmes, seminars, workshops, and other company activities when required.
Maintain the confidentiality of students personal, academic, and application-related information.

Good understanding of the Indian education and higher-education system.

Description:
About The/Nudge
The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime."
What are we solving for
We are solving for households in poverty who are also nancially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
At The/Nudge Institute, we are in the process of catalyzing the propagation of the same. Our purpose is to contribute to making the most excluded individuals contributing member to the economy:
Enable govt to adopt by providing research,design, and implementation support
Continue to implement on its own to iteratethe design for impact at scale
Enable more NGOs to adopt technical and capacity-building support
Continue to generate data on poverty and evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Build technology solutions for NGOs and governments to adopt and implement at scale & with quality.
Position Overview:
The/Nudge Institute is partnering with the Tripura Rural Livelihood Mission (TRLM), Rural Development Department, Government of Tripura, to promote the adoption of the Graduation Approach (Economic Inclusion Program) for supporting extremely vulnerable households in achieving sustainable and dignified livelihoods. As part of this partnership, a State Project Management Unit (SPMU) has been established at TRLM, Agartala, to support the Government of Tripura in designing and implementing the Tripura - Samaveshi Aajeevika Yojana (TR-SAY) & Chief Ministers Nabadisha Abhijan (CM-NDA). This position will be based at the concerned blocks of Tripura, work closely with block officials of TRLM and will report to the Program Lead.

What will you do
Understand and practice the values and spirit of The/Nudge Institute and the State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM).
Identify and select vulnerable women in the designated project geographies across the state.
Mobilize vulnerable women into hamlet-level groups and Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
Support the selection, placement, and capacity building of community cadres from local villages/Gram Panchayats to provide intensive handholding and facilitation support to targeted vulnerable women and their households.
Facilitate vulnerable households access to eligible government entitlements and social security schemes by leveraging convergence platforms, including community cadres, community institutions, social capital, block-level line departments, and internal convergence mechanisms within the SRLM.
Facilitate livelihood planning for targeted households and support them in accessing formal credit and loans through community institutions to establish and strengthen livelihood activities.
Strengthen the capacities of community institutions and community cadres to ensure the long-term well-being of vulnerable women by fostering community ownership through the communitization process.
Ensure that all project activities are implemented on time and with the highest quality, in accordance with the approved Project Implementation Plan (PIP), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Package of Practices (PoPs), and Community Operational Manual (COM).
Ensure the timely collection, entry, processing, analysis, and reporting of program data.
Develop case studies and contribute contextualized content to strengthen the programs knowledge management initiatives.
Build and maintain strong relationships with grassroots stakeholders to ensure effective stakeholder engagement and collaboration.
What s in it for you
Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

Description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a versatile Web Developer to build, deploy, and maintain custom client websites. In this role, you will take full ownership of client digital assets from initial design and layout conceptualization to ongoing technical maintenance, CMS integration, and performance optimization.
Key Responsibilities
Web Design & Development: Conceptualize, build, and maintain responsive, high-performance websites and digital portals for our clients.
Maintenance & Security: Perform regular website maintenance, updates, security audits, and performance optimization.
Project Procurement & Business Growth: Identify and acquire new web development projects/clients for DSCHOLAR WEB (attractive performance incentives paid per procured project).
Training & Mentorship: Conduct training sessions and workshops for internal team members and interested candidates looking to upgrade their web development skills.
Technical Operations: Manage web hosting, domains, SSL, CMS platforms, and client delivery workflows.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Education: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
Experience: 1 5 years of web development experience building and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Core Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP/Node.js, and popular frameworks (React.js, Next.js, or Vue.js).
CMS & Database Management: Experience with WordPress/Elementor, headless CMS tools, and relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL).
Web Operations: Solid understanding of domain configuration, cloud hosting (AWS, Vercel, cPanel), SSL certificates, and web security best practices.
Work From Home (WFH) Setup Requirements
As a fully remote position, the candidate must have a functional and dedicated home workstation equipped with:
Hardware: High-performance laptop/desktop (Intel i5/i7 or AMD Ryzen 5/7, minimum 16GB RAM, 256GB+ SSD).
Display & Peripherals: External monitor setup recommended for multi-tasking, along with a working webcam, noise-canceling headset, and microphone for video meetings.
Internet Connectivity: High-speed broadband connection (minimum 50 Mbps) with a secondary backup power connection (e.g., router UPS or mobile hotspot) to ensure uninterrupted service during power outages.
Workspace: A quiet, professional home office space conducive to video calls with clients and trainees.
Compensation & Perks
Negotiable based on experience, portfolio, and technical assessment.
Work Environment: e-Workspace, Collaborative, fast-paced environment with exposure to international clients and cutting-edge web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for an interview.
Candidates with good networking skills will be preferred.
Job Features
Job Category: Consultant, DScholar Web
Location: Remote
Work setup: Work from Home, Set-up required
Mode of Selection: Online Video Interview

Description:
Web Developer - Full-Stack and Client Web Solutions (Job location - Agartala, Tripura, India)
Full-Time Web Developer Job in Agartala, Tripura | DSCHOLAR WEB
Full-Time Desk Job | Agartala, Tripura
Unit: DSCHOLAR WEB | DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics
Job Type: Full-Time, Desk-Based Position
Job Location: Agartala, Tripura, India
Employment Type: Full-Time
About Us
DSCHOLAR WEB is a specialized service unit of DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics, providing end-to-end website design, development, hosting, management, maintenance, and digital solutions.
We design, develop, deploy, host, maintain, and manage websites and digital platforms for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled and versatile Full-Time Web Developer based in Agartala, Tripura.
This is a full-time, desk-based professional position in Agartala. The selected candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, maintaining, securing, and optimizing client websites and digital platforms.
The employee will handle the complete lifecycle of assigned web projects-from understanding client requirements and designing the website to development, deployment, hosting, maintenance, troubleshooting, updates, and ongoing technical management.
The position also involves client and project coordination, technical operations, business-development support, project procurement, and training activities when required.
Key Responsibilities 1. Website Design & Development
Design and develop modern, responsive, professional, and high-performance websites.
Develop websites for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Convert client requirements and concepts into functional digital solutions.
Develop corporate websites, professional/profile websites, institutional websites, e-commerce websites, landing pages, portals, and custom web solutions.
Ensure websites are fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Develop and customize websites using appropriate programming languages, frameworks, CMS platforms, themes, and plugins.
Customize WordPress, Elementor, and other CMS-based websites according to project requirements.
Integrate forms, payment systems, APIs, analytics, third-party services, and other functionality where required.
2. Website Management & Maintenance
Take responsibility for the ongoing technical management of assigned client websites.
Perform regular CMS, WordPress, theme, plugin, and software updates.
Troubleshoot website errors, broken pages, compatibility problems, and technical issues.
Maintain backups and website recovery procedures.
Monitor website functionality, availability, and performance.
Implement requested content, design, layout, and functionality changes.
Provide ongoing technical support for completed client projects.
3. Hosting, Domains & Technical Operations
Configure and manage domains, subdomains, DNS records, and nameservers.
Manage website hosting environments, VPS servers, cPanel/WHM, and cloud-hosting platforms.
Configure and maintain SSL certificates.
Configure professional and business email services where required.
Perform website migrations, deployments, staging, backups, and restorations.
Troubleshoot hosting and server-related issues.
Maintain appropriate technical records and documentation for client projects.
4. Website Security & Performance
Implement website security best practices.
Conduct routine website security checks.
Identify and resolve vulnerabilities and security-related issues.
Assist with malware prevention/removal and unauthorized-access incidents.
Optimize website loading speed and overall performance.
Configure caching, CDN, database optimization, image optimization, and related performance technologies.
Maintain appropriate website backup and disaster-recovery procedures.
5. Client & Project Coordination
Understand and document client requirements.
Communicate professionally with clients through meetings, phone calls, email, and approved digital channels.
Participate in client meetings and project discussions when required.
Provide project updates and coordinate revisions.
Maintain project timelines and ensure timely completion and delivery.
Handle multiple website development and maintenance assignments.
Maintain professional records of requirements, changes, project progress, and deliverables.
6. Project Procurement & Business Development
Identify prospective clients and new website-development opportunities.
Assist DSCHOLAR WEB in acquiring website design, development, hosting, maintenance, and related digital projects.
Communicate the services and solutions offered by DSCHOLAR WEB to prospective clients.
Develop professional networks and business relationships capable of generating projects.
Follow up with prospective clients and business leads where assigned.
Participate in organizational business-development initiatives.
Performance Incentive: Attractive additional performance-based incentives will be provided for eligible projects successfully procured by the employee, subject to organizational terms and policies.
7. Training & Mentorship
Conduct training sessions, workshops, demonstrations, and practical classes when assigned.
Train interested candidates and team members in website development and related technologies.
Provide practical training in WordPress, website development, hosting, domains, and web operations.
Prepare technical documentation and training materials where required.
Mentor trainees and provide guidance during practical web-development activities.
8. Daily Desk-Based Responsibilities
As this is a full-time desk job based in Agartala, Tripura, the selected employee will be expected to:
Maintain regular attendance and punctuality.
Remain available for assigned responsibilities throughout designated working hours.
Work independently as well as collaboratively with the team.
Attend internal meetings, client discussions, training sessions, and project reviews.
Maintain daily or periodic records of assigned and completed work when required.
Coordinate professionally with management, colleagues, clients, and trainees.
Meet project deadlines and assigned performance expectations.
Maintain professional workplace conduct and discipline.
Handle multiple assignments efficiently in a professional desk-based environment.
Required Qualifications
Educational Qualification: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Professional Experience: Preferably 1-5 years of relevant web-development experience, particularly in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Portfolio: Candidates should be able to demonstrate their technical abilities through a portfolio, live websites, GitHub projects, previous professional work, or practical technical assessment.
Required Technical Skills
JavaScript / TypeScript, PHP and/or Node.js, WordPress, Elementor, MySQL / PostgreSQL, Responsive Web Design, UI/UX Fundamentals, Website Deployment, Domain and DNS Management, cPanel / WHM, VPS and Cloud Hosting, SSL Configuration, Website Migration and Backups, Website Security, Website Speed and Performance Optimization, Git / Version-Control Fundamentals.
Knowledge of React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, AWS, Vercel, Cloudflare, headless CMS platforms, APIs, e-commerce platforms, payment-gateway integrations, and related modern web technologies will be an advantage.
Professional Skills
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to communicate professionally with clients.
Good networking and interpersonal skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned projects.
Strong time-management and organizational abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.
Ability to work effectively as part of a professional team.
Ability to train and mentor others.
Professional discipline, punctuality, and accountability.
Candidates with strong networking, communication, and client-acquisition skills will be preferred.
Compensation & Benefits
Salary: Negotiable based on the candidate s qualifications, relevant experience, portfolio, technical expertise, interview performance, and technical assessment.
Performance Incentives: Additional incentives may be provided for successfully procured and eligible client projects in accordance with organizational policy.
Work Environment: Professional, collaborative, and technology-focused environment with exposure to website development, hosting, digital operations, client projects, research-related platforms, and modern web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Application screening.
CV and portfolio evaluation.
Shortlisting.
Interview.
Technical assessment and/or practical web-development task.
Final selection.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for the interview/selection process.
Candidates demonstrating strong technical expertise, professional communication skills, independent project-handling ability, and good networking skills will be preferred.
Important
This vacancy is for a FULL-TIME, DESK-BASED POSITION IN AGARTALA, TRIPURA.
Candidates should apply only if they are available to work full-time in Agartala, Tripura and can maintain regular attendance, professional discipline, and availability during assigned working hours.

Job Summary
CBM India Trust is committed to improving the quality of life of persons with disabilities and members of other marginalized communities. We work in partnership with local, national, and international actors with the aim of creating a more equal society for all. Our vision is to have an inclusive world in which all persons with disabilities enjoy their human rights and achieve their full potential. To ensure smooth field implementation, coordination with schools and communities, and quality delivery of inclusive education and accessibility interventions at the grassroots level.


Responsibilities
Field Operations Activity Planning
Lead planning and scheduling of field activities across program components and outcomes.
Coordinate day-to-day implementation of project activities in schools and communities.
Ensure timely execution of field plans and support the Project Manager with progress updates.
Coordinate with school authorities, block officials, and contractors for the renovation of
Oversee installation of accessibility features such as ramps, accessible toilets, railings, and
Ensure all modifications meet disability-inclusive accessibility standards.
Training Capacity - Building Coordination
Organize and coordinate training for teachers, special educators, and school staff.
Manage training logistics, including scheduling, venue coordination, materials, and
Support implementation of inclusive education practices promoted under Samagra Shiksha.
Community Field Team Supervision
Supervise Community Mobilizers and ensure effective outreach and engagement across all
Guide field teams in community awareness, school engagement, and inclusion activities.
Ensure consistent program coverage and quality implementation at the grassroots level.
Therapy Services Child Support
Coordinate with therapy centers to facilitate services for children with disabilities.
Arrange transport and support mechanisms to ensure regular access to therapy services.
Track participation and follow-up of children receiving therapy and educational support.
Monitor field progress and document implementation challenges.
Prepare regular updates and structured field reports for the Project Manager.
Support data collection and reporting for program monitoring and donor reporting
Ensure adherence to disability-inclusive standards in all school-level interventions.


Professional profile and requirements
A Bachelor's degree in Education, Social Work, Disability Studies, or a related field, or a B.Ed. in Special Education, or a Diploma in Special Education
2-3 years of experience in field coordination or program implementation in education, rehabilitation, or community development projects.
Prior experience working on inclusive education or programs for children with disabilities under initiatives such as Samagra Shiksha will be preferred.
Experience coordinating with schools, community stakeholders, and local government officials in


Skills
Strong coordination and communication skills for effective stakeholder engagement, including school interactions, home visits, and community sensitization on disability inclusion.
Proficiency in basic digital tools for monitoring and reporting, including Excel and mobile-based applications for IEP tracking and program data management.
Willingness to travel extensively across districts in Tripura, with strong cultural sensitivity to disability inclusion and community norms.


Other requirements
The future job holder is expected to adhere to CBM India\'s policies and procedures, commit to CBM India\'s Child Safeguarding Policy and Code of Conduct, and follow CBM India\'s safety security.
Eight hours per day

Job Context & Major Challenges
Job Context/Job Challenges:Organisation ContextEstablished in 1994, Aditya Birla Sun Life Asset Management Company, (ABSLAMC) is a joint venture between Aditya Birla Group &Sunlife Ficial Inc. , a leading international ficial services company in Canada. ABSLAMC is a fund manager for Birla Sunlife Mutual Funds ¤tly ranks as the fourth largest fund Management houses in India with a total Average AUM base of over INR 2 Lakh 45 Thousand crores(as on Nov 2017). Out of the 42 fund houses in the country, ABSLAMC ranked 1st in Fixed Income AUM &5th in Equity AUM category respectively. As of November 2017, the Average AUM market Share of the organisation was approx 10. 73%. The company grew its investor client base by 44% to about 5. 2 Mn from 3. 6 Mn from the previous year, thereby bagging a second position in this category. Distribution Network: ABSLAMC has a footprint in more than 200 locations across the country with approx 65, 000 IFAs, 210 National Distributors & 85 banking partnership. ABSLAMC also has its offshore presence through its rep offices in Singapore, Dubai & Mauritius. Its offerings also include Portfolio advisory services for High Net worth individuals as well as offshore funds for Non Resident Indians. The Company follows a longterm, fundamental research based approach to investment &thrives to provide a transparent ðical services to its investors. One of the key challenges for ABSLAMC has been to maintain a balance between moving with dynamic &constantly changing regulatory norms of the country &maintaining growth &profitability in the extremely competitive market. &some of key strengths of the organization that have helped it to sustain &grow are:
Focus on TechnologyThe organization has been in the forefront in implementing technological innovation to foster innovation &also to improve efficiency for its stakeholders, whether it is employees, clients or distributors
Product InnovationABSLAMC has been known to be a pioneer in terms of products &has a history of launching innovative, category defining products like Birla Cash plus, etc. Research based approachABSLAMC has one of the largest team of research analyst dedicated to tracking down the best companies to invest in. Strong Distributor Delivery MechanismThe Company has developed a 4pronged sales/delivery mechanism to ensure maximum reach &penetration to the end customers. This mechanism includes Company s direct Channels (branches/online), Independent Ficial Advisors (IFAs), National Distributors (ND) &Banks.
Regulator InterfaceABSLAMC plays a key role in the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) with quite a few members of the top management being a part of the AMFI Board. Description:
We are looking for an Associate Business Head to lead our ed-tech firm's growth and profitability. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of the business, including sales, marketing, product development, and operations, and driving the P&L of the designated branch.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop and implement strategies to drive revenue growth and profitability for the business.
Build and lead a high-performing team to execute the company's goals and objectives.
Identify new market opportunities and develop plans to expand the company's customer base.
Develop and execute marketing campaigns to promote the company's products and services.
Manage product development initiatives, including ideation, design, and launch.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless delivery of products and services to customers.
Develop and manage the P&L for the organization, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
Identify and manage key business risks, including competitive threats, regulatory changes, and market fluctuations.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including investors, partners, and customers.
Represent the company at industry events and conferences.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field. MBA preferred.
At least 3+ years of experience in a senior leadership role, with a track record of driving business growth and profitability.
Experience in the ed-tech industry is highly preferred.
Strong business acumen and financial management skills, with experience managing P&L for a business unit.
Excellent leadership and management skills, with the ability to build and lead high-performing teams.
Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to develop and execute complex business plans.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with key stakeholders.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
Entrepreneurial mindset, with a bias towards action and a willingness to take risks.

Project Role Description : Configure and support packaged or SaaS applications to adapt features, manage releases, and ensure system stability. Use standard tools, APIs, and low-code platforms to align solutions with business needs while preserving compatibility and performance.

Summary:
As a Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer, a typical day involves configuring and supporting packaged or software as a service applications to tailor features according to evolving business requirements. The role includes managing application releases and ensuring the overall stability and performance of the system. The engineer works with various tools, application programming interfaces, and low-code platforms to deliver solutions that align with organizational goals while maintaining compatibility across different environments. Collaboration with stakeholders to understand needs and adapt the application accordingly is a key part of daily activities.

Roles Responsibilities:
- Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
- Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
- Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and implement application enhancements.
- Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues to maintain optimal operation.
- Document configuration changes and maintain knowledge base for future reference.
- Assist junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on best practices.

Professional Technical Skills:

HRSD Snr Dev - HR Case Knowledge Management, Employee Center , Lifecycle Events

- Familiarity with APIs and integration techniques within ServiceNow platform.
- Ability to work with low-code/no-code tools to streamline application development and deployment.
- Strong problem-solving skills to address technical challenges and optimize system functionality.
- Understanding of release management processes and version control in SaaS environments.
- The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in ServiceNow Human Resource Service Delivery (HRSD).
- This position is based at our Bangalore office.
- A 15 years full time education is required.

Job Summary:
As part of our Data & AI practice, you will join a worldwide network of smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading statistical tools, methods, and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically informed, issue-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.
Accenture will continually invest in your learning and growth. You'll work with experts in SaaS & PaaS and Accenture will support you in growing your own tech stack and certifications.
In Data & AI you will understands the importance of sound analytical decision-making, relationship of tasks to the overall project, and executes projects in the context of a business performance improvement initiative.
