Development and testing of AI algorithms and techniques, custom-tailored to effectively address and solve specific, complex business problems.
Manage large databases proficiently, conducting exploratory data analytics to derive valuable insights for stakeholders.
Track down and thoroughly investigate previous information related to a problem, asking probing questions to identify root causes.
Employ a systematic approach to problem-solving, exploring known avenues and asking insightful questions to unravel the core issues.
Work collaboratively with both internal teams and external consultants/managers to achieve project objectives.
Develop and manage data pipelines to streamline the flow of information for enhanced efficiency.
Demonstrate adaptability and flexibility in responding to changing project requirements.
Proactively seek and embrace continuous learning opportunities to stay updated with the industry trends and advancement.
Professional & Technical Skills:
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related field.
Experience working for large Software or Platform organizations.
Proven experience (4+ years) in working on AI projects and delivering successful outcomes.
Hands-On exposure to Generative AI frameworks (Azure Open AI, Vertex AI) and implementations & Strong knowledge of AI technologies, including Embedding, prompt engineering, natural language processing, computer vision, etc.
Hands on experience in building and deployment of Statistical Models/Machine Learning including Segmentation & predictive modelling, hypothesis testing, multivariate statistical analysis, time series techniques, and optimization.
Ability to work with large data sets and present findings / insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL
Proficiency in statistical packages such as R, Python, Java, SQL, Spark, etc.
Knowledge in training large language models and fine-tuning for specific applications or domains.

Additional Information:
Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)
Experience:
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.

Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles

Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience
Generic Data Analyst or Data Steward profiles without SAP MDG experience

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Description:
Roles & ResponsibilitiesA day in the life of an Infoscion
As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to lead the engagement effort of providing high-quality and value-adding consulting solutions to customers at different stages- from problem definition to diagnosis to solution design, development and deployment.

You will review the proposals prepared by consultants, provide guidance, and analyze the solutions defined for the client business problems to identify any potential risks and issues.

You will identify change Management requirements and propose a structured approach to client for managing the change using multiple communication mechanisms.

You will also coach and create a vision for the team, provide subject matter training for your focus areas, motivate and inspire team members through effective and timely feedback and recognition for high performance.

You would be a key contributor in unit-level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high-quality, value-adding consulting solutions to customers adhering to the guidelines and processes of the organization.

If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!
Technical Requirement
9 + years of work experience (certification is preference) in Callidus Cloud (SAP) Commissions.
Experience in Callidus Cloud Advanced Workflows is added advantage. Knowledge of Crystal reports is also a plus.
Should have experience of working in at least 1 end to end implementations in Callidus Cloud Commissions.
Additional Responsibility
Ability to develop value-creating strategies and models that enable clients to innovate, drive growth and increase their business profitability
Good knowledge on software configuration management systems
Awareness of latest technologies and Industry trends
Logical thinking and problem-solving skills along with an ability to collaborate
Understanding of the financial processes for various types of projects and the various pricing models available
Ability to assess the current processes, identify improvement areas and suggest the technology solutions
One or two industry domain knowledge
Client Interfacing skills
Project and Team management

Location of posting - Infosys Ltd. is committed to ensuring you have the best experience throughout your journey with us. We currently have open positions in a number of locations across India - Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Indore, Nagpur, Mangalore, Noida, Bhubaneswar, Kolkata, Coimbatore, Mumbai, Jaipur, Mysore and Hubli. While we work in accordance with business requirements, we shall strive to offer you the location of your choice, where possible.
Educational RequirementBachelor of Engineering
Preferred SkillsTechnology->SAP Functional->SAP Commissions
Service LineEnterprise Package Application Services

3+ years of experience managing large QA teams.
Strong knowledge of CLM business processes.
Hands-on functional, UI, API, and integration testing.
Experience in QA planning and delivery management.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
Experience in onshore/offshore delivery models.
Good to Have
CLM tools: Icertis, Agiloft, Conga, DocuSign CLM.
Automation: Selenium, Playwright, Tosca.
API Testing: Postman, REST Assured.
SQL, Jira, Azure DevOps.
AI/ML application testing.
ISTQB certification.

The Opportunity

EY Consulting is a fast-moving, high-growth area with huge potential. We are currently recruiting for a Seniors to join our team. This team offers variety, challenge, responsibility and the opportunity to realize your leadership potential. Being a member of our Consulting team means you will specialize in a particular competency - Risk, Technology Consulting, or IT Risk & Assurance. Our Technology Consulting team is focused on helping clients improve operational efficiency and security, while also reducing costs and managing risk.

In this role we are looking for an experienced SAP FICO Senior Manager to join our growing SAP Finance team. As a Senior Manager in the IT Consulting Services team to work on various SAP Implementation projects for our customers across the globe.  You will work closely with business stakeholders to deliver innovative, scalable, and compliant solutions within the SAP FI/CO landscape.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a Senior Manager, you'll assist in developing applicable methodologies, tools, approaches, points of view, thought leadership and accelerators to differentiate EY in the ERP advisory market. These are shared with all EY market facing organizations to provide consistency and common platforms with which to go to market.
As a Senior Manager you will be involved in different phases of various ongoing SAP Implementation Projects and contribute effectively.
Interface and communicate with the onsite coordinators.

Ideally, youll also

Skilled in team leadership” – adhering to the project methodology and PMO processes/procedures, planning the data team’s work, leading local and offshore resources, reporting status, logging and escalating risks/issues/decisions, participating in program governance, etc.
Advanced knowledge and experience with SAP Finance and Controlling Module
Effectively team with diverse skills and backgrounds and foster an innovative and inclusive team-oriented work environment.
Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills, coupled with a strong interest in further developing and integrating enterprise domain knowledge with technology skills.
Demonstrate characteristics of a forward thinker and self-starter that thrives on new challenges and adapts quickly to learning new knowledge.
Ability to lead a team of consulting professionals on multiple projects.
A strong work ethic
Prior client facing consulting experience

What we look for

Candidate must be a qualified CA / ICWA / ICMA/ MBA Finance in a reputed institution with a sound industry/domain experience and SAP relevant experience with 10+ years
Experience of having worked in an onsite- offshore delivery model
Project Management experience should be of leading at least a team of 10-15 members
Experience with leading business blueprint, gathering and documenting business requirements and designing SAP enabled solutions
Experience facilitating cross-functional team members with complex schedules against a published plan
Development of project documentation including business process flows, training materials, requirements gathering and project management methodology experience required
Experience should be in End-to-end Implementation, Rollout, Support, upgrade, enhancements in the below areas.
SAP Finance – FI- New General Ledger & Profit Center Accounting, FI-Accounts Payable, FI-Bank accounting and FI-Asset Accounting.
Exposure on SAP Simple Finance – GL Accounting, Asset Accounting and CO – Overhead Cost Controlling & Profitability Analysis.
SAP Finance – Taxation and Withholding Taxes.
SAP Finance – Closing activities, Validations and Substitutions & Reporting.
Controlling- CO-Cost element accounting CO-Cost Center Accounting and CO-Internal Orders.
Knowledge on CO-PA & Product Costing (Planning and cost object controlling).
FI integration with MM, SD, HR & PS.
Excellent business communication skills
Experience on FIORI APPS, BO-DS, BW, HANA and other reporting tools
What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. 
Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

 Validate the job record billing details and add projects to the job, if required

Update and maintain billing schedules 
Respond to queries  in relation to engagement financial performance
Prepare and maintain Year-to-Date fee summaries as required
Accounts Receivables

Respond to requests from National Finance with respect to cash allocations
Initiate reminders to clients and diligently follow up to ensure timely resolution, as directed by manager/partner

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an Tech Lead (Backend Developer) - Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Advisory practice, you will leverage advanced analytics and statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets, helping solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.
Responsibilities
- Leading data science initiatives to transform raw data into actionable insights for informed decision-making
- Guiding teams in the application of advanced analytics and statistical techniques to solve complex business problems
- Developing and implementing machine learning models to enhance data-driven decision-making processes
- Collaborating with client support teams to design and develop robust data solutions that drive business growth
- Utilizing data science algorithms and troubleshooting techniques to optimize data analysis and visualization
- Mentoring team members to leverage their unique strengths and improve performance on client engagements
- Analyzing system components to identify linkages and interactions for comprehensive data solutions
- Taking ownership of projects, including planning, budgeting, execution, and completion, to meet client expectations
- Encouraging innovation and the use of technology to enhance delivery and inspire team development
- Addressing conflicts and engaging in challenging conversations with clients and stakeholders to maintain project alignment
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree from Tier 1
- At least 7 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Computer and Data Engineering, Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems/Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering
- Strong proficiency in Python for production-grade application or service development.
- Experience designing, implementing, and integrating REST APIs.
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerised service deployment.
Strong working knowledge of PostgreSQL, including schema design, querying, and performance tuning.
- Proficiency with Git-based collaborative development workflows.
- Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including clean code, automated testing, design patterns, and maintainability.
- Working knowledge of Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience setting technical direction, reviewing code, resolving complex issues, and mentoring engineers.
- Experience with asynchronous APIs, messaging platforms, or event-streaming technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
- Exposure to agentic development using frameworks such as LangGraph, the OpenAI SDK, or Google ADK.
- Leveraging tools and methodologies to generate innovative solutions

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 2-5 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine-tune foundation models using frameworks such as Hugging Face and Lang Chain.
Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.
Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning technologies.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Python and AI/ML libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or similar frameworks.
Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Azure ML.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
Nice to Have
Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
Experience working in enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 5-9 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.

Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.

Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.

Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.

Experience working in enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

Role Overview
The Assistant Cluster Lead will support the Cluster Lead in managing operations across multiple residential & comemrcial communities. The incumbent will be responsible for driving operational excellence, team effectiveness, vendor performance, customer satisfaction, governance compliance, and financial discipline across assigned sites while ensuring adherence to organizational standards and service commitments.

Key Responsibilities
Operational Management
Support the Cluster Lead in overseeing daily facility management operations across assigned communities.
Ensure implementation and adherence to FM guidelines, SOPs, statutory requirements, and work instructions.
Conduct regular site visits and operational audits to ensure service quality and compliance.
Monitor preventive and corrective maintenance activities across sites.

Team Management
Guide, mentor, and supervise Site Managers, Community Executives, and operational teams.
Ensure manpower deployment, attendance management, roster adherence, and workforce productivity.
Support hiring, onboarding, training, and performance management of site teams.
Drive a culture of accountability, customer-centricity, and continuous improvement.

Financial Management
Review operational expenses and support budget control across assigned sites.
Monitor monthly budgets and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
Coordinate with Finance for billing, collections, vendor payments, and financial reconciliations.
Assist in achieving revenue and profitability targets for assigned communities.

Stakeholder Management
Build strong relationships with Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), Management Committees, and Developer Representatives.
Support governance meetings and ensure closure of action items.
Act as a key escalation point for operational and service-related issues.

Customer Experience
Drive resident satisfaction by ensuring timely resolution of complaints and service requests.
Monitor customer feedback and implement improvement initiatives.
Support resident engagement activities and community-building programs.
Minimize escalations through proactive issue identification and resolution.

Vendor Management
Monitor vendor performance against defined SLAs, KPIs, and contractual commitments.
Conduct periodic vendor reviews and service quality audits.
Ensure compliance with safety, statutory, and operational standards.
Support onboarding and governance of service partners.

Compliance & Governance
Ensure adherence to EHS guidelines, statutory compliances, and internal audit requirements.
Monitor documentation, licenses, certifications, and compliance trackers.
Support implementation of risk mitigation and corrective action plans.

Review & Reporting
Prepare and review Monthly Management Reports (MMR), operational dashboards, and business review presentations.
Track key operational, financial, and customer experience metrics.
Share periodic updates with stakeholders and management on site performance.

Educational Qualification
Any Graduate / BE/ B.Tech/ MBA/ Hospitality courses/ BHM (Any)

Experience
8-17 years of experience in Facility Management, Property Management, Community Management, or Operations.
Experience managing residential townships, premium housing societies, or mixed-use developments preferred.
Prior experience leading multiple sites and vendor management is desirable.

Description:
Senior Associate Workforce Solutions (Dayforce)
Job description
is responsible for independently managing assigned workstreams and supporting end-to-end Dayforce HCM implementation projects across functional areas, including Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, and Talent Management, as well as technical areas such as Data Conversion, Integrations, and Reporting. The role requires strong expertise in one or more Dayforce modules, with a working understanding of related modules and cross-functional dependencies. Key responsibilities include requirements gathering, business process design, solution design, system configuration, data migration and validation, integrations, reporting, testing, cutover, and post-go-live activities. The position involves collaborating closely with clients, project managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into effective HCM solutions, resolve implementation challenges, and ensure timely, high-quality project delivery. Additionally, the role supports regulatory compliance, process optimization, and transition to managed services while ensuring solution quality and alignment with client business objectives.
Essential Responsibilities
Support the end-to-end implementation and transformation of Dayforce HCM solutions for external clients, covering discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support, within your primary module and in coordination with other module workstreams.
Own assigned Dayforce functional workstreams, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of project milestones, deliverables, and client requirements.
Facilitate client discovery workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, document current-state HR and payroll processes, business rules, organizational structures, and data flows, validate design decisions, resolve open items, and align client needs with Dayforce capabilities.
Translate business and functional requirements into Dayforce configurations, solution design documents, configuration workbooks, and test scenarios.
Support data migration activities, including coordination of legacy data extraction, data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure accurate conversion into Dayforce.
Collaborate with technical and integration teams on inbound and outbound integrations between Dayforce and third-party systems, including data mapping, integration testing, error resolution, and data flow validation.
Plan and execute testing activities, including functional, system integration (SIT), user acceptance (UAT), regression, and end-to-end business process testing; support payroll parallel testing where applicable by validating calculations, analyzing variances, and reconciling results; and manage defects through resolution.
Advise clients on Dayforce capabilities, HCM business processes, regulatory compliance considerations, and leading practices, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and optimization by assessing manual workarounds, control gaps, and system capabilities.


Requirements
48 years of relevant experience in HCM implementation, HR technology consulting, HR transformation, or enterprise HRIS projects, including hands-on Dayforce HCM implementation experience.
Hands-on experience configuring Dayforce in at least one primary module (Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, or Talent Management), with working knowledge of cross-module dependencies.
Experience across the end-to-end Dayforce implementation lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, data migration, integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover, go-live, and post-production support.
Experience independently managing a functional workstream, facilitating client workshops, translating business requirements into system solutions, troubleshooting configuration issues, and delivering documentation and project milestones.
Solid knowledge of HCM data migration, mapping, validation, reconciliation, integration testing, and defect management.

Description:
Role Purpose
The Software Procurement intern is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end lifecycle of global software assets, software procurement processes, and supplier contracts at Thoughtworks. This role ensures cost efficiency, streamlined workflows, timely supplier payments, regulatory compliance, and seamless cross-functional collaboration across GITS, InfoSec, Finance, Accounts Payable, and Legal departments.
Key Responsibilities
Learn and work closely with Software Procurement Lead on below mention responsibilities:
1. Procurement Operations & Purchase Management
End-to-End Workflow Optimisation: Direct and analyse the efficiency of software procurement processes, from request ingestion to inventory updating
Coupa Platform Management: Initiate supplier onboarding forms, monitor supplier statuses until active, and create/publish Purchase Orders (POs) and Virtual Contracts in Coupa
Requisition Approvals: Act as the designated Global Procurement Approver and authorise high-value requisitions (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) on behalf of the Global Software Lead.
Manage Credit Card Spend: Manage monthly or annual subscriptions that are on credit card and submit weekly expense reports in Expensify; allocating cost accurately.Manage multiple domain registrars: Register and renew domains, working closely with LegalAWS account provisioning: Work closely with CloudOps team on provisioning / deprovisioning AWS accounts including management of login credentials
2. Vendor Relationship & Renewal Management
Vendor Coordination: Manage direct communication with major global SaaS vendors (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn, Snowflake, Sisense, Pearson VUE) regarding quotes, order forms, and payment terms.
Renewal Pipeline Tracking: Partner with external procurement platforms to monitor renewal deadlines, evaluate license needs, coordinate stakeholder feedback, and schedule retirements of legacy software.
3. Financial & Budget Governance
Invoice & Payment Resolution: Partner closely with Accounts Payable (AP) to verify receipts, resolve billing discrepancies, split invoices manually, and escalate critical past-due accounts.
Budgeting & Cost Allocation: Monitor license allocations and manage pay-as-you-go or credit-based models to optimize spend and ensure unused credits do not expire.
Cost Distribution Mapping: Distribute software costs accurately among business units, regions (DEC/POH), and specific accounts or departments by aligning data from Jigsaw and other tools.
4. Software Entitlement & Compliance Management
Software Asset Management (SAM): Track active software assets and license assignments via ServiceNow (SNOW). Requires close coordination with multiple teams.
Risk & Regulatory Compliance: Collaborate with GITS, InfoSec, and regional legal leads to verify software compliance, evaluate export regulations (such as the Remote Access Security Act), and implement geographic usage restrictions.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Learn and build following skills (tools/applications and Soft skills:
Procurement Platforms: High proficiency in Coupa Software, ServiceNow, Expensify and Zendesk.
Negotiation & Financial Acumen: Strong capability in analyzing pricing models (pay-as-you-go, subscription, credit-based, or enterprise commitments) and driving cost splits across departments.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment: Exceptional cross-functional relationship-building skills, specifically with Finance, AP, Legal (contracts/compliance), GITS, and InfoSec.
Compliance Mindset: Understanding of IT software security guidelines, software usage terms, and regional compliance standards.
Must-have criteria
Education: MBA / PGDM graduate, 2026 pass-out
Specialization: Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Strategic Sourcing, or a closely related specialization
Location: Gurgaon, Bangalore, Pune
Experience: Freshers and candidates with relevant internship/project experience can be considered
Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills
Stakeholder management: Comfortable interacting with internal stakeholders and external vendors
Commercial mindset: Interest in negotiation, pricing, cost optimisation and vendor management
Analytical skills: Comfortable working with data, comparing options and drawing insights
Technology interest: Willingness to learn about software, SaaS products and technology procurement

Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening

Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

Description:
Join us on our exciting journey!
IQVIA has been consistently rated as the leader in real world studies.
The vision of our Real World Evidence teams is to pioneer and lead with scientific and technical expertise, the generation and dissemination of high-quality Real World Evidence that make a true difference to patient lives, globally.


The HEOR Global Scientific Services team is part of Real World Solutions and has nearly 250 talented professionals, specializing across 3 verticals:
- Scientific Literature Review
- Health Economic Modelling
- Medical & Scientific Writing.

The team delivers HEOR projects across the globe, across study types and therapeutic areas.
What makes HEOR team special is the access to the huge amounts of clinical data; opportunity to interact and work with thought leaders of the industry; exposure to traditional and innovative trials (Digital studies, External comparators, pragmatic trials etc.) and extensive training opportunities to grow.

Job Overview:
Conduct literature reviews to collect data, analyzes it and run country specific adaptations of cost effectiveness analysis models and budget impact analysis models under senior oversight.
Support main modeler on building de novo pharmacoeconomic models across diverse therapy areas. Typical projects include the design and programming of budget impact analysis models and cost-effectiveness analysis models (such as: Markov, decision tree, partitioned survival).
Support the preparation of technical documents associated with the models such as technical report, user guide and collaborates with medical writers for publications related to PE models. Along with conducting tasks on the model and undertakes quality control of work.
Build working relationships and actively collaborate with key internal and external stakeholders to deliver high quality output. You will also present analyses conducted, either verbally, or in graphical, tabular, or descriptive form.

Key Responsibilities:
Conduct literature review and collect model inputs
Run country specific adaptation of CEA and BIA models including quality checks
Support main/senior modeler on development health economic decision-analytic models to undertake either budget impact analysis or cost-effectiveness/cost-utility analysis, including decision tree, Markov, partitioned survival models
Support development of deliverables such as model analysis plan(s), technical reports, and user guides
Support dissemination of findings through articles, posters, and presentations
Support development of global modelling materials, processes, and methodology with HE Modelling, Centre of Excellence.
Contribute to other process improvement efforts including development of source repository
Participate in client calls, as required
Requirements:
Masters degree in the life science field, or equivalent
4-10 years of hands-on working on country specific adaptation and supporting the build of de novo Pharmacoeconomic models and running analysis in the industry or academia bringing in a combination of strong health economics knowledge and strategic insights.

Reporting to Quality function, you will provide independent quality assurance oversight to ensure engineering and project activities are delivered in compliance with nuclear regulatory requirements, customer commitments, and the CANDU Quality Assurance Program.
You will play a key role in strengthening quality culture, driving compliance, managing quality risks, and ensuring the objective evidence, traceability, and governance required to support safe, reliable, and Right First-Time delivery within a highly regulated nuclear environment.
Your Role
Nuclear Quality Assurance
Support the implementation and continual improvement of the CANDU Quality Assurance Program.
Ensure compliance with regulatory, customer, project, and management system requirements.

Engineering Quality

Verify compliance with design control, verification, validation, and configuration management requirements.

Working knowledge of

ASME NQA-1
ISO 9001 and ISO 19443
Nuclear Safety Culture principles
Supplier Quality Assurance

Design Control and Verification

Overview
AtkinsRalis is seeking an experienced Senior Urban and Real Estate Economist to join its Advisory team supporting Middle East projects based out of India
The role will provide economic, demographic and real estate market analysis to support development advisory, urban planning, master planning and infrastructure planning assignments. The successful candidate will translate population, household, employment and sector growth forecasts into spatial and real estate requirements, including:
Land-use and development demand; Real estate asset mix and scale; Housing and employment requirements; Social infrastructure needs; Development capacity and absorption; Development and infrastructure phasing; and Investment priorities.
The candidate will work as part of multidisciplinary teams alongside development advisors, urban planners, master planners, real estate specialists, infrastructure planners, engineers, transport specialists, GIS professionals and financial advisors.
The role is based in India and support projects in Dubai and across the UAE, KSA and the wider Middle East.
Your Role
Roles Responsibilities
Urban and Spatial Economics
Undertake economic, demographic and socio-economic analysis for regional strategies, city plans, master plans and major development programmes.
Prepare population, household, employment and economic forecasts at regional, city, district and development levels.
Translate growth forecasts into spatial requirements for residential, commercial, retail, hospitality, industrial, mixed-use and community development.
Assess relationships between economic activity, population distribution, employment, accessibility, land use and infrastructure provision.
Develop and test alternative growth and development scenarios and assess their spatial implications.
Prepare socio-economic baselines, city and regional benchmarks, economic impact assessments and wider-benefits analysis.
Translate demographic forecasts into requirements for housing and social infrastructure, including education, healthcare, recreation and community facilities.
Work with planning and GIS teams to spatially represent population, employment, economic activity and development demand.
Real Estate Economics
Undertake real estate market, demand and supply assessments across relevant asset classes.
Analyse market drivers, existing and planned supply, occupancy, take-up, pricing, absorption and competing developments.
Prepare development demand forecasts for residential, office, retail, hospitality, industrial and other real estate uses.
Provide economic and market inputs into development positioning, land-use mix, scale, density and phasing.
Assess the market supportability and absorption of proposed development programmes.
Support highest-and-best-use studies, development strategies, land strategies and master plans.
Test development scenarios against economic, demographic and real estate market conditions.
Work with financial advisors to align market assumptions, development programmes and financial feasibility.
Provide evidence to support development, land-use and investment decisions.
Development and Infrastructure Planning
Translate population, employment and real estate forecasts into high-level infrastructure and service-demand assumptions.
Support infrastructure planners in understanding how development growth affects transport, utilities, municipal services and social infrastructure.
Identify development dependencies and infrastructure triggers affecting land release, development sequencing and phasing.
Support the alignment of real estate absorption, development delivery and infrastructure investment.
Provide economic and demand inputs into infrastructure strategies, investment plans and business cases.
Project Delivery
Lead defined urban and real estate economics workstreams within multidisciplinary advisory assignments.
Develop clear methodologies, analytical frameworks, forecast models and evidence bases.
Gather and analyse quantitative and qualitative information from government, commercial and client sources.
Prepare high-quality technical reports, presentations, working papers and executive summaries.
Translate complex analysis into clear findings and practical recommendations for planning, development and investment decisions.
Present analysis and recommendations to clients and project stakeholders.
Business and Practice Development
Contribute to technical and commercial proposals across development advisory, urban planning, real estate and infrastructure planning.
Support client engagement and the identification of new business opportunities.
Develop reusable datasets, forecasting tools, analytical methodologies and templates.
Contribute to market insights and thought leadership on urban growth, real estate development and regional economic trends.
Share knowledge and good practice across Advisory and the wider AtkinsRalis business.
Support the professional development of junior economists and analysts.
Champion collaboration, inclusion and high-quality delivery.

Bachelor's degree in Economics, Real Estate Economics, Urban Economics, Economic Geography, Regional Science, Urban Planning or a related discipline.
Master's degree in Urban Economics, Real Estate, Economics, Development Economics, Economic Geography, Urban Planning or a related field is preferred.

Experience in urban economics, real estate economics, development advisory, socio-economics or a related consulting discipline.
Demonstrable ability to translate economic and demographic forecasts into spatial and real estate requirements.
Experience supporting master plans, development strategies, regional plans, regeneration programmes or major real estate developments.
Experience in real estate market assessment and demand forecasting across one or more asset classes.
Good understanding of the relationship between economic growth, population, employment, land use, real estate markets and infrastructure.
Strong quantitative, forecasting and analytical capability.
Advanced capability in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience with GIS, statistical analysis or data-visualisation tools is desirable.
Experience in the UAE, KSA or wider GCC is strongly preferred.
Experience within a consultancy, development authority, planning agency, real estate advisor or government organisation is advantageous.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with the ability to move from data and evidence to practical recommendations.
Ability to connect economic and real estate analysis with physical planning, development and investment decisions.
Excellent written communication, report-writing and presentation skills.
Ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Commercial awareness and understanding of the factors influencing real estate and development decisions.

Description:
1 Job Description for CS to Logistics Team: (Executive/Sr. Executive)
a. Handling all logistics related queries which will be routed from the CS team through mails, chats, and calls.
b. Closing urgent deliveries, POD, disputed cases raised from customers.
c. Closing all the cases for customers within defined TAT.
d. Need to take ownership and close customer queries with a positive response.
e. Enhances organization reputation by accepting ownership for accomplishing new and different requests.
f. Having a weekly review with courier partners for improvisation on TAT and maintaining a quality of deliveries.
g. Working with the CS team and other team members to improvise the process and enhance the quality of service for customers.
h. Engaging with a cross functional team.

2. Job Description for NDR Agent/Supervisor: (Executive/Sr. Executive)
a. Should be able to manage a team of 10 to 12 people.
b. Outcall and mail to customers and validate the failed delivery remarks from customers.
c. Taking initiative and getting shipments delivered to customers by keeping a close followup with courier partners.
d. Outbound calling for non-delivered shipments.
e. Determines requirements of customers.
f. Answers inquiries by clarifying desired information; researching, locating, and providing information.
g. Resolves problems by clarifying issues; researching and exploring answers and alternative solutions; implementing solutions; escalating unresolved problems.
h. Maintains NDR calling database by entering information.
i. Enhances organization reputation by accepting ownership for accomplishing new and different requests.

3. Job Description for Billing and COD Reconciliation Team: (Executive/Sr. Executive)
a. Deal with logistics partners and manage the disputes for marketplace vendors.
b. Logistics cost reconciliations.
c. CN recovery against the Damage and lost shipments.
d. Maintain data of COD-remittance and reconciliation with courier partners.
e. Check and reconcile courier and vendor bill or invoice copy.

4. Job Description for MIS/Data Analytics Team: (Executive/Sr. Executive)
a. Handling day to day logistics operations and interacting with different teams warehouse, finance, retail stores.
b. Monitor dispatch to deliver TAT and prepare the action plan for further improvement.
c. Conduct Weekly performance meetings with LPs to provide feedback.
d. Proactive actions on the basis of data analysis.
e. Identify the stuck shipments and provide Tat for tail shipments.
f. Dispatch to in transit delays.
g. Manage non delivery related issues.
h. Marketplace operations closure.
i. Shipment cycle closure.
j. Generating SCM reports.
k. Reverse pickups handling and monitoring.

Job Title: Manager Strategy Consulting (Corporate Deals Technology)
Department: PwC Acceleration Center – Strategy Consulting
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Overview:

Join PwC’s Corporate Deals Technology (CDT) team to partner with global corporate clients and drive technology strategy that fuels business value and deal success in complex M&A transactions. Our CDT practice leverages deep industry knowledge and thought leadership to deliver consulting services focused on the technology elements of the value chain, enabling scalable and profitable business transformations.
As part of the Strategy platform, CDT supports corporate clients across industries by:

Developing M&A Technology Strategies for integrations, separations, carve-outs, and divestitures through collaboration with C-suite executives.
Conducting Technology Due Diligence to assess IT landscapes, identify risks, and uncover value creation opportunities.
Advising on Integration and Divestiture Planning to align technology strategies with business and operational goals.
Designing Future-State Technology Models and Architectures that support strategic objectives.

Key Responsibilities:
As a Manager, you will lead a team of experienced consultants solving complex business challenges from strategy through execution. Your responsibilities will include:
Leading and supporting teams across the deal spectrum, including IT due diligence, integration, and separation activities.
Managing project delivery, guiding teams, and engaging in client and leadership communication.
Overseeing solution design and implementation, ensuring high quality deliverables within timeline and budget.
Planning and developing integration and separation plans covering Day One readiness, business process, and systems alignment.
Developing financial models related to IT synergies, one-time costs, standalone operations, and stranded costs.
Recommending enterprise architecture, solutions, and systems informed by industry best practices and past experience.
Advising on IT integration, separation, and carve-out strategies across various IT domains.
Mentoring and coaching senior associates and associates to consistently deliver impactful work.
Contributing to business development initiatives by identifying and researching opportunities with new and existing clients.
Building strong internal relationships and strengthening your personal brand within PwC.

Preferred Knowledge & Skills:

Must-Have:

Proven experience in IT M&A including IT due diligence, integration, separation planning, and execution.
Expertise in IT Strategy and Digital Transformation initiatives.
Technical proficiency in key IT pillars such as Application Rationalization, Infrastructure/Cloud Strategy, Cybersecurity, and ERP Transformation.
Demonstrated ability to lead large teams through end-to-end client engagements.
Strong project management, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
Solid data and cost modeling capabilities.
Proficiency in leveraging Generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT) for efficient research and analysis.

Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

Description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Python Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Python-based test automation and SAP business process automation.
The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing, enhancing and maintaining automated test cases using an existing Python automation framework. The role involves automating SAP GUI transactions and SAP Fiori workflows, developing reusable automation components, and supporting end-to-end automation across various SAP business processes.
The candidate should have hands-on experience in Python programming, SAP S/4HANA automation, SAP GUI and Fiori, along with a strong understanding of automation frameworks and software testing methodologies.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and automate new SAP business test cases using the existing Python automation framework.
Enhance and maintain reusable Python components, transaction classes, workflows, subflows and automation utilities.
Automate SAP GUI transactions and SAP Fiori workflows wherever applicable.
Develop end-to-end automation solutions across Procurement, Sales, Inventory, Finance and other SAP business processes.
Maintain and enhance regression, smoke and integration automation test suites.
Identify, debug and resolve automation failures to improve test stability and execution efficiency.
Improve synchronization, logging, reporting and error-handling mechanisms within the automation framework.
Follow coding standards and best practices, conduct code reviews and validate changes to prevent regressions.
Collaborate with SAP functional consultants, QA teams and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into reliable automation solutions.
Support continuous improvement of automation frameworks, utilities and testing processes.

Required Skills & Experience

Strong hands-on experience in Python programming and automation development.
Experience in SAP S/4HANA automation and SAP business process testing.
Hands-on experience automating SAP GUI transactions.
Experience with SAP Fiori-based workflow automation.
Good understanding of Python automation frameworks and reusable component development.
Experience developing and maintaining automated test scripts and workflows.
Knowledge of regression testing, smoke testing and integration testing.
Ability to debug automation scripts and troubleshoot execution failures.
Understanding of SAP business processes such as Procurement, Sales, Inventory and Finance.
Strong problem-solving, analytical and debugging skills.
Good communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Skills

Experience with Pytest, Selenium, Robot Framework or similar automation tools.
Knowledge of SAP GUI Scripting API.
Exposure to PyAutoGUI or other desktop automation libraries.
Experience with SAP Fiori and SAP Gateway.
Knowledge of API automation and integration testing.
Experience working with reusable automation frameworks and test utilities.
Exposure to Agile development and testing methodologies.

Interested candidates can share their Cvs to namrata.dutta@mindseek.net.

Thanks & Regards
Namrata Dutta

SAP GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer Job Description and Summary We are seeking a passionate and skilled SAP GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer with 9+ years of overall experience, including hands-on experience working with SAP environments and a minimum of 9 years in Generative AI (GenAI). The ideal candidate will combine an understanding of SAP applications, data, integrations, and technical landscapes with strong hands-on expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Python, and modern AI engineering frameworks. The AI Engineer will play a key role in designing, building, and deploying enterprise-grade AI solutions and accelerators that address SAP transformation and delivery use cases. Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy GenAI and Agentic AI solutions for SAP and enterprise use cases, with a strong focus on production readiness.
Build and scale RAG-based solutions using SAP and enterprise data, documentation, technical artifacts, and knowledge repositories.
Develop AI-powered accelerators supporting SAP use cases such as:
SAP custom code analysis and modernization
Functional and technical specification analysis
SAP configuration and documentation analysis
Code generation, review, and validation
Test case generation and automation
Data mapping and data validation
SAP API and integration recommendations
Impact analysis and knowledge assistants
Integrate LLM solutions with SAP applications, APIs, services, and enterprise data sources.
Build and integrate graph-based memory, tool-using agents, and context-aware AI solutions.
Implement multi-agent orchestration and reasoning workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, LangChain, or custom agent frameworks.
Develop clean, efficient, reusable, and scalable Python-based AI services and APIs.
Work with cloud-based LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.
Collaborate with SAP functional, technical, data, integration, and business teams to translate business requirements into scalable AI-powered solutions.
Implement evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, relevance, groundedness, hallucination, performance, and reliability of AI solutions.
Apply strong software engineering practices covering version control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, security, and maintainability.
Support deployment and operation of AI solutions in enterprise production environments.
Required Qualifications
47 years of overall experience in software engineering, SAP technology, AI/ML, or related technology areas.
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI solutions.
Prior experience working within SAP environments or on SAP transformation/implementation programs.
Understanding of the SAP ecosystem, SAP business applications, data structures, APIs, integrations, and technical artifacts.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs such as OpenAI GPT models, Claude, Gemini, or equivalent models.
Strong hands-on knowledge of RAG architectures and Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent frameworks.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Experience building APIs, microservices, containers, and cloud-native applications.
Experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
Experience with tool calling, agent orchestration, graph-based memory, or memory-augmented AI architectures.
Understanding of prompt engineering, context management, grounding, and hallucination mitigation.
Solid understanding of software engineering practices including Git/version control, testing, CI/CD, and code quality.
Ability to work effectively with SAP technical and functional teams and translate SAP requirements into AI engineering solutions.
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on experience with one or more SAP technologies such as ABAP, CDS, RAP, SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, SAP APIs/OData, or SAP HANA.
Experience building AI solutions or accelerators specifically for SAP use cases.
Understanding of SAP S/4HANA transformation and Clean Core principles.
Experience integrating AI solutions with SAP BTP or SAP S/4HANA.
Experience with Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or other enterprise LLM platforms.
Experience with tool-using agents, multi-agent systems, memory-augmented architectures, or cognitive architectures.
Experience with LLM evaluation, optimization, observability, and production monitoring.
Prior contributions to open-source GenAI or agent frameworks are advantageous.
Experience deploying and maintaining AI systems at enterprise scale.
Mandatory Skill Sets
Generative AI (GenAI)
Agentic AI
Python
RAG and LLM application development
SAP experience/background

Role & responsibilities
We are seeking an experienced SAP Change Management Lead to govern SAP changes, releases and transports across the landscape, ensuring controlled delivery, business continuity and compliance with ITIL, SOX and security requirements.
Key Responsibilities
SAP Change Management:
Oversee and manage SAP system changes, ensuring they align with business and compliance requirements.
Define and implement change control processes for SAP applications.
Work closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, and third-party vendors to evaluate, approve, and schedule changes.
Release Management:
Develop and manage the SAP release calendar to ensure seamless deployment of changes.
Plan and coordinate SAP upgrades, patches, and enhancements.
Ensure proper documentation and testing for all releases to minimize disruptions.
Governance & Compliance:
Ensure adherence to IT policies, regulatory requirements, and SAP best practices.
Implement ITIL-based change and release processes, ensuring compliance with audit and security policies.
Manage risk assessments and impact analyses for all SAP changes.
Collaboration & Communication:
Act as a liaison between business, IT, and SAP functional teams to coordinate change implementations.
Provide regular updates and reports on change and release activities to leadership and stakeholders.
Drive continuous improvement in SAP change and release management processes.

Required Skills & Leadership Capabilities

SAP Change Tools: Hands-on experience with SAP Solution Manager ChaRM and Rev-Trac for change control, workflow, approvals, audit trail and release governance.
Transport Management: Strong knowledge of SAP Transport Management System, transport sequencing, dependency management, import coordination, conflict resolution, retrofit and emergency transports.
ITIL & Governance: Strong understanding of ITIL change enablement, release management, CAB governance, risk and impact assessment, change models, emergency change control, PIR and continual improvement.
SOX Compliance: Ability to ensure segregation of duties, approvals, evidence retention, testing and deployment traceability, and readiness for internal and external audits.
SAP GRC: Working knowledge of SAP GRC Access Control, role and access risks, SoD controls and coordination with security teams is preferred.
Leadership: Lead CAB and release readiness reviews, manage escalations and change conflicts, coach coordinators, define governance metrics, analyse failed and unauthorised changes, and present risks, trends and improvement actions to senior stakeholders.
Stakeholder Management: Strong communication, decision-making and coordination skills across business, application, Basis, security, infrastructure and vendor teams.

Description:
Job Summary
Hitachi Energy India Development Centre (IDC) is a research and development facility with around 500 RD engineers, specialists, and experts, who focus on creating and sustaining digital solutions, new products and technology. This includes product integration, testing, cybersecurity, and certification. The India Development Centre is situated in Chennai and Bangalore. IDC collaborates with the RD and Research centers of Hitachi Energy, which are spread across more than 15 locations throughout 12 countries. In the past 20 years, IDC has secured more than 200 international papers and 150+ patents. Responsible to conduct and manage product development, type tests and design improvements related to Electrical aspects of product design, across the GPQSS range to ensure the product portfolio remains at the forefront of technology. Including but not limited to performance improvements, cost reductions, increased manufacturability, and new application/new market developments.
Responsibilities
Leading RD activities. Collaborate with the team to design and develop electrical systems and products. For designing, hands-on experience of software like DS-E3 is one of the advantageous requirements.
Integrate electrical components and systems and conduct testing to ensure functionality and performance. To be willing to learn electrical complex systems and passionate about working with cutting edge technology.
Work closely with product line cross functional teams located across geographical regions. This includes functions such as SCM, manufacturing/production, service, engineering, sales, project management, product management.
Create and maintain technical documentation, including design documentation, test procedures, product manuals.
Actively engage with global market and industry representatives to ensure market trends are noted and where applicable identify future development project opportunities. Have thorough understanding of competitor offerings.
Ensures alignment with assigned project development targets (time, cost, quality) and coordinates with the project team involved in specific RD activities.
Capacity to generate new ideas for improvement and develop innovative solutions to enhance existing products, services or processes.
Ability to think creatively and develop novel solutions to complex problems. Takes initiative to identify opportunities for innovation and proposes solutions.
Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Qualifications
Required master's degree in EEE/Power system/Power electronics from reputed institution. Hands-on experience in the field of RD new product/prototype development and type testing.
Preparation of electrical design schematics, product manual, hardware specification, software specification and power system calculation. Selection and finalization of electrical-electronics components, cables, converters, auxiliary equipment etc. for any LV or MV product integration.
Familiarity with industrial communication protocol enabled products. Having ability of selection, assembly, and testing (Hardware and software both). Knowledge of protocols like Modbus TCP/IP, CAN, Profibus, Ethernet/IP, PROFINET.
Knowledge of relevant standards such as IEC, UL, SAE, IEEE. Knowledge of product safety and cyber security. Detailed knowledge and work experience with products like multi-winding power transformers, power converters, FACTS equipment, harmonic filters, DC or AC charging systems for battery charging in MW range, ESS(energy storage systems).
Preferred candidate is with work experience in the field/fields E-mobility product AC/DC charging side / STATCOM/LV-MV electrical projects in MW range/renewable energy product in MW range like BESS, wind or solar system etc. DS-E3, AutoCAD, MATLAB, ETAP
Ability to work with global large teams, stress-tolerant, Strategic thinking. Proficiency in both spoken written English language is required.

Job Overview
We are looking for an experienced Senior / Lead QA Playwright Automation Engineer to design, develop, and maintain robust automation solutions for web and mobile applications. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Playwright, API automation, SQL, cross-browser testing, and modern test automation frameworks.
The candidate will work closely with development, product, and QA teams in an Agile environment, contribute to quality engineering strategies, and provide technical leadership to ensure the delivery of high-quality software.

Shift Timing: 12.00 PM 10.00 PM
Work Type: Hybrid 3 days WFO
Work Location: Chennai / Hyderabad / Bangalore / Pune / Coimbatore

Key Requirements:
510 years of professional experience in software quality assurance and test automation for web and mobile applications.
Minimum 23 years of hands-on experience with Playwright is must.
Strong programming experience in at least one language such as Java, JavaScript, TypeScript.
Proven ability to design and build test automation frameworks from scratch and select appropriate tools and frameworks based on project requirements.
Strong experience in API automation testing using REST Assured.
Good knowledge of relational databases with the ability to write complex SQL queries using Oracle Database or other relational databases.
Hands-on experience with cross-browser testing and automation using platforms such as BrowserStack and Sauce Labs.
Experience with functional, regression, integration, and API testing.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies, CI/CD practices, and modern software development processes.
Knowledge of Git/GitHub and version-control best practices is good to have.
Exposure to Generative AI/GenAI tools and applications is an added advantage.

Roles and Responsibilities:
Develop, maintain, and enhance scalable test automation frameworks for web and mobile applications.
Create and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright and appropriate programming languages.
Design and execute functional, regression, integration, and API automation tests.
Develop and maintain API automation suites using REST Assured.
Write and execute complex SQL queries to validate backend data and application workflows.
Perform cross-browser and cross-platform testing using BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, or similar solutions.
Identify opportunities to improve test coverage, automation efficiency, reliability, and maintainability.
Define, track, analyze, and report Quality Engineering metrics.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous testing practices.
Analyze test failures, troubleshoot issues, investigate defects, and work closely with developers to drive resolution.
Collaborate with product managers, developers, business analysts, and other QA engineers in a fast-paced Agile/Scrum environment.
Provide technical leadership in automation strategy, framework architecture, and testing best practices.
Mentor and guide junior QA engineers and contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives.
Participate in test planning, estimation, risk assessment, and release readiness activities.
Continuously evaluate and introduce modern testing tools, technologies, and best practices.
Preferred Skills
Knowledge of Git/GitHub, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
Exposure to GenAI-based testing tools and productivity solutions.
Knowledge in Healthcare domain is added advantage.
