Job Title Project Management Specialist - Specialist - ACS Song

Management Level: Level 9 - Specialist

Location: Kochi

Must have skills: Agile Project Management

Good to have skills: Project Budget Detailing and Resourcing Experience

Experience: 5-7 years of hands-on experience in project management

Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)

Job Summary
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Project Manager for delivering IT projects on time, within scope, and within budget. In this role, you will have a strong ownership in ensuring project efficiency by engaging in stakeholder communication, preparing and maintain project plans, identifying and mitigating risks, planning tasks and managing schedules, maintaining documentation, and facilitating communication across teams. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including software developers, QA testers, and business stakeholders to help drive project success in a fast-paced tech environment.

Roles and Responsibilities
Define project scope, objectives, milestones, deliverables, and success criteria in collaboration with business and technical stakeholders
Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering schedule, resources, dependencies, risks, and budget
Lead execution across all project phases including initiation, planning, delivery, UAT, deployment, and closure
Track project progress using appropriate tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project, Confluence) and ensure timely delivery
Own project tracking - timelines, effort, budget, and burn rates
Identify variances early and implement corrective actions to minimize delivery risk
Ensure deliverables meet agreed quality standards through defined acceptance criteria and governance checks
Support forecasting, invoicing, and financial reporting as required
Act as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment
Provide regular status reports, dashboards, and executive summaries to leadership and clients
Proactively manage expectations, escalations, and decisionmaking forums
Facilitate effective communication across distributed and crossfunctional teams
Identify, document, and monitor project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies (RAID)
Define and track mitigation and contingency plans
Manage scope changes through a controlled change management process, assessing impact on cost, schedule, and quality
Ensure all changes are formally reviewed, approved, and communicated
Coordinate internal and external resources, ensuring clarity of roles, responsibilities, and priorities
Facilitate Agile ceremonies (where applicable) such as sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and daily standups
Drive accountability within the team to meet commitments
Ensure adherence to organizational delivery standards, processes, and compliance requirements
Capture lessons learned and identify opportunities for improving delivery effectiveness
Contribute to PMO or practicelevel initiatives such as process improvements, templates, and best practices
Support mentoring or guidance of junior project coordinators or Scrum Masters where required



Qualification

Professional and Technical Skills
Handson experience managing IT or digital projects
Proven experience delivering projects in Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery models
Strong understanding of SDLC, system integration, and enterprise IT environments
Experience managing budgets, schedules, and crossfunctional teams
Ability to put creative and analytical thinking abilities into practice.
Good communication and collaboration skills with written language skills.
Exposure in working with global clients is an added advantage.

Summary:
The Field Sales Executive plays a vital role in driving business expansion within the paint-chemical industry by cultivating strong, lasting relationships with key trade partners, including painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. The opportunity
The position is for the team within EY Brand, Marketing and Communications in GDS team and will be aligned to the Communications and Engagement pillar.
This position will work with our stakeholder team to manage communications data, create insightful reports and dashboards to make communications more data driven and manage CE channels.
Your key responsibilities
Timely and accurate addition of all data for delivered communications to the Management Information Application (MIA).
Creation of metrics reports for all communications activities, showcasing function performance in PowerPoint presentations to help stakeholders make informed decisions.
Operational support for communication dissemination on EY channels of communication and SharePoint.
Coordinate the setup of leadership emails for delivery via Broadcast Center (tool specific to EY).
Develop toolkits for the stakeholder on Modern SharePoint.
Assist with the creation of metrics reports for multiple functions using PowerPoint.
Handle logistics and provide operational support for webcasts on platforms like Kaltura and MS Teams.
Create, maintain, and update distribution lists using the One Access tool.
Submit tickets to the BMC ticketing system for updates on the intranet and Broadcast Center.
Interact and collaborate with internal teams on multiple projects.
Skills and attributes for success
Support EY brand, understand, implement, and strictly adhere to the quality standards and procedures established by EY, including verbal and branding guidelines
Pursue and share best practices within the team
Demonstrate eye for detail and ensure all deliverables are of high quality
To qualify for the role, you must have
Overall 8-10 years’ experience and 7-9 years’ CE experience
Graduate – Bachelor’s or master’s degree – preferably in English literature/Mass communication/Journalism
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly PowerPoint and SharePoint.
Familiarity with Broadcast Center, One Access, and other relevant communication tools.
Strong organizational and project management skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ideally, you’ll also have
Business acumen to understand the leadership strategy and translate it in the deliverables prepared
Eagerness and be a fast learner who is willing to expand on core skills
Technologies and Tools
MS Office – Word, PowerPoint and Excel
Desirable – Content CMS, communications analytics, SharePoint, Adobe Analytics

Analytics acumen
Research skill
Communication Skills (Comprehend, Verbal & Written)
Listening Skills
Result Oriented
Time Management
Customer Focus
Personal Learning & Development
Planning and organizing

At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
GDS ES Finance - Controlling -Senior Associate- Financial Planning and Analysis
We provide reporting solutions/requirements through finance, markets and operations reporting along with cyclical and critical controlling processes such as Forecasting, Financial Planning, Revenue Planning, Markets Leadership Planning and Cash Reporting to help you take better business decisions. With projects like Mercury, we also support business transformation, and we are continuing to expand our services to support all Regions with their reporting and analytics needs.
Your key responsibilities
Responsible for Planning, Budgeting and Outlook exercise for Global functions
Holding discussions with the Budget Holders (Business Controller Role)
Provide timely reporting of actual operating expenses and headcount variances to budget subservice line wise. Analyse and explain spend variances to budget
Forecast Operational and Cost analysis for business decision making
Responsible for Preparing High level Analysis report for the Leadership (Both in the Business Controller Role and the Business Analyst Role)
Present the monthly and quarterly financial reports of various units and departments
Responsible for meeting agreed Service Level Agreements (SLA) on Turn Around Time (TAT) Accuracy
Review and delivery of high level reports to EYG Leadership on a regular/ ad-hoc basis
Should be able to individually work on and present key reports/ analysis to senior Finance Leadership
Review and Approval of invoices at Finance Level
Co-ordination with GL, AP, Billing and Treasury teams to address the queries from client
Own review of EYG books of accounts
Act as a finance consultant to Global Finance controllers/ clients to maintain the accounts
Ensure delivery of monthly reporting packs to key stake holders
Manage, develop and implement the aspects of quality compliance and accuracy attributes
Review the existing quality processes and procedures and provide suggestions for improvement in business processes for efficient functioning
Work on internal projects and drive the team to deliver goods on those projects
Confer with clients to discuss and resolve matters such as complaints and implementation problems
Interact with customers and clients to understand requirements, set expectations, address concerns, and discuss them with senior leadership
Plan, organize and direct transition activities
Effectively manage escalations
Develop back up plan and focus on cross training the team
Manage and ensure effective transition of process by scheduling project inputs, assigning resources and responsibilities
Skills and attributes for success
Possess strong communication skill
Strong Presentation skills
Problem Solving skills
Have logical and analytical skill
Be decisive on real time basis
People management skill
Have good business knowledge
Business acumen and process insights
Ability to learn and demonstrates expert knowledge of EY financial priorities, processes, budgeting and accounting cycle
Ability to learn and demonstrate strong awareness of all the major sources of cost and revenue in the Global entities
Operates successfully on controlling and accounting engagements crossing multiple sub-functions within Global Finance team
Strategic thinking and continuous improvement
Demonstrate executive presence while discussing, refining and finalizing issue definitions with decision-makers, where necessary achieving consensus between differing viewpoints.
Define business problems and apply structured approach to gather data and conduct financial analysis that drives strategic decision making
Lead the storyboarding to explain complex issues and present solution options and implications simply and clearly
Help transform data effectively and efficiently into meaningful insights that underpin the strategic objectives of the Working Capital team
Client focused:
Drives interactions that build trust
Ability to operate and influence at a Global level, across cultures and locations
Operate effectively in a matrix management structure
Collaborates and teams with finance colleagues and other functions to enhance service to clients, and to leverage leading practices.
Able to embed ECS (Exceptional Client Service)
To qualify for the role, you must have
Master s in Finance and Accounting with 3-5 years of experience in core finance
Relevant experience in Financial Planning and Analysis
Professional qualifications (such as CA / CPA, CGMA, CFA) are preferred
Advanced Excel Knowledge
Strong accounting Knowledge
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY FA practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world

Report any site deviations that could affect modular furniture installation.
Ensure measurement and marking activities are completed within project timelines.

Capture site photographs and relevant measurements.

Highlight deviations, pending work, and technical concerns.

Summary
Account Manager (AM) is involved in strategic planning, relationship management at a global scale, and innovation in go-to-market approaches. The AM is responsible for enabling the execution of account growth strategies and serving as a central point of contact to facilitate global team connectivity, focusing on revenue growth and account management excellence across one or more accounts. Manage select key deal pursuits; may assist with connection to pursuit resources for proposal responses.
Co-develop and deliver account onboarding for new leadership and team members.

Champion the effective utilization of established in-house technologies, providing persuasive insights and hands-on guidance to senior personnel.
Utilize firm tools for relationship mapping, white spot analysis, and innovation initiatives to drive growth.


Professional Experience
10+ years in a professional services firm with sales enablement experience preferred.

Proven success in leading complex projects with minimal supervision.
Sector relevant focus a plus (e.g., life sciences, technology, wealth management, consumer, energy, etc.).

Soft Skills
Executive-level communication and consultative skills.
Networking and emotional intelligence.
Ability to navigate ambiguity with agility and entrepreneurial spirit.
Proactive and comfortable taking the initiative in a low-guidance environment.


Technical Skills
Microsoft BI user experience.
Microsoft Excel.
PowerPoint.
SharePoint.


Desirable Skills
Negotiations with internal stakeholders and peers

Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Job Summary

Supervising Associate - Netting and Settlement
Lead the day-to-day delivery of the NetPay netting and settlement process, ensuring accurate reconciliation of intercompany balances, timely settlement, strong controls and a consistent service experience for participating EY member firms. The role combines operational ownership with people leadership, member-firm onboarding, stakeholder management, escalation management and continuous improvement.


Key responsibilities
NetPay operations and settlement delivery
Own and coordinate daily NetPay operations across participating member firms, ensuring activities are completed accurately, on time and in line with agreed controls and service expectations.
Oversee the review and matching of intercompany invoices and open positions across AP and AR, ensuring completeness, consistency and timely resolution of discrepancies.
Coordinate the identification and exchange of missing documents and support member firms in correcting mismatches, disputed invoices and other exceptions.
Review periodic netting and payment calculations and confirm that settlement outputs are complete, accurate and appropriately validated before circulation.
Monitor member-firm payment execution and support the correct application and clearing of receipts and payments.
Maintain operational trackers, reconciliations, evidence and process documentation to support transparency, control and audit readiness.
Member-firm onboarding and adoption
Partner with member firms to onboard them into NetPay, from initial engagement and process assessment through readiness, testing, implementation and transition to business-as-usual operations.
Explain NetPay requirements, roles, timelines, controls, data and documentation expectations to local Finance, AP, AR, Treasury and Controlling stakeholders.
Develop onboarding plans, track dependencies and risks, and coordinate actions across the central netting team and member-firm stakeholders.
Facilitate onboarding workshops, process walkthroughs and knowledge-transfer sessions; provide post-go-live support and stabilize operations.
Monitor adoption and compliance after onboarding, address gaps and promote consistent use of the standard NetPay process.
Team management and capability development
Provide day-to-day direction, work allocation and prioritization for the Netting and Settlement team, balancing operational deadlines, onboarding activity and improvement initiatives.
Review team output for quality, completeness and timeliness; provide practical coaching and feedback to strengthen technical and stakeholder-management capability.
Ensure adequate coverage, effective handovers and clear ownership of recurring activities, exceptions and follow-ups.
Create an inclusive, collaborative environment that encourages accountability, knowledge sharing, continuous learning and proactive problem solving.
Identify training needs, maintain process knowledge and support the development of subject-matter expertise and succession capability within the team.
Stakeholder and escalation management
Act as the primary operational point of contact for participating member firms and central stakeholders on NetPay, netting and settlement matters.
Build effective working relationships across geographies and functions, align expectations and provide clear, concise updates on operational status, risks, issues and decisions required.
Manage escalations relating to unmatched items, missing documents, disputed invoices, delayed payments, process non-compliance and service delivery concerns.
Perform root-cause analysis, agree corrective actions with relevant stakeholders and monitor actions through closure.
Escalate material risks and unresolved issues to leadership promptly, supported by facts, impact assessment and recommended next steps.
Quality, controls and process improvement
Drive a strong quality and control culture through defined review checks, exception monitoring, ageing analysis and timely corrective action.
Identify recurring issues, control gaps, manual effort and process bottlenecks; translate observations into practical improvement initiatives.
Lead or support standardization, simplification and automation opportunities that improve accuracy, cycle time, transparency and stakeholder experience.
Define and monitor relevant operational measures, quality indicators and action plans; use data and trends to prioritize improvement opportunities.
Maintain standard operating procedures, process maps, control documentation and other governance materials so they remain current and usable.
Support internal and external audit requirements relating to intercompany netting and settlement, including timely provision of evidence and resolution of observations.
Reporting and governance
Prepare and review weekly operational reporting for participating member firms, providing visibility of invoice status, exceptions, ageing, pending actions and key risks.
Provide regular management updates covering delivery performance, onboarding progress, escalations, quality, improvement initiatives and decisions required.
Facilitate operational governance calls and ensure actions, owners and target dates are clearly documented and followed through.
Ensure compliance with applicable accounting requirements, EY policies, legal requirements and locally agreed operating procedures.


To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a related field.
Relevant experience in intercompany accounting, AP, AR, financial accounting, netting, settlement, treasury operations or a comparable finance process.

Description:
The opportunity
We are looking for Managers with strong experience in global payroll advisory, transformation and implementation to join the PC team. The role will lead complex, multi-country payroll engagements, advise clients on payroll strategy, operating models, technology and service delivery, and manage diverse teams across global locations. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading global professional services organisation while contributing to the growth of the PC payroll practice.


Your Key Responsibilities:
Grow the GDS payroll consulting practice through strong collaboration, relationship building and integrated solutioning with EY global offices.
Lead multi-country payroll advisory and transformation engagements from assessment, strategy and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment and stabilisation.
Advise clients on payroll operating models, process harmonisation, governance, controls, compliance, vendor strategy, shared services and outsourcing options.
Lead payroll technology-enabled transformation involving integrations across HCM, payroll, workforce management, finance and third-party systems.
Provide subject matter direction across payroll inputs, gross-to-net processing, statutory deductions, remittances, garnishments, time and attendance, payroll accounting and reporting.
Manage project scope, workplans, resources, budgets, risks, dependencies, quality and engagement economics, ensuring timely delivery and effective escalation management.
Lead requirements workshops, current-state assessments, fit-gap analysis, future-state process design and the preparation of business requirements and solution design documentation.
Oversee data migration, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, payroll parallel runs, reconciliation, cutover, go-live and hypercare.
Establish effective client governance, executive reporting and stakeholder communication across global and country teams, vendors and functional workstreams.
Support business development through solutioning, proposals, effort estimation, client presentations, credentials and development of payroll thought leadership and reusable assets.
Build and coach high-performing teams, set objectives, provide timely feedback and support capability development and career progression.
Implement internal processes to achieve practice objectives relating to quality, productivity, utilisation, headcount growth and market penetration.


Skills and attributes for success
Strong consulting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex payroll challenges into practical recommendations and implementation plans.
Sound understanding of end-to-end payroll processes, controls, statutory compliance, payroll accounting and global delivery models.
Ability to lead complex engagements, manage ambiguity and balance strategic priorities with hands-on delivery.
Strong client-facing, stakeholder management, facilitation, communication and presentation skills.
Commercial awareness, including experience in project planning, effort estimation, budgeting, risk management and engagement economics.
Ability to manage multiple engagements and geographically distributed teams simultaneously.
Strong quality orientation, attention to detail and commitment to meeting delivery timelines.
Cross-cultural awareness and the ability to work effectively with global and country stakeholders.
High integrity, adaptability and willingness to travel nationally and internationally for approved client projects.


Ideally, you ll also have
Experience leading payroll strategy, maturity assessment, operating model, vendor assessment, implementation, transformation or managed-services engagements.
Experience designing payroll delivery options, including consolidation, outsourcing, shared services and technology-enabled process improvement.
Practical experience across requirements, process design, data migration, integrations, testing, parallel payroll, reconciliation, cutover and hyper care.
Experience with payroll and HCM technologies such as Workday, SAP HCM, SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll, Dayforce, ADP GlobalView, ADP Celergo, Oracle or PeopleSoft.
Understanding of Workday-to-payroll, SAP-to-payroll, time-to-payroll and payroll-to-finance integration concepts, including data mapping, interface controls and error management.
Experience with workforce management and time-and-attendance platforms such as Dayforce, UKG/Kronos or Workforce Software.

Description:
As a Technical Superintendent at BSM, you will be responsible for providing end-to-end technical and operational oversight of assigned vessels, ensuring safe, compliant, and cost-efficient ship management. The role plays a critical part in connecting ship and shore by acting as the primary technical point of contact for vessels, clients, and external stakeholders, while supporting BSM s strategic objectives, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement of fleet performance.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver contractual ship management services in line with customer agreements, ensuring vessels meet required technical and operational standards
Act as the primary technical contact for Masters and Chief Engineers, providing guidance on safety, maintenance, drydock planning, critical equipment, and non-routine repairs
Maintain close communication with clients on technical, operational, and budgetary matters, building effective working relationships
Monitor vessel machinery, equipment performance, and maintenance execution to enhance safety, reliability, energy efficiency, and operational performance
Develop, implement, and monitor maintenance, repair, and drydocking plans, ensuring timely execution within approved budgets
Prepare, control, and report technical and OPEX budgets for assigned vessels
Ensure vessels maintain valid certification and comply with all applicable maritime legislation
Plan, conduct, and follow up on vessel visits, inspections, audits, and surveys
Coach, mentor, and support shipboard personnel, including performance reviews, interviews, and contribution to career development
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, or equivalent, or a valid Chief Engineer s Certificate
Minimum of three years sailing experience as a senior officer, or three years shore-based experience as a technical superintendent within a ship management or owning company
Experience on LPG/VLGC vessels with ME Engine working experience
Skills & Competencies
Leadership and people management skills with a coaching and mentoring mindset
High level of organisation, attention to detail, and problem-solving ability
Team-oriented, proactive, and safety-focused approach
Fluency in English and solid computer literacy
Why You Should Join Us!
We offer a supportive environment, competitive compensation, and meaningful opportunities. By joining us, you will enjoy:
On-the-job training
First-hand exposure to the growing maritime technological industry
Diverse workforce
Technology-driven company
Be a part of the ever-growing Schulte group family

Designation: Associate/Senior Associate Customer Service
Experience: 0 - 6 years
Location: Trivandrum
Skill Required: Excellent communication skill, Word, Excel and Outlook
Education: GCSE Level or equivalent

The Associate Customer Service representative is responsible for delivering exceptional customer support through inbound calls and web-chat channels. The role involves assisting new and existing customers with insurance products, handling policy-related queries, supporting sales activities, and providing efficient after-sales service while ensuring a positive customer experience.

Key Responsibilities
Handle inbound customer calls and web-chat interactions professionally and efficiently.
Assist prospective customers by providing product information, quotations, and support for motor and home insurance products.
Support sales activities by guiding customers through the policy purchase process using internal systems and underwriting guidelines.
Identify customer needs and provide appropriate solutions while maintaining service quality standards.
Deliver a positive and professional customer experience across all touchpoints.
Resolve customer queries efficiently while adhering to company policies and procedures.
Escalate complex issues to appropriate teams when necessary.
Meet established service, quality, and productivity targets.
Work collaboratively with team members to achieve departmental goals.
Participate in training programs and continuously update product and process knowledge.
Support a culture of continuous improvement and customer-centric service delivery.

Required Skills & Competencies
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.
Ability to learn and use internal customer service and insurance systems effectively.
Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with customers.
Self-motivated and proactive approach to work.
Good organizational and time-management skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced and target-driven environment.

Description:
EY-Process & Controls Risk Consulting – O&G Upstream Senior
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be supporting the Team in client engagements related to Risk Management, Internal Audit, GRC solutions for various clients across the MENA region. The client base spans across various sectors and includes collaboration with other teams within Consulting services.
The opportunity
We’re looking for experienced professionals with experience in the Energy sector and Internal Audit/ Risk to join our Process & Controls Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering. This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the beautiful state of Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
Your key responsibilities
The current role requires executing internal audit and other risk consulting engagements for energy companies. As part of the role, the candidate is expected to:
Assist in executing client engagements and meeting the expectations of the client and the onsite team within the MENA region.
Support in performing end-to-end internal audits from planning to reporting including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrix / audit work program, control testing to assess their design and operating effectiveness, preparation of audit report and agreeing issues/ actions with management.
Have an in-depth understanding of the Oil & Gas upstream industry risks/ issues / trends and end-to-end business processes.
Have thorough knowledge and understanding of Internal Audit methodology and IIA requirements.
Deliver engagements to time, cost and high quality.
Identify key areas of improvement in the client's business processes and add value by preparing insightful recommendations.
Contribute to business development activities such as preparing proposals, lead identification
Always comply with the firm’s quality and risk management policies
Manage multiple assignments and related project teams.
Maintain excellent rapport and proactive communication with the client
Skills and attributes for success
Exceptional command on spoken and written English
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at a short notice
Highly analytical, organised and meticulous consulting skills
Demonstrating and applying strong project management skills, inspiring teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members
Ability to multi-task, work well under pressure with commitment to deliver under tight deadline
Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize effectively
Attention to detail and quality assurance
Proficient in MS-Office Suite, data analysis & validation
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor’s degree in engineering with specialisation in Oil & Gas or relevant professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CIA.
PMP certification holders will be preferred
Experience in Internal Audit /Risk Management with Oil & Gas upstream sector focus or working in Oil and Gas Drilling and / or Oil Field Service Companies, or Exploration & Production (E&P) Companies or working as Drilling Engineers, Rig Foreman, or in Warehousing and Logistics for Drilling Operations.
Experience leading or supporting risk-based internal audits across upstream operations, including drilling and well operations, rig management, production operations, workover activities, petroleum engineering processes, drilling materials and inventory management, supply chain and logistics, contract management, HSE compliance.
Knowledge of key upstream business and operational processes, including Exploration & Appraisal activities, Field Development Planning, Work Programs & Budgets (WP&B), Authorization for Expenditure (AFE), Petroleum Cost Recovery, Joint Venture (JV) Accounting, Cost Allocations, Affiliate and Related Party Charges, Production Allocation, Reservoir Management, and Hydrocarbon Measurement controls.
Experience evaluating operational and financial controls related to drilling campaigns, rig utilization, non-productive time (NPT), well costs, contractor performance, procurement and contracting, warehousing and drilling materials management, inventory controls, logistics operations, and production reporting.
Strong understanding of Process Safety Management (PSM), Health, Safety & Environment (HSE), Well Integrity Management, Asset Integrity, Reliability Engineering, and applicable industry standards and frameworks (e.g., API, IADC, ISO 55000, OSHA PSM, IWCF/IADC well control requirements, and other upstream industry standards).
A minimum of 4 years of relevant work experience
A valid passport for travel.
Internal Audit Software Such as Teammate and ERP Exposure such as SAP, Oracle to extract reports (contracting/procurement/material management modules).

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Clients & Industries: Global C&I Strategic Operations Support
About EY
At EY, we re all in to shape your future with confidence. Join EY and help build a better working world. We ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
The Opportunity
Global Operations Support plays a key role in supporting operational excellence across the Clients & Industries (C&I) organization. This role focuses on enabling strategic priorities, optimizing processes, and facilitating collaboration across domains, functions, and pods to deliver agility and impact.
The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.
This position sits within the Business Enablement - Business Management Office which supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.
Success in this model depends on agility - the ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.
The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the rest of the Domain team. This position works directly with the Operations Senior Specialist or Operations Specialist.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Operations
Manage and execute domain initiatives and projects by working closely with senior stakeholders, applying strong project management discipline.
Maintain project plans, timelines, documentation, and next steps, ensuring accuracy and timely updates.
Drive project meetings, coordinate actions across contributors, advance activity as appropriate and track progress against milestones.
Support preparation of leadership - ready materials (presentations, updates, trackers), ensuring they meet EY standards and are ready for circulation.
Identify project risks, dependencies, and opportunities to improve processes, escalating issues as appropriate.
Act as a single point of coordination with relevant C&I domains and CBS Functions (e.g., BMC, Finance, Technology, AWS) to support delivery of project outcomes.
Operational Excellence
Support consistent execution of operational processes by maintaining clear documentation, governance artifacts, and reporting.
Proactively identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance ways of working within the domain.
Maintain and manage knowledge repositories, databases, SharePoint sites, and content libraries, including regular review and validation of materials.
Share knowledge, insights, and updates with stakeholders using agreed communication channels.
Support preparation of status reporting and dashboards, ensuring clarity in coordination with Performance & Data Insights where applicable.
Assist the triage of requests for ad - hoc analysis, reporting, and information, helping to embed new ways of working and reinforcing self - service where possible.
Stakeholder Engagement
Develop strong working relationships across domains, functions, and pods, anticipating needs and supporting broader team objectives.
Manage stakeholder communications and expectations, providing clear, timely updates on progress, risks, and next steps.
Act as a trusted delivery partner to leadership by ensuring follow - through on actions and high - quality execution.
Participate actively in regular update calls and forums, contributing insights and supporting other team members as needed.
Facilitate coordination across geographically dispersed teams to enable smooth execution and alignment.
Skills & Attributes for Success
Good analytical and problem - solving skills, with attention to detail.
Experience supporting operational process design, improvement, and handoff.
Competence in reporting, data visualization, and storyboarding, with the ability to translate data into clear insights.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders, delivering high - quality outputs under tight timelines.
A client - focused mindset, with the ability to respond to changing needs and redirect effort as required.
Clear, confident communicator with the ability to engage senior stakeholders effectively.
Resilient, adaptable, and comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment with evolving priorities.
Familiarity with AI/other automation to enhance processes, project outcomes and personal deliverables
What we offer you
At EY, we ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence Apply today.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Undertake other projects and duties as assigned.
Work collaboratively with digital design and production teams.

Coordinate multiple website workstreams, dependencies and stakeholders with strong attention to detail.

Strong understanding of digital publishing and best practices.

Experience working within a content management system to create outstanding digital experiences.
Experience coordinating website requests, digital projects or digital marketing operations.
Strong influencing skills.
Strong project and time management ability.

Experience and confidence working closely with global teams.
Experience using Zendesk, Adobe Analytics, Conductor, SharePoint and PowerPoint in a digital marketing environment.
A good eye for effective use of imagery.
An eye for design and basic knowledge of design software such as Photoshop and Microsoft Office.
A basic understanding of HTML.

Basic understanding of Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
Working knowledge of Zendesk, Adobe Analytics, Conductor, Microsoft PowerPoint and SharePoint.

Bachelor’s or master’s degree.
A professional, confident and enthusiastic candidate who can adapt to flexible work timings and demonstrate an exceptional work ethic and customer focus.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in website coordination, digital marketing, web operations or a related field.

About The Role


Job Title -

Instructional Design - Associate

- T&O- (S&C GN)

Management Level:12 - Associate

Location:Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai

Must have skills:

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline


Good to have skills:Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model

Experience:Minimum 0-3 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification:Any Bachelors Fulltime

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.
Collaborate with stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts, team leads, media and technology teams to support iterations to the learning material for improved business outcomes.
Creatively visualize the content and work with the visual design team to convey the course content/key messages impactfully.
Write impactful storyboards by understanding the raw content and repurposing it based on audience, content, modality, and other considerations.
Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Understanding of industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Job Title
Vulnerability Management Engineer Level 2
Role Objective
The Vulnerability Management Engineer Level 2 is responsible for the day-to-day operational execution of the organizations vulnerability management activities. The role operates and maintains vulnerability management platforms (e.g., Tenable Security Center, Tenable One or comparable solutions), schedules and executes authenticated and unauthenticated scans, ensures onboarding of new assets into the scanning scope, and validates scan accuracy. The engineer actively tracks remediation activities with system owners, enforces defined remediation SLAs, and ensures that vulnerabilities are properly documented, re-tested, and closed. The position ensures continuous visibility of technical exposure and supports measurable risk reduction through meaningful reporting and disciplined operational follow-up.
Key Responsibilities
Tenable Infrastructure Operation: Operate and maintain Tenable Security Center (Tenable SC), Tenable One, and Nessus scanners
Test and approve new Nessus Agent versions and Coordinate the rollout of them
Keep scan engines, plugins, policies, and agents up to date
Monitor connectivity, performance, and health
Ensure proper scanner coverage and health monitoring
Onboarding of New Systems: Deploy and troubleshoot Tenable Agents / Nessus Scanners / Nessus Managers
Configure servers/VMs for active scanning
Maintain scan templates and scanning policies
Assign systems to correct Asset Groups and Scan Policies
Execution and Monitoring of Vulnerability Compliance Scans: Schedule and perform regular vulnerability and compliance scans
Monitor scan completion, accuracy, asset coverage, and scan errors
Troubleshoot scanning issues (credentials, firewall blocks, service problems, missing ports, etc.)
Analysis Prioritization of Findings: Review, validate, and prioritize vulnerabilities
Use CVSS, exploitability, and asset criticality for risk-based classification
Provide clear, concise recommendations to European stakeholders
Remediation Tracking Escalation: Proactively follow up with server owners and application teams
Track remediation progress and ensure timelines are met
Highlight overdue critical findings and escalate when needed
Support troubleshooting during patching or mitigation efforts
Communication Reporting: Communicate professionally in English with European teams
Prepare vulnerability reports, dashboards, KPIs, and SLA overviews
Maintain documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures
Support internal audits and compliance requirements
Penetration Test Report Review Integration: Review and interpret penetration test reports delivered by internal or external security teams
Validate the findings, assess their severity, and ensure they align with the organizations risk model
Translate penetration test findings into actionable remediation tasks for system owners
Follow up with responsible teams to ensure the identified weaknesses are addressed
Integrate penetration test results into the vulnerability management workflow and tracking tools
Provide summaries and clear explanations to stakeholders who may not have a security background
Required Knowledge
Hands-on experience in Vulnerability Management and IT Security
Strong understanding of CVE, CVSS, vulnerability types, and exploit mechanics
Strong practical knowledge of Tenable SC, Tenable One, and Nessus
Solid understanding of Windows and Linux server environments
Good knowledge of networking (ports, protocols, firewalls, routing)
Understanding of patching processes and change management
Familiarity with compliance scanning (CIS benchmarks, hardening standards)
Ability to understand common penetration testing techniques and methodologies (e.g., OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK)

Job Summary
The L3 Security Specialist / Incident Response Lead acts as the highest technical escalation point for critical complex security incidents in the 24x7 CERT service model. Key Responsibilities
Lead Technical Investigation of Complex, High-Severity, or Escalated Security Incidents Beyond Standard L2 Analysis
Perform Advanced Incident Scoping to Determine Extent of Compromise, Impacted Systems/Accounts, Attack Sequence, Likely Threat Progression
Review Escalations Involving Suspicious Privileged Activity, Repeated Compromise Patterns, Container/Runtime Anomalies, High-Risk Infrastructure Alerts, or Evidence of Coordinated Attack Behavior
Provide Expert-Level Containment Remediation Recommendations Based on Risk, Business Criticality, Threat Behavior, Operational Constraints
Support High-Priority Incident Communications by Translating Technical Findings into Structured Stakeholder-Ready Updates
Work Closely with Internal Resolver Groups, Infrastructure/Application Owners, Incident Managers, Service Management Stakeholders During Critical Investigations
Identify Systemic Weaknesses Recurring Root Causes, Recommend Longer-Term Improvements in Detection Use Cases, Process Maturity, SOPs, Playbooks, Escalation Models
Guide Security Analysts on Advanced Analysis Methods, Evidence Handling, Incident Scoping, Response Decision-Making
Participate in Weekly Incident Reviews, Monthly Governance Reporting, Continuous Service Improvement Discussions with a Strong Focus on Risk Trends Service Resilience
Strengthen Knowledge Management Through Development of Advanced Use Cases, Threat Investigation Patterns, Specialized Runbooks, Lessons Learned Documentation
Required Technical Skills
Deep Expertise in Incident Response, Advanced Threat Investigation, Attack Analysis, Containment Strategy, Operational Decision-Making in Live Incidents
Strong Experience with SIEM/SOAR Platforms, Especially Investigation Workflows, Offense Analysis, Data Correlation, High-Fidelity Case Handling
Strong Understanding of Security Telemetry Across Logs, Authentication Systems, Network Activity, Endpoint Behavior, Container/Runtime Monitoring, Threat Advisories
Ability to Assess Business Impact vs Technical Severity Advise on Containment Actions Without Losing Sight of Continuity Requirements
Strong Knowledge of Incident Lifecycle Management, Escalation Governance, Reporting, Knowledge Management, Service Improvement Practices
Ability to Write Clear Executive Technical Summaries for Senior Stakeholders Operational Teams
Required Experience / Qualification
Bachelors Degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Security, or Related Field Preferred
Typically 610+ Years of Experience in Incident Response, CERT/SOC Engineering, Advanced Threat Analysis, or Senior Security Operations Roles
Proven Experience Handling Critical/High-Severity Security Investigations Guiding Cross-Functional Technical Response
Certifications such as GCIA, GCIH, GCFA, CISSP, SC-200, Vendor SIEM Certifications, or Equivalent Advanced Credentials would be Advantageous

Description:
At Medtronic, we push the limits of what technology, therapies, and services can do to help alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. As a Senior Compliance Specialist, you will serve as a strategic compliance business partner responsible for supporting the development, implementation, and oversight of an effective compliance program that promotes ethical business conduct and mitigates compliance risks across commercial operations.
You will provide expert compliance guidance to business leaders and employees, support risk assessments and monitoring activities, oversee channel partner compliance programs, and help ensure adherence to company policies, industry codes, and applicable laws and regulations. The role requires the ability to influence stakeholders, balance business objectives with compliance requirements, and drive a strong culture of integrity throughout the organization.  
This is an individual-contributor role and the position will be in Mumbai in India and has responsibility mainly for India Subcontinent (subject to changes). The position will report directly to the India Subcontinent Compliance Officer.
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

Strategic Business Partnership
Serve as a trusted advisor to commercial and functional stakeholders on compliance and data privacy matters. Understand business strategies, operating models, commercial priorities, and emerging initiatives to provide timely and practical compliance guidance.
Advise on Global Business Conduct Standards/Compliance Policy such as HCP/HCO interactions, sponsorships, educational grants, consulting arrangements, and promotional activities, in adherence with applicable laws, codes, regulations, and company policies.
Clearly document compliance advice, risk assessments, approvals, exceptions, and agreed mitigation actions.
Monitor regulatory and industry developments and support the implementation of relevant changes in policies, processes, systems, training, and business practices.
Support the integration of privacy principles into business processes, digital initiatives, customer programs, vendor arrangements, and projects involving personal or sensitive data.
Promote privacy-by-design principles by encouraging teams to consider data minimization, purpose limitation, appropriate access, retention, security, transparency, consent, and individual rights at the beginning of an initiative.
Data Analytics and Risk Insights
Develop dashboards, metrics, and reports for management and compliance leadership to analyse trends.
Translate analytical findings into clear risk insights, recommendations, and action plans for business and compliance stakeholders, for continuous improvement of the compliance program.
Utilize data analytics to identify opportunities for process and control enhancements.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators supporting continuous improvement.
Track remediation activities and evaluate whether implemented actions have appropriately addressed identified risks.
Compliance Monitoring and Process Reviews
Support in developing and executing risk-based compliance monitoring plans aligned with country, business, and program priorities.
Conduct risk-based compliance reviews and assessments, analyse findings, root causes and risk trends.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve compliance concerns and track timely closure.
Identify opportunities to simplify processes, strengthen controls, improve documentation, and enhance the effectiveness of the Compliance Program.
Third-Party Compliance
Support the third party compliance program for India SubCon such as due diligence, training, monitoring, remediations and lifecycle-management processes.
Review third-party due-diligence / screening results, red flags, design appropriate remediations and supporting documentation.
Conduct or support audits/monitoring, remediations, process assessments, and other risk-based oversight activities.
Training
Support in design, develop, and deliver engaging compliance training for employees, managers, Business Units, functional teams, distributors, dealers, and other third parties.
Tailor training and communication to the specific risks and promote awareness of compliance requirements, culture of integrity and ethical decision-making.

Required Qualifications:
Requires advanced knowledge of job area combining breadth and depth, typically obtained through advanced education combined with experience. May have practical knowledge of project management.
Requires a Baccalaureate degree with minimum of 4 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 2 years relevant experience.

Preferred:
Experience in the healthcare, medical-device, pharmaceutical, life-sciences, or another highly regulated industry.
Knowledge of Indian healthcare compliance requirements, UCMPMD, data-protection requirements, and applicable anti-bribery and anti-corruption laws.
Experience managing distributor, dealer, channel-partner, consultant, vendor, or other third-party compliance risks.
Experience conducting investigations, monitoring activities, and compliance risk assessments.
Proficiency in Excel and experience with Power BI, data visualization, dashboards, or other analytical tools.
Relevant professional qualification or certification in compliance such as CCEP, law, audit, privacy such as CIPM, fraud examination, risk management, accounting, or data analytics.

The Opportunity
Hitachi Energy Grid Integration (HVDC) offers an exciting opportunity to work with advanced High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) and High Voltage Alternating Current (HVAC) technologies. You will be part of the Services team, supporting the installed base of HVDC systems by ensuring reliable operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and customer satisfaction while contributing to the long-term performance and availability of critical power infrastructure.
How You'll Make an Impact
Demonstrate a strong commitment to Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) standards, policies, and guidelines.
Serve as the primary customer interface for the HVDC installed base and maintain strong customer relationships.
Perform troubleshooting and restoration activities for HVDC systems and equipment during failures or outages, in coordination with technical experts.
Execute preventive and corrective maintenance activities for HVDC and HVAC equipment.
Monitor installed HVDC assets using Asset Management tools, including performance monitoring and inventory control.
Coordinate with internal teams, customers, vendors, and OEMs to ensure fulfillment of warranty obligations and service requirements.
Manage replacement, installation, and commissioning activities related to failed HVDC/HVAC equipment.
Support Service Project Managers by providing reports, technical inputs, and updates related to warranty, reliability, availability, and Long-Term Service Agreements (LTSA).
Prepare and maintain site documentation, including Minutes of Meeting (MOM), and service reports.
Review technical drawings, engineering documents, protection schemes, and operating procedures to support maintenance and fault resolution.
Participate in outage management, fault investigations, emergency response activities, and root cause analysis.
Ensure timely communication and coordination with technical support teams during critical service events.
Travel domestically and internationally to support customer sites and project requirements.
Uphold Hitachi Energy's core values of safety, integrity, teamwork, and customer focus.
Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business
Your Background
Education Experience
Diploma or bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related discipline.
Additional certifications or training in HVDC, substation systems, control protection, or power system maintenance will be considered an advantage.
5 Years of experience in HVDC/HVAC systems, substations, power transmission, grid integration, or power system maintenance.
Hands-on experience in troubleshooting, maintenance, and operation of electrical equipment in utility, transmission, or industrial environments.
Experience in customer-facing service roles and managing technical support activities.
Exposure to outage management, fault diagnosis, equipment replacement, and commissioning activities.
Experience working with warranty management, LTSA contracts, reliability, and availability monitoring is preferred.
Willingness to travel extensively and work in demanding operational environments.
Proficiency in both spoken written English language is required.

The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.

Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization Workiva Implementation,Blackline Implementation.

Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.

Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.

Professional & Technical

Join our team of Strategy & Consulting Global Network Song who solve customer facing challenges at clients spanning sales, service and marketing to accelerate business change.

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Are you passionate about scaling businesses using in-depth frameworks and techniques to solve customer facing challenges? Do you want to design, build and implement strategies to enhance business performance? Does working in an inclusive and collaborative environment spark your interest?

Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities within Accentures Strategy & Consulting Global Network Song practice.

The Practice A Brief Sketch The Strategy & Consulting Global Network Song practice is aligned to the Global Network Song Practice of Accenture and works with clients across their marketing, sales and services functions. As part of the team, you will provide transformation services driven by key offerings like Living Marketing, Connected Commerce and Next-Generation Customer Care. The Life Sciences Marketing Senior Manager position is within the Marketing Transformation vertical of Accenture GN Song. The individual would work at the heart of the top global Life Sciences (Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology and Medical Technology) and would collaborate on innovative projects while bringing in deep industry knowledge and Marketing skills.

The key responsibilities will include

Strong project management skills to plan, execute, and deliver content initiatives successfully. This includes managing timelines, budgets, resources, and coordinating cross-functional teams. An analytical & data driven mindset to drive result-oriented decisions

Exposure and experience in roles across the marketing value chain, primarily in the life sciences or allied industries as detailed out below.

Consulting & Advisory service

Market Research

Analysis and assessment of the pharmaceutical market across disease areas and opportunity identification for new launches, indication expansions , identify emerging trends, competitive landscapes, and new opportunities within the life sciences sector .


Competitor benchmarking, patient journey mapping, segmentation & targeting


Digital Marketing

Develop E2E strategy & campaigns Liaise with key client stakeholders in the marketing teams to design strateg ies for omni-channel marketing campaigns . Lead development of content marketing, social media, and web engagement programs for the client, ensuring that they are aligned with the overall content strategy. In-depth knowledge of branding, creative development and execution, digital marketing, and campaign deployment and optimization


Provide expertise on Content design and campaign execution Able to provide a perspective on identification and selection of the right digital channel s and content types based on campaign objectives . Able to understand client requirements based on their brief s & ideat e to appropriate creative design s. Support end to end campaign execution and suggest ways for optimization.







Marketing Technology

Lead platform assessment and solution design Understand the marketing value chain across process , technology & people. Conduct a thorough assessment, propose a solution along with an operating model & define KPI s for different marketing technologies Adobe / SF / Veeva . Have an understanding of the regulatory, compliance and governance landscape in the industry and build frameworks for scale up.


MarTech Consulting Projects Lead projects focusing on optimizing the MarTech stack and develop use cases to improve utilization of existing MarTech stack. Research, evaluate and recommend new martech systems and suppliers. Keep a holistic understanding of existing and upcoming martech platforms and how they connect into the broader marketing technology landscape.


Tools & Platforms Hands on experience on Mar-tech tools such as Adobe campaign, Marketo, Adobe, Cloud, Google Marketing platform, Google Ads, Pega decisioning, SFMC etc.


Value realization Crafting a value tree and d eveloping business case s for implementation and scale up


Gen AI

Be aware of the latest AI development s in the Life Science industry and be able to co-create customized solutions for the client to meet their objectives .


Have experience in CDP tools and platforms.


Design and implement GenAI use cases




Sales & Business Development

Generating new business engagements:Drive new business opportunities by identifying and pursuing new leads, defining GTM strategy, facilitate client discussions and presentations to drive new business and client relationships.


Own and drive RFP/RFI response coming in from Life Science customers




Practice Development

Take on leadership role:Support overall growth of practice across all the pillars Marketing as well as sales, & service through a combination of business development, talent management, oversight of delivery work, and thought leadership.


Collaborate with Salesforce, Veeva, Adobe, IQVIA etc. business groups, to enable business capabilities with agility, velocity, and quality while optimizing costs.


Establish a strong network with key stakeholders in the Accenture ecosystem, across geographies to socialize and amplify the GN Song capabilities, operating model and ways of working to generate demand and meet the KPIs


Lead and motivate teams with diverse skills and backgrounds. Manage and mentor talented teams of consultants and technologists supporting, providing input and guidance into the talent strategy and actively participate in engagement, capability development activities.

Qualification




Your experience counts!

MBA from a tier 1 institute with preferably bachelors degree in marketing, Journalism, Communications, or a related field


Proven working experience ( 8 + years) in digital marketing/Advertising platforms and in delivering marketing solutions, particularly within the Life Sciences Industry


In-depth knowledge of branding, creative development and execution, digital marketing, and campaign deployment and optimization


Experience in working with middle to senior management levels within existing organization / client organizations


Experience in working with Agencies or working in a Marketing agency for Life Sciences Clients


Strong understanding of marketing, advertising technologies (with hands on ) and ability to apply technology know-how to better how our clients reach out to their customers

An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients

Job Title: Admission Counsellor / Business Development Executive / Senior Learning Consultant EdTech

Job Location: Mumbai / Pune /Chandigarh / Bangalore
Industry: EdTech / Education / Online Learning
Department: Sales, Admissions & Student Counselling
Experience: 1 to 3 Years (Freshers with Excellent Communication Skills are also Welcome)

Job Description

We are looking for enthusiastic and target-oriented professionals to join our growing EdTech team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for counselling prospective students, promoting educational programs, managing leads, and driving admissions and course enrolments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Connect with prospective students through inbound and outbound calls, emails, chats, and online platforms.
- Counsel students regarding online UG/PG programs, management courses, diplomas, certifications, and professional learning programs.
- Understand students' career goals and recommend suitable educational programs.
- Follow up with interested leads and convert enquiries into admissions and enrolments.
- Schedule video counselling sessions, online demos, and program discussions where required.
- Manage the complete sales funnel, from lead engagement to conversion.
- Achieve monthly admission and revenue targets.
- Maintain lead records, follow-ups, and sales reports using CRM tools and Excel.
- Build strong relationships with students and parents while ensuring a positive counselling experience.

Requirements
- Graduate in any discipline.
- Freshers with excellent communication and convincing skills can apply for eligible entry-level roles.
- Experienced candidates with backgrounds in EdTech Sales, B2C Sales, Admission Counselling, Academic Counselling, or Business Development are preferred for experienced positions.
- Strong communication, negotiation, persuasion, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with sales targets and manage multiple leads.
- Basic knowledge of MS Excel, CRM tools, and dialer operations.
- A customer-focused attitude with a passion for education and career counselling.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary as per experience, skills, and company norms.
- Attractive performance-based incentives.
- Opportunity to work in the growing EdTech and online education sector.

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
