Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Are you passionate about scaling businesses using in-depth frameworks and techniques to solve customer facing challengesDo you want to design, build and implement strategies to enhance business performanceDoes working in an inclusive and collaborative environment spark your interest
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities within Accenture Strategy Consultings Customer, Sales Service practice.
The practice is aligned to the Capability Network Practice of Accenture and works with clients across their marketing, sales and services functions. As part of the team, you will work on transformation services driven by key offerings like Living Marketing, Connected Commerce and Next-Generation Customer Care. These services help our clients become living businesses by optimizing their marketing, sales and customer service strategy,thereby driving cost reduction, revenue enhancement, customer satisfaction and impacting front end business metrics in a positive manner.
You will work closely with our clients as consulting professionals who design, build and implement initiatives that can help enhance business performance. As part of these, you will drive the following:
Ability to provide CX solution with Google CCAI suite of contact center products such as Dialogflow CX, Agent Assist, Insights CX and CCAI Platform (Ujet.cx)
Co-Lead the Google Contact Center Offering and leverage the previous experience of building the practice from scratch (attracting the best talent in the market and increasing the demand to deliver high impact Google contact center projects)
Lead and drive design thinking innovative workshops with the clients using design principles and reshape their thinking about customer experience especially in the contact center / customer care domain
Perform CX management capability assessment and identify foundational, evolving and advanced capabilities, co-create the roadmap path with the clients to achieve leading class CX capabilities
Formulate CX target operating model and detail out operating model components such as strategic sourcing mgmt, agent performance management, CX performance, innovation management, CX management, business intelligent and contact center technology support aligned to vision
Ability to understand business requirements still putting customer experience at the heart of CX design
Ability to think and pre-empt scenarios and questions from cross functional client team (from CX operations, IT, Contact Center operations, digital, analytics, line of business etc)
Work with technical Google team/developers to convert user requirements into final product
Work with Accenture and client team on CCaaS (Contact Center as a Service) migration, lead existing legacy solution clients on the journey to new solution
Lead and deliver agile delivery process, continuous improvement and continuous development
Work with other Accenture teams to put forward differentiated CX management solutions for large clients (RFI and RFP process)
Participate in pre-sales activities including response to RFPs, creating proofs of concept, creating effective presentations, demonstrating solutions during client orals, effort, and cost estimation process, etc.

Title: - 11 - Ind & Func AI Decision Science Analyst
Job location: - Hyderabad/Bangalore
About S&C - Global Network: - Accenture Global Network - Data & AI practice help our clients grow their business in entirely new ways. Analytics enables our clients to achieve high performance through insights from data - insights that inform better decisions and strengthen customer relationships. From strategy to execution, Accenture works with organizations to develop analytic capabilities - from accessing and reporting on data to predictive modelling - to outperform the competition
About the Team: -
The team is focused on driving Data & AI based solutions for SaaS and PaaS clients for Accenture. The team collaborates actively with onsite counterparts to help identify opportunities for growth as well as drives client deliveries from offshore.
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
As part of our Data & AI practice, you will join a worldwide network of smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading statistical tools, methods, and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically informed, issue-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.
Accenture will continually invest in your learning and growth. You'll work with experts in SaaS & PaaS and Accenture will support you in growing your own tech stack and certifications.
In Data & AI you will understands the importance of sound analytical decision-making, relationship of tasks to the overall project, and executes projects in the context of a business performance improvement initiative.
What you would do in this role
Development and testing of AI algorithms and techniques, custom-tailored to effectively address and solve specific, complex business problems.
Manage large databases proficiently, conducting exploratory data analytics to derive valuable insights for stakeholders.
Track down and thoroughly investigate previous information related to a problem, asking probing questions to identify root causes.
Employ a systematic approach to problem-solving, exploring known avenues and asking insightful questions to unravel the core issues.
Work collaboratively with both internal teams and external consultants/managers to achieve project objectives.
Develop and manage data pipelines to streamline the flow of information for enhanced efficiency.
Demonstrate adaptability and flexibility in responding to changing project requirements.
Proactively seek and embrace continuous learning opportunities to stay updated with the industry trends and advancement.


Qualification
Job Qualifications
Who are we looking for?
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related field.
Experience working for large Software or Platform organizations.
Proven experience (2+ years) in working on AI projects and delivering successful outcomes.
Hands-On exposure to Generative AI frameworks (Azure Open AI, Vertex AI) and implementations & Strong knowledge of AI technologies, including Embedding, prompt engineering, natural language processing, computer vision, etc.
Hands on experience in building and deployment of Statistical Models/Machine Learning including Segmentation & predictive modelling, hypothesis testing, multivariate statistical analysis, time series techniques, and optimization.
Ability to work with large data sets and present findings / insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL
Proficiency in statistical packages such as R, Python, Java, SQL, Spark, etc.
Knowledge in training large language models and fine-tuning for specific applications or domains.
Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.
Proficient in Excel, MS word, PowerPoint, etc.

Description:
AEL is DMarts ecommerce venture which is engaged in the business of online grocery retail under the brand name DMart Ready. AEL currently operates its business in select areas of Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Surat & is poised to launch its operations in Indore & Bhopal. AEL allows its customers to order a broad range of grocery and household products through its mobile app DMart online grocery shopping and through the website www.dmart.in. Customers can either 1) Self Pick Up: Order online from the app and pick up the order from the nearest DMart Ready Pick-Up point. 2) Home Delivery: Place your order online and get it delivered to home or office at a convenient date &time of choice.


Key Responsibilities
1. GST Compliance & Filings
Manage multi-state GST compliance frameworks across retail channels.
Oversee the timely filing of monthly, quarterly, and annual returns, including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-8 (e-commerce), and GSTR-9/9C.
Execute 3-way reconciliations across Sales Registers vs. GSTR-1, Purchase Registers vs. GSTR-2B, and ERP ledger balances to optimize Input Tax Credit (ITC) utilization.
Monitor e-Way bill issuance, e-invoicing workflows, and GST rates.

2. Direct Tax & Regulatory Compliances
Oversee end-to-end Direct Tax, including monthly TDS/TCS deduction, deposit, quarterly return filings (Form 26Q/27Q), and annual Form 16/16A issuance.
Assist in annual Tax Audits (Form 3CD), corporate tax computations, advance tax forecasting, and tax provision reviews in coordination with statutory auditors.

3. Litigation & Dispute Resolution
Draft robust technical replies to Show Cause Notices (SCNs), audit inquiries, assessment orders, and notices from State/Central GST authorities.
Represent the company before tax officers, appellate authorities, and auditors during assessments, proceedings, and personal hearings.
Partner with external legal counsel, tax advisors, and consultants for high-stakes litigation, appeals, and legal opinions.

Candidate Profile & Requirements
Experience: Minimum 7+ years of hands-on experience in Indirect Taxation.
Technical Skills: Strong mastery of GST laws, legal drafting, ITC reconciliation methodologies, TDS/TCS provisions, and advanced Excel. Hands-on exposure to SAP is required.

Job Description



Platform Automation Developer - Kubernetes, Python, PowerShell Shell
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Noida / Hyderabad / Chennai
Experience: 6+ Years


About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Platform Automation Developer with strong expertise in Kubernetes, Python, PowerShell, and Shell scripting. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building platform-level automation solutions that enable deployment, configuration, packaging, orchestration, and lifecycle management of applications across Linux, Windows, VM, and containerized environments.


Your Role
As a Platform Automation Developer, you will design and develop automation frameworks, orchestration services, deployment tooling, and platform utilities that improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency. You will work closely with DevOps, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Application teams to deliver robust automation solutions.


Key Responsibilities
Develop platform-level automation and orchestration components for deployment, configuration, packaging, and management of application workloads.
Build automation solutions using Python, PowerShell, Bash/Shell, and related technologies.
Automate application installation, configuration, service management, environment setup, and health validation processes.
Develop and maintain container images, Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, and deployment packages.
Create build, release, and packaging automation for Linux and Windows-based applications.

Job Title:Senior Manager Data AI


Location:Mumbai, Gurgaon, Bangalore


Department:AI Data in Growth Networks


Experience:8-10 years


Role Overview
We are seeking a seasoned

Senior Manager Data AI to lead complex, high-impact client engagements and deliver data-driven transformation programs. This individual will work closely with senior client stakeholders, manage project teams, and drive business value through innovative application of data engineering, analytics, and AI technologies.
This is a strategic, client-facing leadership role requiring strong technical understanding, delivery excellence, stakeholder management, and business consulting experience.


Key Responsibilities


Client Engagement Leadership
Act as the primary engagement leader for Data AI projects across multiple clients
Build and maintain trusted executive-level client relationships
Understand business challenges and translate them into data-driven solutions
Lead pre-sales discussions, solution design, scoping and proposal creation


Project Delivery Execution
Oversee end-to-end delivery of complex Data, Analytics AI programmes
Manage cross-functional data teams (data engineers, data scientists, analysts, architects)
Ensure delivery quality, scope adherence, timelines, and budget
Establish data governance, delivery frameworks, and operational excellence practices


Technical Strategic Leadership
Develop data modernization, cloud analytics, MLOps and AI adoption strategies
Guide team on data engineering, analytics, AI, ML, and Generative AI best practices
Review architectures, models, pipelines and solutions for quality and scalability
Drive innovation and adoption of emerging AI and GenAI capabilities


People Development
Mentor and coach project managers and technical teams
Lead talent development, workforce planning, and capability building
Foster a high-performance, collaborative culture


Business Development
Identify new opportunities within existing accounts
Support organization-wide Data AI GTM initiatives
Represent the company in thought leadership, events, and client workshops



Qualification


Required
Qualifications Skills


Education
Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or related discipline will be preferred
MBA preferred but not mandatory


Professional Skills
Strong client leadership, consulting, and executive stakeholder management
Proven track record managing multi-million-dollar data initiatives
Excellent communication, facilitation presentation skills
Strong problem-solving and structured thinking abilities


Key Traits Competencies
Strategic thinker with execution excellence mindset
Customer-obsessed with strong business acumen
Ability to lead through influence in a matrix environment
High adaptability and continuous-learning mindset
Entrepreneurial, collaborative, and proactive

Job Description
Overview
As one of the world s leading consultancies operating in the built and natural environment, we offer unparalleled opportunities for talented individuals in search of a rewarding career both in India and around the world.
As a provider of multi-disciplined technical services to the built environment, Atkins India is committed to design excellence in the delivery of first class solutions which combine innovation, imagination and best practice.
Due to our continuing expansion we currently have an opportunity for a Senior Highways Engineer on multi-disciplinary offshore executed projects from Bangalore office.
Working in a multidisciplinary team of designers and engineers providing a professional design service to our clients, this is an ideal opportunity for individuals looking to develop their international experience with a world renowned consultant.

Your Role

Qualified Degree in Civil Engineering from a reputed College.
Have relevant experience in the region of around 8 to 12 years in consultancy business working on highways and related features.
Experienced user of Civil3D/ Open Roads, MX design, AutoCAD.

Working knowledge of KSA/Qatar/UAE/DMRB/AASHTHO.
project based supervision of designers and drafting staff.
maintaining technical quality standards and mentoring junior designers.
delivering projects to time and budget.
liaising with UK based customers in a responsive and client focused manner.
Be highly self-motivated and ambitious.
Have a track record of technical achievement and client satisfaction within the highways and bridges industry.
Be able to work with minimal supervision.
Have the ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers.
Be able to build excellent working relationships with colleagues and clients.

The position is to be based in Bangalore .

We are seeking 10 disciplined, proactive, and responsible Security Supervisors to lead on-ground security teams, oversee daily post operations, and enforce safety and access protocols. The ideal candidate will bridge on-ground guard personnel and facility management to maintain strict security across the premises.
Key Responsibilities
Team Leadership Shift Management: Manage guard deployment, conduct daily roll-calls (briefing and debriefing), oversee shift handovers, and allocate gate, perimeter, and patrolling duties.
Access Control Material Movement Oversight: Supervise main gate operations, verify visitor/contractor entries, and ensure strict compliance with inward/outward returnable and non-returnable gate pass (RGP/NRGP) documentation.
Patrols Post Audits: Conduct random daytime and nighttime inspections of guard posts, perimeter lighting, emergency exits, and firefighting equipment.
Incident Management Reporting: Respond immediately to security breaches, trespassing, medical emergencies, or workplace disputes; submit detailed First Information Reports (FIR/Incident Reports) to the Security Officer/Facility Manager.
Surveillance Supervision: Monitor CCTV operational readiness, verify guard adherence to radio/intercom communications, and report hardware faults promptly.
Training Discipline: Ensure guards wear clean uniforms, follow turnout standards, and adhere to code of conduct policies; conduct basic fire-safety and emergency drill refreshers.
Eligibility Criteria Qualifications Criteria Requirement Education Minimum 10th Standard (Matriculation) Pass Age Limit Below 40 Years Minimum Height 5 ft 6 inch Experience 1 to 3 years of experience as a Senior Guard, Head Guard, or Security Supervisor (Ex-Servicemen / Paramilitary personnel strongly preferred) Physical Fitness High physical stamina, active command presence, and clear medical health

Description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced SAP ABAP Technical Consultant with strong expertise in SAP ABAP development, SAP HANA, and RICEFW objects. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SAP CRM Technical and preferably SAP BRIM, including Subscription Order Management (SOM), Convergent Charging, Convergent Mediation, and related integration components.
The candidate should be capable of designing, developing, enhancing, and supporting complex SAP solutions across distributed architectures, with experience in SAP HANA and S/4HANA environments.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, enhance, and maintain SAP ABAP applications and custom solutions.
Handle end-to-end RICEFW development, including Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms, and Workflows.
Develop and optimize ABAP programs using Object-Oriented ABAP concepts.
Work on SAP HANA development, including CDS Views, AMDP, ADBC, Native HANA Views, and procedures.
Develop and support SAP CRM Technical components, including CRM enhancements, Events, BAdIs, Middleware, BOL, and GENIL programming.
Work on SAP BRIM components such as SOM, Convergent Charging, Convergent Mediation, and CPQ, wherever applicable.
Develop and support integrations using REST, SOAP, OData, RFCs, BAPIs, IDOCs, and web services.
Work on Fiori and SAP Gateway development, including service implementation and troubleshooting.
Handle FQEVENTS, Provider Order Management, Order Distribution Infrastructure (ODI), and IDOC extensions.
Participate in SAP HANA migration and S/4HANA conversion activities, including analysis of the Simplification List.
Troubleshoot technical issues, optimize application performance, and ensure quality of deliverables.
Collaborate with functional and technical teams to deliver solutions in distributed SAP environments.

Required Technical Skills

1. SAP ABAP Development
8+ years of hands-on experience in SAP ABAP Design and Development.
Strong expertise in Object-Oriented ABAP.
Extensive RICEFW development experience.
Experience with Smart Forms, Adobe Forms, Reports, Module Pool Programming, BAPI, BAdI, User Exits, Enhancements, ALE, IDOCs, RFCs, Events, and SAP Workflows.
Knowledge of Output Determination and Pricing Procedure Routines.
2. SAP HANA Development
Minimum 2 years of experience in SAP HANA design and development.
Hands-on experience with CDS Views, AMDP, ADBC, HANA Native Views, Attribute Views, Analytical Views, and HANA Procedures.
Knowledge of HANA Modelling, HANA XS, and Search.
Understanding of consuming HANA Views through different tools and applications.
3. SAP BRIM / SAP CRM Technical
Experience in SAP BRIM is highly preferred.
Knowledge of BRF+, CRM, Subscription Order Management (SOM), Convergent Charging, Convergent Mediation, and CPQ.
Strong understanding of SAP CRM Technical architecture.
Experience with CRM enhancements, CRM Events, BAdI Framework, Middleware, BOL, and GENIL programming.
Integration knowledge across SOM, Convergent Charging, and Convergent Invoicing (CI).
4. SAP Integration & Fiori
Experience with REST, SOAP, OData, RFC, and Web Services.
Hands-on experience with SAP Fiori and SAP Gateway.
Knowledge of FQEVENTS, Provider Order Management, Order Distribution Infrastructure (ODI), IDOC extensions, and ODI troubleshooting.
5. SAP S/4HANA
Experience in SAP HANA Migration.
Knowledge of the S/4HANA Simplification List.
Experience working in distributed architecture environments.
Preferred Skills
Techno-functional experience in SAP BRIM.
Experience across SOM, Convergent Charging, Convergent Mediation, and CPQ.
Strong understanding of SAP CRM and BRIM integration scenarios.
Experience in complex SAP implementation, enhancement, and migration projects.

Interested candidates can share their Cvs to namrata.dutta@mindseek.net.

Thanks & Regards

Role Purpose:
To become a single point of contact for all financial matters and to stand as the initial safeguard for
auditors and any reporting needs, both internal and external. In addition, assisting the Finance
Manager with daily requirements and backup as needed

Designation: Chartered Accountant
Base Location: Navi Mumbai
Reporting to: Finance Head, DP World GSC

Key Role Responsibilities:

Deliverables
Prepare and ensure timely closure of all accounting processes, supporting the accurate preparation of monthly and annual financial reports in compliance with Indian GAAP, IFRS, and Ind AS standards.
Assist in the preparation of consolidated financial statements and supporting documents for audit purposes.
Prepare financial reports to ensure compliance with the Companies Act, Internal Financial Controls
Prepare cost allocation as per business segments.
Prepare provisioning for receivables, revenue recognition, and assist in the timely transfer of funds from overseas accounts.
Perform bank reconciliations to ensure accurate cash position reporting.
Prepare and review expense accruals to ensure proper allocation and timely recognition of expenses.
Assist in month-end and year-end closing activities related to the General Ledger, ensuring timely and accurate recording of all transactions.

About Accenture

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song- all powered by the world's largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com

What would you do?

Accenture is a trusted, innovative, comprehensive, and experienced partner to leading platform companies and other organizations. The Trust and Safety (Content Moderation and Responsible AI) offering(s) within Accenture helps keep the internet safe and helps platform companies accelerate, scale, and improve their businesses.
Accenture s Trust & Safety team, serves as an important line of defense by helping improve the quality and safety of online content while gaining hands-on job experience. They often systematically test, evaluate, and challenge AI systems and platforms to improve the integrity, quality and safety of content, including generative AI. You will deliver value to our clients, while making a larger impact on society.
You will be responsible for analyzing and reviewing user profiles, audio, videos, and text-based content and or investigating, escalating and or resolving issues that are reported by users or flagged by the system. Due to the nature of the role, you may be exposed to objectionable or disturbing content flashing lights or contrasting light and dark patterns.

What are we looking for?
This is meaningful work that helps keep the internet safe and responsible. It may also be challenging, at times. In this role, you may be directly or inadvertently exposed to, work with, view, or proactively engage with potentially disturbing, objectionable, and sensitive content (e.g., graphic, violent, sexual, or egregious) and expose AI systems to adversarial scenarios. Therefore, Trust & Safety resources need strong resilience and coping skills. We care for the health and well-being of our people and provide the support and resources needed to perform their role responsibilities.
This role requires active participation in Accenture s well-being support program, designed specifically for the Trust & Safety community, provides valuable skills to promote individual and collective well-being.

Roles and Responsibilities:
Role Details and
Key Responsibilities:
Review, classify and or remove, work with, view, or proactively engage with content according to client guidelines, using specific tools and channels
Understand and remain updated on changing client policies and guidelines Stay up-to-date with industry trends, identified generative AI shortcomings and advancements in content moderation and or responsible AI regulations, governance, policy, and consulting work.
Investigate, resolve, and relay complex content issues to the broader Trust and Safety team
Develop and execute prompt strategies to interrogate large language models on various topics related to responsible AI, including medical advice, legal advice, and other sensitive areas.
Analyze the model s responses for appropriateness, inappropriateness, refusal to answer, or appending disclaimers to the response according to client definitions and guidance.
Collaborate with other team members to create a comprehensive understanding of responsible AI issues based on a model s responses.
Contribute to the development of best practices and guidelines for content moderation and responsible AI governance and policy.
Basic Qualifications and Skills Needed:
Strong coping, emotional resilience, and stress-management skills
Excellent comprehension, communication, and ENGLISH skills
Ability to perform duties objectively, devoid of inherent biases or personal beliefs, in the best interest of client policies
Strong attention to detail
Comfort synthesizing and analyzing information from multiple streams
Strong critical thinking and decision-making skills
Preferred Qualifications:
Deep familiarity and passion for responsible AI, the internet, internet platforms, and internet culture
High affinity and cultural awareness of political and social situations regarding the relevant market and region that will be supported

Qualification
Any Graduation

Monitor third-party due diligence workflows through closure, including questionnaire distribution, tracking, follow-ups, and status reporting
Coordinate onboarding and offboarding support activities for agent banks and market infrastructure providers, including closure of oversight actions
Administer negative media workflows and credit risk rating-related processes in line with established procedures
Execute relationship inventory upkeep activities, including collecting, validating, and distributing required information and documentation
Maintain party and reference data records and supporting documentation, including retention and repository hygiene requirements
Publish management information reporting reference data and documentation for stakeholders using established templates and routines
Investigate exceptions, breaks, and stakeholder queries by documenting root cause analysis and driving timely resolution paths
Recommend efficiency enhancements by identifying process gaps and proposing practical changes to reduce friction and rework
Support change delivery activities, including user acceptance testing preparation and execution in partnership with data, analytics, and technology teams
Participate in ad hoc projects supporting the Network Management team and relevant business-aligned partners
Strengthen controls and governance routines by tracking actions, maintaining evidence, and escalating risks when needed

Apply strong written and verbal communication skills to build effective working relationships across stakeholders

Practice disciplined execution with clear ownership and accountability for risk and control outcomes
Manage deadlines through effective time management, including planning, prioritizing, scheduling, and monitoring work
Support audit, compliance, and regulatory inquiries by providing well-organized evidence and reconciliations and maintaining audit readiness
Build productive working relationships across functions and levels to achieve outcomes in a collaborative environment
Operate effectively across a global team model, including coordinating with internal partners and external parties to obtain and distribute required information
Handle sensitive third-party and internal information with strong confidentiality awareness and careful data-handling judgment
Use spreadsheet, presentation, and document tools (Excel, PowerPoint, and Word) to produce updates, documentation, and status materials
Adapt to changing priorities while maintaining accuracy, urgency, and control discipline

Hold a postgraduate qualification in Finance

Show familiarity with preparing market development communications and briefing materials for stakeholders
Develop negotiating skills to support practical solutions to workflow challenges and information gaps

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Tele Sales Executive

Department: Sales
Are you a motivated individual with a passion for real estate sales? Join our team at NoBroker as a Tele Sales Executive and help revolutionize the way people buy and sell properties!
Location: Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore)

Position Type: Full-time
Salary Range: 4.97 LPA to 5.74 LPA (inclusive of variable components & based on current relevant experience)

About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000 transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1 billion.

Specific Responsibilities

Make outbound calls and handle inbound enquiries from prospective customers for approximately 3 to 4 hours every day as part of a voice-based sales process.
Own end-to-end sales conversion understand customer requirements, pitch NoBrokers property and service offerings, and close deals to achieve monthly sales targets.
Build trust and rapport with leads, negotiate effectively, and provide regular follow-ups until conversion.
Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, and conversions using internal CRM tools and adhere to company sales processes.
Consistently work towards and exceed individual and team sales targets to maximize performance-based incentives.

Perks & Value Proposition
Attractive incentives: Earn performance-based incentives of 20,000 - 25,000 per month, over and above your fixed salary.
Health insurance: 1 lakh group insurance per year, fully paid by the company.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top sales performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2 years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for all employees.
Employee referral program: Incentives for bringing in new talent.

Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers

Education:
Graduation, 12th, or 10th qualified. Should not be currently pursuing any full-time, part-time, online, or distance-learning course.

Skills:
Excellent verbal communication, strong negotiation and persuasion skills, target-driven mindset, and good interpersonal skills.

Languages: English mandatory; Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu or Marathi preferred.

Technical skills: Basic proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word) and comfort using CRM/calling tools.

Work schedule: 6-day working week Saturday and Sunday are working days, with one rotational weekly off between Monday and Friday.

Leave policy: Leaves are generally not approved during the first three months of joining, except in case of emergencies.

Age: 18 - 30

Other: Should not be currently engaged in any real estate business or property brokerage. Candidates should be able to join immediately.

Description:
The Group
Morningstar’s corporate functions play an essential role in supporting our company’s strategic initiatives, day-to-day operations, and infrastructure. The People and Culture team is the steward of Morningstar’s unique culture. We design and deliver the end-to-end programs and experiences that support the entire talent lifecycle. By helping our employees succeed, we contribute to Morningstar’s growth and success.

The Role
The Talent Acquisition Operations Analyst plays a key role in driving process excellence, data integrity, and technology optimization for the India region. You will serve as the process and technology SME for India TA—ensuring our systems, analytics, and governance practices enable an efficient, high-quality hiring experience for candidates, recruiters, and business leaders. Reporting to the Director of Global Talent Acquisition Operations, this role focuses on identifying opportunities for process standardization, improving efficiency, and implementing solutions. You will collaborate with the Director, Talent Acquisition, India region, and across People & Culture functions to enable process optimization, technology enablement, and an improved User experience.

Key Responsibilities
Partner with the Director, Talent Acquisition Operations to establish, refine and document global talent acquisition processes that improve recruiting workflows, reduce manual work, and ensure consistent candidate experience. Includes requirements gathering, leading user design sessions, UAT and deployment.
Serve as a Workday subject matter expert for global Talent Acquisition teams, supporting our roadmap of enhancements in partnership with the Workday team. Manage day-to-day questions and issues.
Design and maintain the recruiting playbook for India, ensuring that recruiting teams understand and adhere to TA processes and compliance requirements. Implement governance practices through periodic audits.
Identify and document reporting and/or dashboard needs and assure insights are delivered to TA, business, and HR leaders.
Monitor errors and defects in tools, processes, and technology to identify root cause issues. Partner with Workday and IT teams to resolve/implement improvements.
Support recruiter enablement through configuration, testing, training, and documentation of processes.
Collaborate across COE’s to minimize organizational silos, integrate future state plans, and streamline communications. Support internal communications and training to drive awareness and consistent adoption of TA processes and systems.
Assist with vendor management and evaluation of new TA technology solutions.

Requirements
5+ years of experience working in talent acquisition operations, HR Information Systems, or related.
Demonstrated expertise in specific areas of TA or HR operations which include but are not limited to talent acquisition technology, candidate/manager experience and data insights and analytics.
Proficiency working with Workday Recruiting or equivalent ATS, as well as related tools.
Proven success in identifying, designing, and implementing process improvement; good command of data and analytics.
Ability to present data and influence key stakeholders, establishing credibility and building trust with team and internal clients.
Knowledge of India labor laws and data privacy practices related to recruiting.
Effective communication, organizational and project management skills.
Four-year degree preferred.

Fresher
Location: Bangalore
____________________________________________________________________________________
About MarketStar
At Regalix, A MarketStar Company, you will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic
environment that thrives on collaboration, embraces cutting-edge technologies, and
delivers impactful solutions to our clients. With a shared commitment to excellence,
innovation, and client success, we are setting new benchmarks in the market. By
leveraging Regalix's deep understanding of digital marketing strategies and MarketStar's
proven track record in driving advertising operations, we have forged a unique synergy that
propels us to the forefront of our field.
Together, we shape the future of digital advertising by providing operational excellence
and data-driven insights that enable clients to succeed.
____________________________________________________________________________________
About the Client
The worlds largest professional networking platform.
____________________________________________________________________________________
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly motivated Media Operations Executive / Ad Operations Executive
to join our team in Bangalore. This is a 100% backend, non-voice role focused on
supporting LinkedIn advertising operations across Marketing Solutions (LMS), Talent
Solutions (LTS), and Agency Support (LAS).
The role involves campaign setup, optimization, reporting, CRM case management, and
billing updates, ensuring accurate and timely execution to support LinkedIns operational
and revenue objectives.
____________________________________________________________________________________
Key Skills
Advertising Platforms: Proficiency in LinkedIn Campaign Manager Tool (CMT),
Merlin, Campaign IQ (CIQ), and familiarity with other digital platforms (Google Ads,
Facebook Ads Manager is a plus).
Data Analysis: Ability to interpret campaign data, identify trends, and generate
actionable insights.
CRM Expertise: Proficiency in Zendesk, Salesforce, or Microsoft Dynamics for case
management and reporting.
Reporting & Technical Skills: Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills to create
reports, dashboards, and presentations.
Operational Excellence: Strong attention to detail, data accuracy, and adherence to
SLA, IRT, and quality standards.
Problem Solving: Ability to troubleshoot issues, validate information, and escalate
complex cases when needed.
Collaboration: Work effectively with Sales, Program Managers, and internal cross
functional teams.
Continuous Learning: Stay updated on LinkedIn advertising operations, tools, and
best practices.
____________________________________________________________________________________
Key Responsibilities
Common Responsibilities (All LOBs LMS, LTS, LAS)
Manage incoming requests exclusively through CRM tools; no voice or phone
communication.
Own cases end-to-end: intake, execution, QA, and closure.
Maintain CRM hygiene, including documentation, tagging, and accurate status
updates.
Generate Excel and PowerPoint reports, ensuring adherence to LinkedIn-approved
templates.
Meet performance metrics including SLA, IRT, Utilization, Quality, and Shrinkage.
Participate in training, coaching, and process improvement initiatives.
Communicate updates through CRM, case chatter, or email only.
____________________________________________________________________________________
Shift Coverage
Rotational Shift
____________________________________________________________________________________
Key Qualifications
Graduate / post-graduate in any discipline.
Strong proficiency in CRM tools, Excel, PowerPoint, and LinkedIn advertising
platforms.
Excellent written communication skills and attention to detail.
Comfortable working in a backend, non-voice operations role.
Ability to work in SLA-driven, high-volume environments across global shifts.
____________________________________________________________________________________
What’s in it for you?
Constant learning and career growth opportunities.
Employee-centric benefits including comprehensive health insurance, generous
leave policy, and well-being programs.
Exposure to the world’s leading brands as clients.
Work flexibility and a culture of recognition for high performers.
Opportunity to be part of an organization with 60% homegrown leaders.
Customized training programs for professional development.
AboutCompany:
About MarketStar : In everything we do, we believe in creating growth, for our clients, employees, and community. For the past 35+ years, we have been generating revenue for the most innovative tech companies globally through our outsourced B2B demand, sales, customer success, and revenue operations solutions. We are passionate about cultivating career advancements for our people and supporting them through mentorship, leadership, and career development programs. We provide service and support to our communities through the MarketStar Foundation.
Our exceptional team is the cornerstone of MarketStar's accomplishments. We are proud of our award-winning workplace culture and for being named a top employer. These achievements are a testament to our six core values, embraced by our 3,000+ employees worldwide. From our headquarters in Utah, USA, to our global offices in India, Ireland, Bulgaria, Mexico, the Philippines, and Australia, we all work together to drive innovation and success.
We are excited to have you apply to join our MarketStar team and cant wait to discuss how we can help you find growth!

Description:
Customer Service Executive

Department: Customer Servicing

Are you a people-first individual who enjoys helping customers and solving problems? Join our team at NoBroker as a Customer Service Executive and be the trusted voice that helps our customers through their property journey!

Location: Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore)
Position Type: Full-time
Salary Range: 4.28 LPA to 5.05 LPA (inclusive of variable components & based on current relevant experience)

About Us

NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000 transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1 billion.

Specific Responsibilities

Act as a Relationship Manager for paid customers, building trust and ensuring long-term engagement.
Handle inbound and outbound calls for approximately 3–4 hours daily as part of a voice-based customer service process.
Understand customer needs and assist in resolving queries and finding the right tenant or property, with a strong focus on customer experience rather than hard sales targets.
Provide regular, proactive updates on account/service progress and utilize internal tools while adhering to company guidelines for high-quality service delivery.
Go the extra mile to provide exceptional customer service and ensure customer satisfaction; performance is monitored though the role is not heavily target-based.

Perks & Value Proposition

Performance incentives: Earn performance-based incentives of up to 15,000 per month, over and above your fixed salary.
Health insurance: 1 lakh group insurance per year, fully paid by the company.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2 years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for all employees.
Employee referral program: Incentives for bringing in new talent.

Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers

Education: Graduation, HSC (12th) or 10th qualified. Should not be currently pursuing any full-time, part-time, online, or distance-learning course.
Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, good interpersonal skills, numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making and problem-solving skills.
Languages: English mandatory; Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred.
Technical skills: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word).
Work schedule: 6-day working week — Saturday and Sunday are working days, with one rotational weekly off between Monday and Friday.
Leave policy: Leaves are generally not approved during the first three months of joining, except in case of emergencies.
Other: Should not be currently engaged in any real estate business or property brokerage. Candidates should be able to join immediately.

Why NoBroker?
At NoBroker, we believe in empowering our employees to reach their full potential. Join a dynamic team of professionals who are passionate about changing the real estate landscape. Take the next step in your career and apply today!

Description:
Tele Sales Executive

Department: Sales
Are you a motivated individual with a passion for real estate sales? Join our team at NoBroker as a Tele Sales Executive and help revolutionize the way people buy and sell properties!

Location: Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore)
Position Type: Full-time
Salary Range: 4.97 LPA to 5.74 LPA (inclusive of variable components & based on current relevant experience)

About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000 transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1 billion.

Specific Responsibilities

Make outbound calls and handle inbound enquiries from prospective customers for approximately 3 to 4 hours every day as part of a voice-based sales process.
Own end-to-end sales conversion understand customer requirements, pitch NoBrokers property and service offerings, and close deals to achieve monthly sales targets.
Build trust and rapport with leads, negotiate effectively, and provide regular follow-ups until conversion.
Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, and conversions using internal CRM tools and adhere to company sales processes.
Consistently work towards and exceed individual and team sales targets to maximize performance-based incentives.

Perks & Value Proposition

Attractive incentives: Earn performance-based incentives of 20,000 - 25,000 per month, over and above your fixed salary.
Health insurance: 1 lakh group insurance per year, fully paid by the company.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top sales performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2 years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for all employees.
Employee referral program: Incentives for bringing in new talent.

Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers

Education: Graduation, 12th, or 10th qualified. Should not be currently pursuing any full-time, part-time, online, or distance-learning course.
Skills: Excellent verbal communication, strong negotiation and persuasion skills, target-driven mindset, and good interpersonal skills.
Languages: English mandatory; Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred.
Technical skills: Basic proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word) and comfort using CRM/calling tools.
Work schedule: 6-day working week Saturday and Sunday are working days, with one rotational weekly off between Monday and Friday.
Leave policy: Leaves are generally not approved during the first three months of joining, except in case of emergencies.
Age: 18 - 30

Department: Sales

Are you a motivated individual with a passion for real estate sales? Join our team at NoBroker as a Tele Sales Executive and help revolutionize the way people buy and sell properties!

Location: Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore)
Position Type: Full-time
Salary Range: 4.97 LPA to 5.74 LPA (inclusive of variable components & based on current relevant experience)

About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000 transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1 billion.
Specific Responsibilities

Make outbound calls and handle inbound enquiries from prospective customers for approximately 3 to 4 hours every day as part of a voice-based sales process.

Own end-to-end sales conversion understand customer requirements, pitch NoBrokers property and service offerings, and close deals to achieve monthly sales targets.

Build trust and rapport with leads, negotiate effectively, and provide regular follow-ups until conversion.

Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, and conversions using internal CRM tools and adhere to company sales processes.

Consistently work towards and exceed individual and team sales targets to maximize performance-based incentives.

Perks & Value Proposition

Attractive incentives: Earn performance-based incentives of 20,000 - 25,000 per month, over and above your fixed salary.

Health insurance: 1 lakh group insurance per year, fully paid by the company.

Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding performers eligible for promotions every quarter.

Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top sales performers.

Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2 years.

Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for all employees.

Employee referral program: Incentives for bringing in new talent.

Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers

Education:
Graduation, 12th, or 10th qualified. Should not be currently pursuing any full-time, part-time, online, or distance-learning course.

Skills:
Excellent verbal communication, strong negotiation and persuasion skills, target-driven mindset, and good interpersonal skills.

Languages: English mandatory; Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu or Marathi preferred.

Technical skills: Basic proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word) and comfort using CRM/calling tools.

Work schedule: 6-day working week Saturday and Sunday are working days, with one rotational weekly off between Monday and Friday.

Leave policy: Leaves are generally not approved during the first three months of joining, except in case of emergencies.

Age: 18 - 30

Other: Should not be currently engaged in any real estate business or property brokerage. Candidates should be able to join immediately.

About Rentokil PCI

Rentokil PCI is India's leading pest control service provider and a part of Rentokil Initial, the world's leading pest control brand. Established in 2017 through a joint venture between Pest Control India and Rentokil, the company operates across 300+ locations in India.
We are committed to delivering exceptional customer service through innovation, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction.
Website: https://www.rentokil-pestcontrolindia.com

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Service Planner to join our Operations team at the Dadar branch.
The candidate will be responsible for planning, scheduling, and coordinating service activities for field technicians to ensure timely service delivery, optimum resource utilization, and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Plan and schedule daily, weekly, and monthly service visits for field technicians.
Coordinate technician allocation, route planning, and service appointments.
Monitor daily service schedules and ensure timely completion of assigned visits.
Coordinate with Sales, Operations, and Service teams for new appointments, urgent requests, and customer complaints.
Track pending services, service backlogs, renewals, and customer escalations.
Maintain accurate service records, reports, and documentation in company software.
Monitor technician productivity, service efficiency, and performance KPIs.
Ensure maximum utilization of digital service platforms and mobile applications.
Follow up on customer feedback, complaints, and service-related issues.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports for management.
Coordinate with the IT team for system access and technical support whenever required.

Candidate Requirements
Graduate in any discipline.
1–3 years of relevant experience in service coordination, service planning, operations, or team coordination.
Good knowledge of MS Excel, MS Office, and basic computer applications.
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Good planning, organizing, and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced work environment.
Customer-oriented approach with strong attention to detail.
Experience coordinating with field staff, technicians, or service teams will be an added advantage.

Key Skills

Service Planning | Scheduling | Operations Coordination | Technician Management | MS Excel | Customer Service | Route Planning | MIS Reporting | Workforce Management | Team Coordination

Why Join Rentokil PCI?

Opportunity to work with a leading multinational organization.
Professional learning and development opportunities.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
Exposure to structured operations and digital service management systems.
Career growth opportunities.

Interested candidates can apply with their updated resumes.
Join Rentokil PCI and become a part of a team committed to operational excellence and outstanding customer service!

Job description
Role & responsibilities
As an Executive - Customer Service, you will be responsible to communicate with consumers of healthcare and telecommunication providers in the United States to collect on overdue and unpaid bills. As a collection specialist, you will be responsible for calling consumers on phone and negotiating for the overdue payment, on behalf of the client.
Utilize effective verbal communication and customer service skills while communicating with customers to resolve the account delinquency.
Able to manage difficult customer issues while working in a fast-paced environment
Determine the reason for delinquency and best course of action to assist consumers.
Engage our consumers with the highest level of respect and dignity.
Document all collection efforts for each assigned account in accordance with established procedures and compliance policies.
Communicate professionally and regularly with leadership and peers on status of accounts, escalations in accordance with established standards.
Ensure all accounts in assigned lists are managed accurately and in a timely manner.
Calls are majorly outbound and over a period moves to a blended (inbound/outbound) environment.
Accounts are early/mid/late - stage defaults return payments, first payment defaults, and work date follow up assignments.
Preferred candidate profile
Good communication skills
This job requires you to work in US shifts between 5:30 pm & 10:30 am
Perks and benefits
Best in Market Salaries from 3 lakhs plus
7 week new hire training program
Unlimited Incentive Plan with transparent KRA's • Enhance your Analytical/Decision Making & Negotiation skills
Cross functional growth opportunities within 6 months, for experienced candidates
Free Medical/Life insurance • Employee Centric & Compliant Policies
Free Home Pick & Drop Transportation
Fixed shifts post the training period [Rare changes in case of business requirements]
7:15 min login plus 45 minute break = 8 hour shifts
Sunday fixed Off & Alternate Saturday Working

Are you a motivated individual with a passion for real estate sales? Join our team at
Nobroker as an Inside Sales Executive and help revolutionize the way people buy and
sell properties !!!

Location : Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore)
Position Type : Full-time
Salary Range : Up to 2 LPA to 3 LPA
& based on current relevant experience)

About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech
unicorn. It’s a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants
and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh
new users each month, it’s reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000
transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered
in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and
Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1
billion.

Specific Responsibilities:
Act as a Relationship Manager for paid customers, building trust and ensuring long term
engagement.
Understand customer needs and assist in finding the right tenant or property with tailored
solutions.
Manage inbound and outbound calls, negotiate with leads, and provide regular updates
on account progress.

Utilize internal tools and adhere to company guidelines to deliver efficient and high-
quality service.

Go the extra mile to provide exceptional customer service and ensure customer
satisfaction.

Perks & Value Proposition:

Health insurance: Rs 1 lakh per year, fully paid by the company.
Free lunch and snacks: Provided to all employees.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding
performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2
years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for
all employees.
Employee referral program: Incentives for bringing in new talent.

Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers:

Education: Graduation or HSC qualified.
Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, good interpersonal skills,
numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making skills.
Languages: English and Hindi mandatory; Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred.
Technical skills: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word).
Work schedule: day shift (9 hours between 8 AM - 10 PM), and
comfortable working 6 days a week, with a weekday off.

Why Nobroker?
At Nobroker, we believe in empowering our employees to reach their full potential. Join a
dynamic team of professionals who are passionate about changing the real estate landscape.
Take the next step in your career and apply today !!!

Description:
Job Title
Senior Executive - Alternatives


Department
Leasing - Alternatives


Job Summary
We are looking for a dynamic and driven professional to join the Leasing team, focused on alternative real estate segments including schools, hospitals, co-living, senior living, and student housing. The role requires a blend of field-based surveying expertise and transaction management skills, with the ability to build relationships across a diverse set of stakeholders including developers, operators, landowners, and institutional clients unique to these sectors.


Role Overview

Key Responsibilities
Business Development
Drive strong business development activities through networking, industry seminars, sector-specific conferences, and other sourcing channels relevant to alternative segments such as education, healthcare, and living segment operators.
Leverage existing and building new relationships with the industry stakeholders covering developers, land owners, HNIs and institutional players, with a focused approach on identifying business opportunities within the alternatives segment.
Develop and execute parallel business development strategies for the assigned geography, with accountability for meeting or exceeding individual transaction targets.
Site Identification and Due Diligence
Conduct site surveys, micro siting, site procurement, and identification of supply suited to the specific requirements of schools, hospitals, senior living, co-living, and student housing formats.
Pool and maintain detailed property information, including coordinates, ownership details, and land-use considerations relevant to alternative asset development.
Conduct site inspections to assess suitability for specific use cases such as healthcare infrastructure, educational campuses, or residential living formats.
Collect competitor intelligence specific to the alternative segments and maintain strong cross-functional rapport to support cross-selling of services.
Client and Stakeholder Management
Assess client requirements through regular interaction with developers, institutional operators, and end-users across the relevant sectors.
Provide input on pricing strategy and actively participate in proposal discussions tailored to the operational and regulatory nuances of alternative asset classes.
Ensure optimum client service delivery through calls, meetings, site visits, and presentations, with timely follow-up and accurate submission of proposals.
Transaction Management
Manage the end-to-end leasing and acquisition process for alternative asset transactions, including supply and demand identification, financial modelling, best-use analysis, target identification, deal structuring, and negotiation.
Coordinate legal and commercial due diligence, working closely with solicitors, legal consultants, and relevant government or regulatory bodies, given the specialized compliance requirements often associated with healthcare, education, and senior living developments.
Prepare information memorandums, financial analyses, and market intelligence reports specific to alternative segments.
Prepare marketing collateral, including client presentations and proposals, tailored to the needs of institutional and operator clients in these sectors.
Maintain overall governance and process discipline throughout the execution phase of each transaction.
Experience Required
Up to 2 years of relevant experience as a surveyor or broker with hands-on fieldwork exposure. Prior experience or exposure to alternative asset classes will be an added advantage.
Skills and Competencies
Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage credibly with institutional operators, developers, and regulatory stakeholders.
Sound understanding of real estate fundamentals, with willingness to develop specialized knowledge of alternative asset classes.
Strong analytical skills for financial modelling, feasibility analysis, and market research.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for client-facing engagements and proposal submissions.
Self-motivated with a results-driven approach and ability to work independently in the field.
Proficiency in MS Office tools, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, for financial analysis and presentation preparation.
Qualifications
Graduate or postgraduate degree in Real Estate, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. Additional certifications in real estate or exposure to healthcare, education, or senior living sector dynamics will be viewed favourably.


Location
On-site - Pune, MH


Scheduled Weekly Hours
40

Description:
We are hiring enthusiastic, career-oriented Freshers for a Customer Support - Voice Process role. This opportunity is ideal for graduates who possess excellent communication skills in English and Hindi, are passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences, and are eager to build a successful career in the customer service industry. The ideal candidate should be confident in interacting with customers over phone calls, demonstrate strong listening and problem-solving skills, and maintain a customer-first approach while upholding professionalism at all times. Since the role involves supporting customers from diverse regions, the ability to communicate effectively in Hindi whenever required is mandatory.

General Guidelines:
Registrations will be processed on a first-come, first-served basis.
Participation is limited to the first 350 eligible candidates reporting between 09:00 AM and 11:00 AM.
Personal laptops, tablets, or other electronic devices are not permitted during the interview process.
Candidates are advised to carry a mobile charger, as the assessment and interview process may continue throughout the day.
We are specifically looking for fresh graduates with outstanding communication skills and a customer-centric mindset.
Applicants must have completed their Graduation or Postgraduation. Candidates currently pursuing any degree, certification, or educational program are not eligible.
The role operates in a 24x7 work environment, primarily supporting customers across different geographies, including US customers. Candidates must be willing to work in rotational shifts and rotational week-offs.
Candidates who can join immediately are highly encouraged to apply, as immediate availability will be considered an advantage.

Candidates must bring required documents:

Two copies of their updated resume.
A valid Government-issued photo ID proof.
Original and photocopies of educational certificates and marksheets.

Eligibility Criteria:
Freshers are welcome to apply.
Any internship experience, customer service exposure, or BPO experience will be an added advantage.
Experience in Content Moderation will be considered a plus.
Excellent spoken English is mandatory.
Strong communication skills in Hindi and English are mandatory.
Ability to read, write, understand, and communicate fluently in both Hindi and English is a key requirement for this role.
Strong listening, interpersonal, and communication skills.
Ability to engage in professional and fluent customer conversations.
Customer-focused mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities.

COMPANY DESCRIPTION:
Allegis Group is the largest privately held talent management firm in the world. We are headquartered in
Hanover, Maryland, USA, and consist of a number of specialist operating companies (OpCos) that serve a
wide range of industries. We work with clients across the world and have more than 15,000 people who work
across 500+ offices with operations in North America, Europe, and Asia.
Allegis Group is founded on a culture that is passionate about transforming the way the world acquires talent
by delivering client-focused solutions that make a difference for businesses worldwide. From refining how
you manage your contingent workforce to strengthening your employer brand to recruit top talent, our
integrated talent solutions drive the business results you need.
JOB TITLE: Recruiter Level 1
LOCATION: Bangalore, Karnataka
JOB DESCRIPTION:
If you have the passion to work with people and are excited by the thought of collaborating with an
international audience, making a difference in peoples lives around the world, and of course growing your
career in the HR Recruitment space, you should interview with us.
JOB SUMMARY:
The key focus for a Recruiter is to execute sourcing strategies and plans with a focus on passive candidates,
with the aim of achieving high quality, cost-effective and timely filling of roles. You will work closely with the
Recruitment Relationship Manager and stakeholders to recommend and develop a sourcing strategy. Based
on your experience, you will recommend enhancements to ensure recruitment strategy effectiveness and
will initiate and drive best-practice sourcing strategies
Your duties may include, but are not limited to:
Responsible for identifying talent that meets specific client requirements.
Build a strong working relationship with Recruitment Relationship Manager and stakeholders.
¢ Understanding & analyzing the requirement of the position based on clients specifications.
¢ Utilize a variety of recruiting strategies to focus on direct sourced (passive) candidates.
¢ Involved in sourcing profiles through job portals, internal databases, and professional networking.
¢ Utilize the internal database to identify potential candidates and post jobs on the portals to increase
the pool of candidates.
¢ Call potential candidates in the US and discuss the job openings.
¢ Provide exceptional candidate care and ensure that candidates are effectively pre-screened before.
¢ Select and qualify candidates based on skill, cultural, and motivational fit, utilizing behavioral-based
Approach and screening criteria.
¢ Maintain timely and accurate information on all candidate interactions.
¢ Proactively pipeline talent and create pre-qualified candidate talent pools in line with the clients.
QUALIFICATION:
¢ Bachelors/Masters degree. (For recent under-graduates: They should have all the semesters
original mark sheets. No active backlogs)



¢ The average of 10th, 12th (PUC), and UG marks percentage should be more than 60%.
¢ Ability to learn and adapt to working on newer skills and requirements demands.
¢ Possess strong written and oral English communication skills.
¢ Ability to recruit with a sense of urgency.
¢ Availability to work before/after typical office hours as work may necessitate.
¢ A strong work ethic and sense of commitment.
¢ Ability to work under pressure and target-driven environment.
WORK SCHEDULE:
Night Shift Should be flexible to work on both shift
CAREER PATHWAY
¢ Shift- 1: 5:30 pm/6.30 pm IST to 2:30 am/3.30 am IST
¢ Shift- 2: 8:30 pm/9.30 pm IST to 5:30 am/6.30 am IST
¢ Saturday & Sunday fixed off

Job Description
Overview

We are looking for passionate and detail-oriented Architecture Interns to join our Architecture team. The internship provides hands-on experience in architectural design, Revit/BIM modelling, documentation, detailing, and multidisciplinary coordination on live projects, with guidance from experienced Architects and BIM professionals and exposure to international project workflows.

Your role:

Develop architectural Revit models and drawings, including plans, elevations, sections, schedules, working drawings, and details, under senior guidance.
Support design and construction documentation and architectural detailing for elements such as doors, toilets, staircases, wall interfaces, and other building components.
Coordinate architectural information with Structural, MEP, BIM, Interior Design, and other disciplines.
Incorporate design and QA/QC comments and follow established project standards, BIM workflows, QA/QC procedures, and documentation guidelines.
Support Rhino-based modelling and complex geometry development where required.
Take responsibility for assigned tasks, meeting agreed timelines with project-team guidance.
Participate in coordination meetings, design reviews, team discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
About you

Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch) and available for a 4-6 month internship.
Good working knowledge of Autodesk Revit and AutoCAD.
Good understanding of architectural design fundamentals, building construction, working drawings, and detailing.
Good verbal and written communication skills, with willingness to learn and collaborate in a multidisciplinary environment.

Portfolio Expectations

Candidates should showcase one or two academic design projects, preferably demonstrating:

Architectural design development and understanding of building construction.
Working drawings and construction details, including application of relevant building codes and standards.
Revit/BIM-based modelling or documentation, where available.
Preferred Skills

Knowledge of Rhino and Grasshopper and an interest in complex geometry or technically challenging architectural projects.
Familiarity with SketchUp, Photoshop, InDesign, or Enscape.
Basic understanding of BIM workflows and multidisciplinary coordination.
Exposure to international or Middle East architectural projects is an advantage but not mandatory.
Professional Qualities

Passion for Architecture, attention to detail, and commitment to quality.
Positive, collaborative attitude with ownership of assigned tasks and responsiveness to feedback.
Good communication and coordination skills, including proactively seeking clarification and resolving issues.
Enthusiasm for developing technical, design, BIM, and software skills.
Reward benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.
About AtkinsRalis

We're AtkinsRalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
